meta.plot: A skilled surgeon becomes a coma patient and possesses a first-year resident who is the polar opposite of him in expertise and personality.

1.title: KO - Ghost Doctor [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Finest Cardiothoracic Surgeon
1.plot: Sensing that Ko Seung-tak, a resident at Eunsang University Medical Center, will not get along with him, Cha Young-min, the top cardiothoracic surgeon, plans to get rid of him.

1.title: KO - Ghost Doctor [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - A Coma Ghost
1.plot: Young-min finds his body in a critical condition and gets confused about if he is alive or dead; Young-min discovers that he can possess Seung-tak only; a mysterious man calls Young-min a coma ghost.

1.title: KO - Ghost Doctor [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - A Well-Planned Coincidence
1.plot: Young-min suspects Seung-tak for the car accident but reconsiders his opinions when Seung-tak makes a sacrifice for him; a VIP patient suffers side effects after the surgery.

1.title: KO - Ghost Doctor [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - You Want In Or Out?
1.plot: With an emergency patient in front of him, Seung-tak struggles. At the same time, Young-min faces the risk of disappearing for good. The two become physically and mentally inseparable, but neither one seems to accept the situation. Meanwhile, Young-min finds out who the wrongdoer behind Chairman Jang’s case is and gets shocked.

1.title: KO - Ghost Doctor [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Help Me Out Here!
1.plot: Seung-tak has no other option but to ask Young-min for help in saving an emergency patient. While Young-min is impressed with his good faith, he is also shocked and realizes that there is a possibility that Seung-tak might be seeing him. But first things first, the two team up to save the patient.

1.title: KO - Ghost Doctor [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Ghost Patient
1.plot: Young-min finds out from the ghost patient that the accident he was involved in was also planned out by someone. Meanwhile, Seung-jo begs Seung-tak to do whatever it takes to save him. However, the only doctor who can save Seung-jo is Young-min, and the only person who can connect the two is Seung-tak.

1.title: KO - Ghost Doctor [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - What It Means to Save Someone’s Life
1.plot: Young-min is excited that he can save someone’s life again. At the same time, Seung-tak asks Young-min what it’s like to save a life all on your own. Meanwhile, someone special to Young-min visits the hospital, not as a guest but as a patient.

1.title: KO - Ghost Doctor [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Sharing Secrets
1.plot: Young-min reveals the truth about what happened to Seung-tak 12 years ago; Young-min's assailant regains consciousness but cannot remember anything.

1.title: KO - Ghost Doctor [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Ghost Doctor
1.plot: Se-jin feels Young-min's presence when interacting with Seung-tak; Seung-won finds Seung-tak's behaviour suspicious.

1.title: KO - Ghost Doctor [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - No Reason to Hide
1.plot: Young-min, still in Seung-tak's body, decides to reveal himself to Seung-won; Seung-tak helps Young-min spend some time with Se-jin; something unexpected happens at the hospital.

1.title: KO - Ghost Doctor [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Weak Spot
1.plot: Young-min feels helpless when the coordination with Seung-jo goes wrong during surgery. Knowing how frustrated Young-min is, Seung-tak looks for other ways to save him. Meanwhile, Se-jin tries to keep a distance from Seung-tak, and Seung-tak is bothered by her sudden change in attitude. After pushing Seung-tak away, Se-jin is alone, and that’s when Min-ho barges in.

1.title: KO - Ghost Doctor [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - The Conflict
1.plot: Se-jin collapses due to overwork and takes a few days off; Se-jin warns Seung-tak to stay away from Young-min; Seung-won and Tae-hyun hatch another plot.

1.title: KO - Ghost Doctor [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Anything but This
1.plot: Seung-tak loses control during his surgery and disappears, leaving everyone at the hospital worried. Young-min learns about Seung-tak's history, and Se-jin's suspicion about Seung-tak grows.

1.title: KO - Ghost Doctor [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - Thank You Tes
1.plot: The connection between Young-min, Seung-tak, and Tes is revealed; Seung-tak returns to the hospital, and Se-jin is surprised to see the new Seung-tak.

1.title: KO - Ghost Doctor [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - A Difficult Decision
1.plot: Se-jin discovers Seung-tak's secret; Seung-tak learns that the surgery has a major side effect; Young-min intends to treat as many patients; Young-min must make a tough choice.

1.title: KO - Ghost Doctor [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - Life and Death
1.plot: Seung-tak and Young-min get ready for Young-min’s surgery, but Young-min looks like he has a lot on his mind. Either way, this is going to be their last surgery together as one. After the surgery, everyone waits to see if Young-min recovers. However, not everyone wishes that he would wake up or remember what has happened in the past few months.

meta.plot: In the series we will meet a number of talented singers who aim to be part of a band. To form their bond, they'll have one-on-one conversations (and singing sessions) to figure out who they have the best chemistry with. Only when they decide who they want to form a band with do the different members get to see each other. From then on, they will have to work together to achieve the best performance.

1.title: EN - Building the Band [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E01 - The Pinky Promise
1.plot: The singers settle into sound booths and hear their potential bandmates perform live. Will they make a musical match — or will their personalities clash?

1.title: EN - Building the Band [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E02 - Locked In
1.plot: As more singers await their fate, one vocalist makes a career-defining decision. A new band is born, and AJ brings in Nicole Scherzinger as a mentor.

1.title: EN - Building the Band [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E03 - The Magic Number
1.plot: Options dwindle for those who haven't found a band yet. As more musical alliances emerge, two groups take the stage for their formation performance.

1.title: EN - Building the Band [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E04 - I Always Get What I Want
1.plot: A contestant goes home in tears when a new group locks in. Can a boy band find their fourth member? One singer without a band stirs up suspense.

1.title: EN - Building the Band [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E05 - The First Look
1.plot: Six freshly formed bands move in together to test if they can cohabitate in harmony. At their first look performance, they finally see their competition.

1.title: EN - Building the Band [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E06 - Breaking the Band
1.plot: What's in a name? The bands must decide before the showcase. A budding romance puts one group at risk; Kelly Rowland and Liam Payne join as guest judges.

1.title: EN - Building the Band [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E07 - The Showcase
1.plot: The bands showcase their skills before a live studio audience for the first time. As elimination looms, one vocalist's power moves strike a sour note.

1.title: EN - Building the Band [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E08 - The Big Stage
1.plot: Bigger stage, bigger crowd: As the stakes rise, pressure mounts. The bands lay it all on the line, leaving their future up to the audience to decide.

1.title: EN - Building the Band [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E09 - The Pressure Is On
1.plot: One contestant faces a singer's worst nightmare: vocal issues. In a bold move, a group changes their song at the last minute. Will it pay off?

1.title: EN - Building the Band [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E10 - The Finals
1.plot: Fueled by a surprise boost of support, the three final bands give powerhouse performances. Who will be crowned winner — and who will face the music?

meta.plot: Leaning on each other through thick and thin, a trio of best friends stand together as they experience life, love and loss on the brink of turning 40.

1.title: KO - Thirty-Nine [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Thirty, Nine
1.plot: Cha Mi-jo announces her sabbatical to her two best friends. Chance encounters and sweet-scented peonies draw Kim Seon-u and Mi-jo together.

1.title: KO - Thirty-Nine [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - One Absurd Day
1.plot: Unable to let her go, Kim Jin-seok asks Jeong Chan-young to rethink their breakup. Mi-jo receives a heart-racing confession... and heartbreaking news.

1.title: KO - Thirty-Nine [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Something I Had Never Thought Of
1.plot: Jin-seok's wife confronts Chan-young. Lacking the courage to tell Chan-young the diagnosis, Mi-jo takes her anger out on someone else.

1.title: KO - Thirty-Nine [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Choice
1.plot: Chan-young and Jin-seok tearfully reveal their secrets to each other. A friend's sighting of Kim So-won at an unlikely place rattles Seon-u.

1.title: KO - Thirty-Nine [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Rachmaninoff Piano Concerto No. 2
1.plot: Chan-young creates a bucket list of her to-do items for loved ones. Mi-jo consoles a guilt-ridden Seon-u, who blames himself for So-won's sorrows.

1.title: KO - Thirty-Nine [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Conviction
1.plot: At an impromptu dinner for four, Seon-u's dad shows his affinity for Mi-jo and aversion for So-won. Chan-young's mom stops by while Jin-seok is over.

1.title: KO - Thirty-Nine [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Inconvenient Truth
1.plot: Chan-young finds information on Mi-jo's birth mother and auditions to achieve a long-awaited dream. So-won moves into the orphanage.

1.title: KO - Thirty-Nine [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - When You Think It's the End
1.plot: Seon-u asks his father to apologize to So-won. Chan-young's mom demands answers from the trio. Mi-jo learns of her biological mother.

1.title: KO - Thirty-Nine [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - A Thousand Nights Over and Over Again
1.plot: Mi-jo's conversation with her birth mother leaves her distraught. Chan-young excitedly plans her mom's birthday, but nearly misses the celebration.

1.title: KO - Thirty-Nine [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - He Who Dances Must Pay the Piper
1.plot: When a strange man comes looking for Mi-jo at her clinic, she seeks answers from her adoptive mother. Jang Joo-hee expresses her frustration and fear.

1.title: KO - Thirty-Nine [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - About Romance
1.plot: Joo-hee and Mi-jo take Chan-young out to capture her smile after hearing she's taken her funeral photo. Mi-jo's parents invite Seon-u over for a meal.

1.title: KO - Thirty-Nine [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Samseong-dong, Hyochang-dong and Gocheok-dong
1.plot: Chan-young gets the chance to say goodbye to loved ones at an unforgettable brunch. Worried about Mi-jo, she leaves behind a surprise gift.

1.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S01E01 - Bobby Mackey's Music World
1.plot: Zak Bagans, Nick Groff, and Aaron Goodwin of the Ghost Adventures Crew (G.A.C.) embark on their quest of the supernatural with their paranormal investigation of Bobby Mackey's Music World in Wilder, Kentucky. With a history full of murder, suicide and satanic cult activity, this nightclub has become known as "Hell's Gate."

1.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S01E02 - Houghton Mansion
1.plot: Ghost Adventures investigate Houghton Mansion, where a tragic accident and suicide still haunt the Massachusetts mansion.

1.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S01E04 - Riddle House
1.plot: The Ghost Adventures team travels to West Palm Beach, FL, to investigate the Riddle House. Built in 1905 formerly called The Gatekeepers Cottage, the Riddle House was used as a funeral parlor and home to cemetery caretakers. Later it was used as a private residence. The house was moved from its original location, Acacia Rd, West Palm Beach, Florida. This seemed to have upset the spirits causing paranormal activity due to the house having seen its share of death and tragedy.

1.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S01E05 - Sloss Furnace
1.plot: Zak leads the team to Birmingham, AL, to investigate Sloss Furnaces. Built in 1881, this factory was a dangerous place to work. Many workers died and many more were injured. It's the souls of these workers that are believed to inhabit and haunt the factory.

1.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S01E06 - Former Psychiatric Hospital
1.plot: Zak, Nick and Aaron go to New Jersey to investigate an abandoned psychiatric hospital. This hospital once housed thousands of mentally ill patients, many of whom died due to poor conditions. Witnesses have reported disembodied voices and dark shadows there.

2.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S02E01 - Preston Castle
2.plot: Zak, Nick and Aaron are off to Ione, CA, to investigate Preston Castle -- a reformatory that once housed juvenile offenders and abandoned children. Its dark history includes an unsolved murder, countless instances of corporal punishment and many tragic deaths.

2.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S02E02 - Castillo de San Marcos
2.plot: The crew heads to St. Augustine, FL, to investigate a Spanish fort. More than 300 years after it was built in America's oldest city, Castillo de San Marcos is still defended by the spirits of soldiers and haunted by the prisoners once locked inside.

2.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S02E04 - Magnolia Plantation
2.plot: Zak, Nick and Aaron head to Natchitoches, LA, to investigate the Magnolia Plantation. Many slaves labored and died at this cotton plantation, which was built in 1830. The crew looks for evidence of voodoo rituals slaves may have used to seek revenge on the owners.

2.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S02E05 - Bird Cage Theater
2.plot: Ghost Adventures confronts the spirits of the Old West in Tombstone, AZ. The Bird Cage Theater embodied the heyday of the silver boom. Legendary gunslingers, gamblers and prostitutes drank and died in the theater, and some even stayed to haunt it.

2.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S02E06 - Eastern State Penitentiary
2.plot: The team goes to Philadelphia to investigate the abandoned Eastern State Penitentiary. Driven insane by solitary confinement, torture and disease, the inmates suffered an ugly and violent existence. Their angry spirits continue to roam the corridors.

2.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S02E07 - Moon River Brewery
2.plot: Zak, Nick and Aaron visit Savannah, GA, to investigate the Moon River Brewing Company. The building survived General Tecumseh Sherman and has seen its share of feuds, fights and lynchings. Today a ghost named Toby haunts the billiard room and other spirits lurk.

2.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S02E08 - Ancient Ram Inn
2.plot: The Ghost Adventures team travels to England to investigate the Ancient Ram Inn. Built around 1145, its long dark history includes a pagan burial ground, ritual sacrifices of children and a possible connection to Stonehenge.

3.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S03E01 - Pennhurst State
3.plot: Pennhurst State, a school for the developmentally disabled, was forced to close its doors in 1987 after numerous allegations of abuse and neglect. It's believed the tormented souls of the students still linger there.

3.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S03E02 - Poveglia Island
3.plot: Poveglia Island, off the coast of Venice, Italy, is one of the world's darkest epicenters. According to legend, the island was formed from the ashes of burned plague victims, criminals and mental patients who were exiled there.

3.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S03E03 - Ohio Reformatory
3.plot: In its 96-year history, more than 150,000 criminals were confined to the towering cell blocks of the Ohio Reformatory in Mansfield. Today, their evil spirits still prey on women, the elderly and the weak as they carry out their eternal sentences.

3.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S03E04 - Remington Arms
3.plot: The abandoned Remington Arms factory in Bridgeport, CT, has a dark history. Once the largest supplier of munitions in the world, mysterious explosions, electrocutions and melted bodies have earned it a deadly reputation.

3.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S03E05 - Washoe Club and Chollar Mine
3.plot: Zak, Nick and Aaron return to Virginia City, NV, the site of their very first investigation. The angry spirits in this old western mining town have been waiting for their return.

3.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S03E07 - Execution Rocks
3.plot: Execution Rocks Lighthouse inhabits a deserted island in the middle of Long Island Sound. Etched into a landscape of rocks and isolated by water, the lighthouse's history is full of dark stories of shipwrecks, torture and a serial killer.

3.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S03E08 - Prospect Place
3.plot: This mansion, owned by a wealthy abolitionist, was once a stop on the underground railroad. A gateway to freedom for hundreds of slaves, it was also the last stop for many who arrived in terrible physical condition and died there.

3.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S03E09 - Clovis Wolfe Manor
3.plot: During its 7 decades of operation as a sanitarium and convalescent home, thousands perished in this once stately manor. Some locals affix rosary beads and crucifixes to the fence surrounding the property to keep the evil spirits inside.

3.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S03E10 -

4.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S04E01 - Gettysburg
4.plot: The GA Crew travels to Gettysburg, PA, site of the bloodiest battle of the Civil War. While there, they attempt to make contact with dead soldiers, the sadistic woman who ran the town's orphanage and the ghosts of children she abused.

4.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S04E02 - Rolling Hills Sanitarium
4.plot: Rolling Hills Asylum is the Genesee County Poor Farm Tuberculosis ward, Insane Asylum, Geriatric Ward. The Genesee County Poor Farm had as many roles as it did characters. A Satan worshipping nurse, a gentle giant, and an alleged child molester all at one time or another roamed its halls Watch Zak, Nick, and Aaron cast themselves in this Theater of the Damned.

4.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S04E03 - Return to Mackey's
4.plot: When they first investigated Bobby Mackey's Music World in 2008, the Ghost Adventures Crew was physically attacked by unseen forces. And while they never expected to be followed home by the the spirits that haunt this country music bar...that's exactly what happened. Now, Zak, Nick and Aaron return to Wilder, Kentucky to confront the ghosts who have terrorized them the past two years.

4.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S04E04 - Waverly Hills
4.plot: Waverly Hills Sanatorium was the final destination for thousands of tuberculosis patients. The crew investigates its dark history and summons spirits that are still roaming the halls of this derelict building.

4.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S04E05 - Stanley Hotel
4.plot: Zak, Nick and Aaron get locked down in the Stanley Hotel, the house of horrors that inspired Stephen King's "The Shining." Join the crew in one of the world's most notorious nests of paranormal activity.

4.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S04E06 - Hill View Manor
4.plot: Formerly a home for the poor, aged and insane, Hill View Manor was known for countless suicides. Zak, Nick and Aaron investigate reports of full-bodied apparitions who seep out of its crumbling walls.

4.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S04E07 - Vulture Mine
4.plot: The Vulture Mine attracted thousands of gold-hungry prospectors in the 1800s. Before long, violence and corruption led to unspeakable deaths. Zak, Nick and Aaron investigate the evil spirits that haunt this barren gold-rush town.

4.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S04E08 - USS Hornet
4.plot: The crew explores the USS Hornet, a World War II-era aircraft carrier docked in San Francisco Bay. Visitors report seeing apparitions and bloodstains that mysteriously disappear.

4.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S04E09 - La Palazza (Las Vegas, NV)
4.plot: Sin City, Las Vegas, Nevada. The symbolic Last House on the Left, at the end of the street- La Palazza. This once opulent estate, still looks the same from the outside, but is now stripped down to it's proverbial skin and bones. In the shadow of the Las Vegas strip, La Palazza is the stepping stone for a tale that includes spiritual possession, secret rooms covered in blood, and maybe the most evil spirit that the Ghost Adventures Crew has ever encountered. Most of the story, is told thru the eyes of former owner, Chris Martinez, quite possibly, the most compelling character we've ever encountered. You can feel his pain, and how this house and the evil within this structure, tore apart his relationships, tore apart his life, and tore apart his soul

4.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S04E10 - Fort Chaffee
4.plot: Fort Chaffee trained soldiers for combat, held German POWs in the '40s, and housed hostile Cuban refugees in the '80s. Hundreds died there and today reports of paranormal activity persist. The Ghost Adventures crew reports for duty to uncover the truth.

4.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S04E11 - Amargosa Hotel
4.plot: Death Valley Junction, CA is a remote location where the living population is vastly outnumbered by the undead. Join Zak, Nick and Aaron in this dusty mining town as they battle a vicious spirit that is intensely hostile to men.

4.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S04E12 - Old Fort Erie
4.plot: The Ghost Adventures crew uncovers the gruesome stories of lives lost during the War of 1812 at Old Fort Erie. They explore this deeply haunted location in the hopes of making contact with men who made the ultimate sacrifice there.

4.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S04E13 - Villisca Axe Murder House
4.plot: Ghost Adventures investigates an Iowa house where 8 people were brutally murdered almost a century ago. Can Zak, Nick and Aaron find any paranormal clues to these horrific unsolved crimes?

4.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S04E15 - Pico House Hotel
4.plot: Zak, Nick and Aaron are joined by the Hollywood Ghost Hunters as they investigate a once-opulent hotel where 19 Chinese immigrants were murdered during a vicious race riot in 1871.

4.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S04E16 - Return to Goldfield Hotel
4.plot: Zak and company head out to the ghost town that launched their careers.

4.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S04E17 - Bonnie Springs Ranch
4.plot: Zak finds paranormal activity from the violent past of a Wild West town.

4.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S04E19 - Jerome Grand Hotel
4.plot: The crew visits Jerome Grand Hotel to mollify the community's angry ghosts.

4.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S04E20 - Yorktown Hospital
4.plot: The team revisits the past to reveal the events at Yorktown Memorial.

4.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S04E23 - Hales Bar Marina & Dam
4.plot: Zak, Nick and Aaron explore Hales Bar Marina, which locals say is cursed.

4.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S04E24 - Kentucky Slave House
4.plot: Zak, Nick and Aaron investigate the ghosts of the Maysville Slave House.

4.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S04E25 - Tooele Hospital
4.plot: Zak, Nick and Aaron investigate the demons of Tooele Hospital in Utah.

4.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S04E26 - Loretta Lynn's Plantation House
4.plot: Zak, Nick and Aaron investigate their first celebrity home when they visit the Loretta Lynn Plantation in Hurricane Mills, Tennessee. The team splits up and divides their investigation between locations all over the plantation.

4.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S04E27 -

5.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S05E01 - Ashmore Estates
5.plot: Zak, Nick and Aaron confront the demonic spirits of the Ashmore Estates.

5.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S05E02 - The Mizpah Hotel
5.plot: Zak, Nick and Aaron head to Tonapah, NV, to explore the Mizpah Hotel.

5.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S05E03 - Old Town San Diego
5.plot: Zak, Nick and Aaron enter into a multipart lockdown in Old Town San Diego.

5.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S05E04 - Winchester Mystery House
5.plot: The guys conduct a paranormal experiment at Winchester Mystery House.

5.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S05E05 - Lizzie Borden House
5.plot: The guys investigate the infamous axe murders at the Lizzie Borden House.

5.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S05E06 - Letchworth Village
5.plot: The guys explore an abandoned mental institution complex in upstate NY.

5.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S05E07 - Return to Virginia City
5.plot: Zak, Nick and Aaron return to the city where they captured some of their most compelling paranormal evidence. On this visit, they investigate three locations: the St Mary's Art Center, the Silver Queen Hotel, and the Miner's Cabin at the Gold Hill Hotel.

5.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S05E08 - Rocky Point Manor
5.plot: The crew investigates Rocky Point Manor and a Civil War battlefield.

5.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S05E09 - Rose Hall
5.plot: Zak, Nick and Aaron embark on a two-part lockdown on the island of Jamaica, which includes an exploration of the Rose Hall's infamous White Witch and the never-before-investigated home of Johnny Cash.

5.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S05E10 - Old Charleston Jail
5.plot: Zak, Nick, and Aaron investigate an old jail in Charleston, South Carolina. During its 137 years in operation, the Old Charleston Jail held within its stone walls some of the city's most notorious convicts. Some have been vindicated by history; others are remembered as monsters. For a few, their guilt or innocence remains a mystery.

6.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S06E01 - Shanghai Tunnels
6.plot: Zak, Nick and Aaron delve deep into the dingy Shanghai Tunnels in Portland.

6.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S06E02 - Peabody-Whitehead Mansion
6.plot: The guys explore an unsolved murder at the Peabody Mansion in Denver.

6.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S06E03 - The Copper Queen Hotel and the Oliver House
6.plot: Zak, Nick and Aaron engage in a two-part lockdown in the town of Bisbee.

6.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S06E04 - The National Hotel
6.plot: Zak, Nick and Aaron return to Nevada City to investigate a hotel and caves.

6.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S06E06 - The Galka Family
6.plot: Zak, Nick & Aaron help paranormal inventor Gary Galka and his family find closure after the tragic loss of Melissa, Gary's daughter, by celebrating her birthday. The team records audio evidence derived from Melissa's spirit.

6.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S06E07 - The Riviera Hotel
6.plot: Zak, Nick & Aaron explore the Riviera Hotel with a few special guest stars.

7.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S07E01 - Central Unit Prison
7.plot: Zak, Nick and Aaron investigate the ghoulish Central Unit Prison of Sugar Land, Texas, where more than 100 inmates have met their end in the electric chair.

7.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S07E01 - Central Unit Prison
7.plot: Zak, Nick and Aaron investigate the ghoulish Central Unit Prison of Sugar Land, Texas, where more than 100 inmates have met their end in the electric chair.

7.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S07E02 - Excalibur Nightclub
7.plot: Zak, Nick & Aaron head to Zak's hometown of Chicago, IL, for a two-location lockdown of the Excalibur Nightclub and Bachelor's Grove Cemetery. The guys are taken aback when an unseen force pushes Zak down the stairs in the club.

7.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S07E02 - Excalibur Nightclub
7.plot: Zak, Nick & Aaron head to Zak's hometown of Chicago, IL, for a two-location lockdown of the Excalibur Nightclub and Bachelor's Grove Cemetery. The guys are taken aback when an unseen force pushes Zak down the stairs in the club.

7.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S07E03 - Point Sur Lighthouse
7.plot: Zak, Nick & Aaron explore one of America's most haunted lighthouses in Point Sur, CA. The guys are amazed when they discover a mysterious figure along the coastline.

7.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S07E03 - Point Sur Lighthouse
7.plot: Zak, Nick & Aaron explore one of America's most haunted lighthouses in Point Sur, CA. The guys are amazed when they discover a mysterious figure along the coastline.

7.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S07E04 - The Palmer House
7.plot: Zak, Nick and Aaron head to the Great Lakes to explore the demonic activity overrunning the Palmer House Hotel. The investigation gets personal when a dark spirit beckons Zak and Aaron, speaking their full names.

7.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S07E04 - The Palmer House
7.plot: Zak, Nick and Aaron head to the Great Lakes to explore the demonic activity overrunning the Palmer House Hotel. The investigation gets personal when a dark spirit beckons Zak and Aaron, speaking their full names.

7.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S07E05 - Black Moon Manor
7.plot: Zak, Nick and Aaron voyage to Greenfield, Indiana in search of the source of a dark power, which has overrun the Black Moon Manor. As the temperature suddenly drops to 66.6 degrees, the guys are startled to hear a demonic voice.

7.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S07E05 - Black Moon Manor
7.plot: Zak, Nick and Aaron voyage to Greenfield, Indiana in search of the source of a dark power, which has overrun the Black Moon Manor. As the temperature suddenly drops to 66.6 degrees, the guys are startled to hear a demonic voice.

7.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S07E06 - Sedamsville Rectory
7.plot: Zak, Nick & Aaron investigate the Sedamsville Rectory in Cincinnati, OH, plagued by a violent and demonic entity. The guys bring a priest in to perform an exorcism on the house, and they witness someone being possessed.

7.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S07E06 - Sedamsville Rectory
7.plot: Zak, Nick & Aaron investigate the Sedamsville Rectory in Cincinnati, OH, plagued by a violent and demonic entity. The guys bring a priest in to perform an exorcism on the house, and they witness someone being possessed.

7.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S07E07 - Cripple Creek
7.plot: Zak, Nick & Aaron travel to the old mining town of Cripple Creek, CO to investigate two locations plagued with paranormal activity. The guys collect astounding visual evidence after implementing new 3D technology.

9.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S09E01 - "Sharon Tate Ghost/The Oman House"
9.plot: Zak, Nick, and Aaron head to Los Angeles, California to investigate the Oman House, a home riddled with paranormal activity believed to be directly linked to the Manson Murders of 1969 that killed Sharon Tate. The crew also discovers that the home was built upon Native American burial grounds.

9.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S09E02 - The Myrtles Plantation
9.plot: The GAC head to Louisiana in search of the spirits that reside at the Myrtles Plantation, one of hundreds of plantations in Louisiana from the slavery years. It is believed that there have been 10 murders at the location which is renowned to be one of the most likely places to see an apparition in the world.

9.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S09E03 - George Washington Ghost
9.plot: Zak, Nick and Aaron investigate two New York sites: A mansion rumored to be haunted by the ghost of George Washington, and a bar where security camera footage reveals glasses spontaneously flying off shelves.

9.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S09E04 - Bannack Ghost Town
9.plot: The GAC travel to Montana to investigate the Hotel Meade. While investigating, they expand the scope of their investigation to include more areas; including the crying baby houses, the saloon, the church house, and the schoolhouse.

9.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S09E05 - Fear Factory
9.plot: Zak, Nick and Aaron head to a 100-year-old cement factory that's been turned into a Halloween attraction in Salt Lake City, UT. The guys are shocked to hear that employees recite from a satanic bible, causing all sorts of aggressive and demonic paranormal activity. The location is even more eerie in the fact that it holds the address of 666.

9.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S09E06 - Heritage Junction
9.plot: GAC travel back in time to the Heritage Junction. Spirits include those of a woman seen on the second floor of the Newhall Ranch House and a young boy named Timmy who's voice was captured on an EVP calling for "Linda".

9.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S09E07 - Fort MacArthur Museum
9.plot: The guys head to San Pedro, CA, to investigate the Fort MacArthur Military Museum, the site of many claims of paranormal activity believed to be caused by UFOs. Built in 1914, this coastal defense battery was put to the test after Pearl Harbor when they fired almost 1,500 rounds of ammunition at what they believed was an air invasion.

9.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S09E08 - St. James Hotel
9.plot: GAC visit the historic St. James Hotel in Cimarron, where many famous people from the Old West, including Jesse James, Wyatt Earp and Annie Oakley, have stayed over the years. During their lockdown, the guys investigate reports of an ill-tempered spirit in Room 18, which is padlocked shut and off-limits to guests.

9.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S09E09 - Fox Hollow Farm
9.plot: GAC travel to rural Indiana for their lockdown at Fox Hollow Farm, a beautiful mansion on a farm where serial killer Herb Baumeister targeted gay men, luring them back to his pool room and killing up to 19 men by erotic asphyxiation in the mid-1990s. Although eleven of these deaths were identified on the premises, eight still remain a mystery. The guys also venture into the back woods where hundreds of the bones of his victims were found by investigators in June of 1996.

9.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S09E10 - Haunted Savannah
9.plot: Zak, Nick and Aaron travel to the historic city of Savannah for their lockdown at the haunted Sorrel Weed House, the infamous antebellum-style home built in 1839 as well as the Gribble House, where a triple-murder took place in 1909.

9.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S09E11 - Whaley House
9.plot: The guys head back to the west coast for their lockdown at the infamous Whaley House of Old Town, San Diego, one of the most haunted houses in America due to its numerous spirits haunting the home, including a ghost named "Yankee Jim".

9.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S09E12 - Overland Hotel and Saloon
9.plot: The guys visit Pioche, Nev., an 1860s silver-mining town that has maintained much of its Old West character. During their stay, they investigate the historic Overland Hotel and Saloon, and the Million Dollar Courthouse and Jail.

9.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S09E13 - Old Licking County Jail
9.plot: GAC travel to Ohio for their lockdown at the Old Licking County Jail, where multiple murders of famous criminals, inmate suicides and the deaths of four sheriffs were the norm. Also during their trip, they investigate a local paranormal investigator's nearby house who said she captured a photo of a dark shadow apparition named "Davey" who became attached to her back at the jail and then followed her home.

10.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S10E01 - Queen Mary
10.plot: In the season premiere, the investigative trio climb aboard the legendary ocean liner Queen Mary, now permanently docked in Long Beach, California, and considered to be one of the most haunted places in the world. Not long after the ship's maiden voyage in 1936, it was put into military service. Tragedy surrounded the ship - nicknamed the "Gray Ghost" - until 1967 when it dropped anchor for good and became a hotel, still in operation today. With reports of multiple apparitions and voices - including that of a former crewman and little girl - the trio prepares for a powerful investigation.

10.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S10E03 - Zozo Demon
10.plot: Zak, Nick and Aaron head to Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, to investigate a home terrorized by an ancient, demonic force. The Zozo Demon is known for attacking and possessing its victims through a spirit board.

10.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S10E04 - Island of Dolls
10.plot: Near the dark and creepy canals of Xochimilco, Mexico sits what might be the world's strangest and scariest tourist attraction: the Island of the Dolls, also home to a sinister and haunted mystery.

10.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S10E05 - Bell Witch Cave
10.plot: Zak, Aaron, Billy and Jay travel to the Bell Witch Cave in a secluded area in Adams, Tennessee, where they will investigate the notorious legend of the Bell Witch that has plagued the Bell family and other families on the nearby farmland in 1817.

10.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S10E06 - Sallie House
10.plot: Zak, Aaron, Bill and Jay travel to the Sallie House, claimed to be one of the most haunted houses in the Midwest, to investigate the claims of demonic attacks after the experiences of the Pickman family in 1992.

10.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S10E08 - Apache Junction
10.plot: Ghost Adventures crew spend the night in the ghost town of Goldfield, Arizona, which was the original Apache Junction. Zak tests new gas-detecting equipment in the mines, and Jay Wasley is utterly startled when he sees a man in a trench coat roaming through the town. The team also ventures into the cursed lands of the Superstition Mountain in order to find out any details related to the hectic mining for the Lost Dutchman's Gold Mine and its connections to Apache Junction.

10.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S10E10 - Demons in Seattle
10.plot: The Ghost Adventures Crew travels to a quiet suburb just outside of Seattle to investigate the residence of Keith Linder, who claims a demonic force is wreaking havoc throughout the tranquil, contemporary home. Linder has spent the past year documenting what appears to be extreme poltergeist activity, including mysterious demonic inscriptions written on his walls and a fire spontaneously igniting in the home. With activity of this level, Bagans and the team investigate to determine if Keith's antagonistic spirit is one of the most powerful dark forces they have yet to encounter.

10.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S10E11 - Texas Horror Hotel
10.plot: Ghost Adventures heads to Texas to investigate a horror hotel, haunted by a spirit of a little girl. Before the lockdown, the guys take a detour to verify reports of a spirit pushing parked cars onto train tracks.

11.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S11E02 - Old Montana State Prison
11.plot: The Ghost Adventures Crew visits the Old Montana State Prison in Deer Lodge, a place haunted today by a deadly 1959 prison riot. During the lockdown, the guys witness camera batteries inexplicably explode and fizzle acid.

11.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S11E03 - Manresa Castle
11.plot: The Ghost Adventures Crew sets sail to Port Townsend, Washington to investigate the claims of violent hauntings at Manresa Castle. During the lockdown, an entity mimics and torments Aaron.

11.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S11E04 - Old Lincoln County Hospital

11.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S11E05 - Haunted Harvey House

11.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S11E06 - Los Coches Adobe
11.plot: Ghost Adventures Crew travels to Soledad, California for their lockdown at the Los Coches Adobe, a former brothel where a lady in black is said to roam. The guys also investigate a local legend about Old Stage Road outside of Salinas, California to validate peoples claims of a female spirit appearing on the road, and in their car.

11.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S11E07 - Grand Canyon Caverns

11.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S11E08 - Haunted Hollywood
11.plot: Ghost Adventures Crew investigate three notorious hauntings around Hollywood, California.

11.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S11E09 - Oddfellow's Asylum
11.plot: The Ghost Adventures Crew travel outside of Kansas City to Liberty, Missouri for their lockdown inside the old Oddfellow's Asylum, the current home of the famous Belvoir Winery.

11.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S11E10 - Clown Motel and Goldfield High School
11.plot: The Ghost Adventures Crew returns to Tonopah, Nevada where Zak faces his fear of clown dolls during their lockdown at the Clown Motel. They also return to Goldfield, Nevada in order to investigate the old Goldfield High School.

11.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S11E11 - Halloween Special: Deadwood: City of Ghosts
11.plot: GAC travel to the legendary Wild West town of Deadwood, South Dakota to investigate its most haunted locations, where the spirits of cowboys and gunslingers still roam.

11.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S11E12 - Lava Hot Springs Inn
11.plot: The Ghost Adventures Crew travels to Lava Hot Springs, Idaho for their lockdown at the Lava Hot Springs Inn, where many paranormal claims have been reported for the past 27 years.

12.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S12E01 - Black Dahlia
12.plot: The GAC travels to Los Angeles to investigate the Los Feliz home where the infamous Black Dahlia murder is believed to have occurred.

12.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S12E02 - Secret Scientology Lab
12.plot: The GAC heads to the greater Los Angeles area to investigate a compound that served as a Scientology lab. They encounter disturbing energy and Jay Wasley gets mysterious burns after provoking the spirit of Scientology founder L.Ron Hubbard.

12.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S12E03 - Bracken Fern Manor & Tudor House
12.plot: The GAC head to Lake Arrowhead, California, to investigate two buildings plagued with demonic activity.

12.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S12E04 - Return to the Riviera
12.plot: Ghost Adventures returns to Riviera Hotel, once a major Vegas casino but now scheduled for demolition. The guys investigate the casino and hotel one last time, so they invite four fans to join them for the unprecedented event.

12.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S12E05 - Chinese Town of Locke
12.plot: The Ghost Adventures Crew invites Today Show correspondent Dylan Dreyer to investigate Locke, California, a ghost town formerly run by the Chinese mafia.

12.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S12E06 - Star of India
12.plot: The Ghost Adventures Crew climbs aboard the Star of India, a 150-year-old merchant ship docked in San Diego that is part of the Maritime Museum of San Diego.

12.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S12E07 - Leslie's Family Tree Restaurant
12.plot: The Ghost Adventures Crew travel to Utah for their lockdown in Leslie's Family Tree Restaurant, a family-owned eatery, part of it in a 100-year-old building that's reportedly haunted by several ghosts and poltergeist activity.

12.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S12E08 - Hell Hole Prison
12.plot: The Ghost Adventures Crew head to Yuma to investigate the Yuma Territorial Prison, which earned the name Hell Hole due to the intense heat of the location and inhumane punishments dealt to the inmates, such as locking them in the Snake Den.

12.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S12E09 - The Domes
12.plot: GAC heads to the Arizona desert for their lockdown in The Domes, a collection of massive dome-shaped buildings. These unusual structures were built in 1982 by a circuit board company for their offices, but were left abandoned and are said to be haunted by the spirits of children, Native Americans and shadow figures.

12.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S12E10 - Nevada State Prison
12.plot: Ghost Adventures heads to Carson City to investigate the Nevada State Prison.

12.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S12E12 - Stardust Ranch
12.plot: Ghost Adventures investigates extraterrestrial activity in Rainbow Valley, Arizona.

12.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S12E13 - The Haunted Museum
12.plot: The GAC investigate the Deadly Possessions Museum - a mansion that is being converted into a museum for the haunted items Zak has collected over the years.

13.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S13E01 - Colorado Gold Mine
13.plot: Ghost Adventures Crew travel to Idaho Springs to investigate the haunted Phoenix Gold Mine, where a brutal murder took place and a malevolent spirit called "Tommyknocker" is known to roam the deep tunnels.

13.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S13E02 - Mackay Mansion
13.plot: A return to Virginia City, Nev., to investigate two properties once owned by the legendary mining tycoon John Mackay. An intense lockdown for the crew is highlighted by Jay being pushed down a flight of stairs and more.

13.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S13E03 - Palace Saloon
13.plot: The GAC travel to Prescott, Arizona to investigate the Palace Saloon, one of the most lavish saloons in Arizona, to look for spirits that died in high-stakes gambling related murders.

13.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S13E04 - Reseda House of Evil
13.plot: The GAC head to Los Angeles in order to investigate a home plagued with demonic activity. During the investigation, Billy gets severely affected by a demonic presence.

13.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S13E05 - Dorothea Puente Murder House
13.plot: The GAC are called to Sacramento, California to investigate the boardhouse operated by Dorothea Puente, a prolific serial killer who killed her clients when they were in need in exchange for cash.

13.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S13E06 - Hotel Metlen
13.plot: The Ghost Adventures crew is in Dillon, Montana, investigating the historic Hotel Metlen. During his investigation, Zak learns of possession, suicide and an ominous third floor that has been forbidden to the public for over 20 years. As night falls, the crew executes a wildly active lockdown in which Aaron is trapped on the infamous third floor with horrifying results.

13.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S13E07 - St. Anne's Retreat
13.plot: The Ghost Adventures crew investigates St. Anne's Retreat, where in 1997 a group of teenagers, drawn to the property for its legends of dead nuns and hellhounds, were held hostage and terrorized by three armed security guards.

13.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S13E08 - Twin Bridges Orphanage
13.plot: Zak and the crew travel to Montana to investigate an old orphanage with a long history of cruelty and death. During the lockdown, Jay captures a light anomaly, and Zak attempts to communicate with the spirit of a little girl.

13.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S13E10 - Zalud House
13.plot: The Ghost Adventures crew investigates the historic Zalud House in Porterville, CA. Zak learns the history behind a severely haunted chair where a Zalud family member was murdered and each team member that sits in it is affected.

13.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S13E11 - Dakota's Sanatorium of Death
13.plot: The Ghost Adventures Crew visits North Dakota to investigate the San Haven Sanatorium. During the investigation, Zak almost suffers an injury, the crew encounters a slew of disturbing energies and they capture a horrifying EVP.

13.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S13E12 - De Soto Hotel and Concordia Cemetery
13.plot: The Ghost Adventures crew is in El Paso, Texas, to investigate the De Soto Hotel and Concordia Cemetery. They learn about Satanic worship in the basement of the De Soto and dig into serial killer Richard Ramirez's connection to Concordia Cemetery.

13.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S13E13 - Goatman's Bridge
13.plot: The Ghost Adventures crew is in Denton, Texas, investigating Goatman's Bridge. They learn about Satanic worship underneath the bridge and hear stories from four women who were physically attacked by a demonic entity.

14.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S14E01 - Stone Lion Inn
14.plot: The Ghost Adventures crew investigates the Stone Lion Inn in Guthrie, Oklahoma, where it is said the owner performs satanic rituals in the local cemetery.

14.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S14E02 - Freak Show Murder House
14.plot: Zak and the crew investigate the site of a 1996 double murder in Los Angeles' Chatsworth neighborhood. The guys gather chilling evidence of paranormal activity and are lured away from the location against their will.

14.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S14E03 - Samaritan Cult House
14.plot: Zak and the crew investigate an abandoned prison in Guthrie, Oklahoma, which in the 1990s served as the headquarters for the Samaritan Foundation, an organization with rumored ties to murder and terrorism.

14.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S14E04 - Double Eagle Restaurant
14.plot: Zak and the crew travel to New Mexico to investigate the Double Eagle Restaurant and the Dona Ana County Courthouse. Both buildings have been plagued by death, leading to poltergeist activity that torments investigators.

14.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S14E05 - Silent Movie Theatre
14.plot: Zak and the crew arrive in sunny Los Angeles to investigate the infamous Silent Movie Theatre. Zak delves deep into a famous murder, learns of the strange death of a beloved savior of silent films and even contacts a deceased movie star.

14.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S14E06 - Exorcism in Erie
14.plot: Zak and the crew travel to Erie, Colorado, along with Bishop Bryan Ouellette to perform an exorcism on a young man in order to help rid him of a demonic attachment he obtained after trying to conjure an entity years ago.

14.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S14E07 - Skinwalker Canyon
14.plot: Zak and the crew are given special permission from the Navajo Nation to investigate Skinwalker Canyon, a place where many residents refuse to enter in fear of encountering shape-shifting creatures.

14.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S14E08 - Upper Fruitland Curse
14.plot: Zak Bagans and his crew head to Upper Fruitland, New Mexico, to help a family who are troubled by the ghost of a faceless young boy. During the intense lock down inside the Navajo Nation, the guys capture a chair moving on its own.

14.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S14E09 - Witches in Magna
14.plot: Zak and the crew investigate a family-owned pizzeria in Magna, Utah, where an evil witch has cast a spell that has the family fearing for their safety. During the lockdown, the guys try to draw out what's in the basement and get some violent responses.

14.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S14E10 - The Viper Room
14.plot: Zak and the crew investigate the infamous Viper Room on West Hollywood's Sunset Strip. With a famous owner, the tragic death of a beloved actor and the unsolved disappearance of a business partner, the nightclub is filled with sinister energy.

14.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S14E11 - Asylum 49
14.plot: Zak and the crew return to Tooele, Utah, to investigate a recently abandoned nursing home that shares the same building with a haunted attraction that was in operation during their original investigation of Tooele Hospital in 2011.

15.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S15E01 - Golden Ghost Town
15.plot: The crew travels to a sinister ghost town near Wolf Creek, Oregon. During the investigation, Zak is overtaken by an aggressive entity, Aaron is incapacitated by a dark force, eerie figures appear and a voice warns of a demonic presence.

15.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S15E02 - Ogden Possession
15.plot: The crew travels to a home in Ogden, Utah (adjacent to a graveyard) to help a family plagued by serious possessions and the presence of a red-headed entity. A cleric is brought in to attempt an exorcism.

15.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S15E03 - Albion Normal School
15.plot: Zak and the crew head to Idaho to investigate the Albion State Normal School, where dark energy from satanic graffiti is affecting its staff. During the lockdown, Jay and others are aggressively marked with strange symbols behind their ears.

15.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S15E04 - Museum of the Mountain West
15.plot: Zak and the crew head to a Colorado museum where something is threatening the health of its employees. During the investigation, they uncover the property's violent history and gather disturbing evidence of a dangerous entity.

15.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S15E05 - Pythian Castle
15.plot: The crew travels to Missouri to investigate the ominous Pythian Castle. Once plagued by torture and suicide, this historic building is infected with violent spirits who seem to mimic the living and deliver fatal premonitions.

15.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S15E06 - The Titanic Museum
15.plot: GAC investigate the massive Titanic Museum in Branson, Missouri where employees believe the spirits of the 1,496 people who lost their lives on board the Titanic on April 14, 1912, have found their way to the museum dedicated to their memory.

15.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S15E08 - Eureka Mining Town
15.plot: Zak and the crew travel to the small mining town of Eureka, Nevada, to investigate reports of an aggressive spirit at a hotel as well as a mysterious underground tunnel system built by oppressed Chinese laborers.

15.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S15E09 - Sin City Exorcism
15.plot: Zak and the crew travel to Las Vegas to help a family plagued by a demonic force in their home. The man and his siblings believe the entity attached itself to their mother and caused her death.

15.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S15E10 - Phelps Dodge Hospital
15.plot: The crew investigates an abandoned Arizona hospital where the caretaker is being choked by a dark presence. A strange conflict arises between Zak and Aaron after objects are thrown at the guys and a violent threat is captured on EVP.

15.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S15E11 - The Slaughter House
15.plot: The crew travels to Arizona to investigate The Slaughter House, a meatpacking plant-turned haunted attraction. Rapper Post Malone joins the lockdown and Zak is affected by dark energy, leading to a marathon of paranormal activity.

16.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S16E01 - Hotel Léger
16.plot: Zak and the crew head to Hollywood, CA, to investigate the iconic Ripley's Believe It or Not museum, where employees claim to be adversely affected by its rare artifacts.

16.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S16E08 - Graveyard of the Pacific: Norblad Hostel
16.plot: Zak and the crew continue their investigation of the Graveyard of the Pacific in Astoria, Oregon, where they encounter a very dangerous and very unholy presence in the basement of a historic hotel.

16.plot: Zak and the crew continue their investigation of the Graveyard of the Pacific at a former military installation near Astoria, Oregon, that's haunted by a tragic past and home to an aggressive entity.

17.plot: Ghost Adventures Live takes over Zak’s Las Vegas Haunted Museum for a four-hour live event with special guests and spooky surprises.

17.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S17E02 - Idaho State Reform School
17.plot: Zak and the crew travel to St. Anthony, ID, to investigate a former school with a dark history of suicide and death. The guys capture paranormal activity that proves the children who lost their lives are still trapped on the grounds.

17.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S17E03 - Westerfield House
17.plot: Zak and the crew head to San Francisco to investigate the historic Westerfeld House, which played host to satanic rituals performed by underground occultist filmmaker Kenneth Anger and Church of Satan founder Anton LaVey.

17.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S17E04 - Crisis in Oakdale
17.plot: The crew lands in Oakdale, CA, to investigate a sinister energy darkening the home of a grieving family. During the emotionally charged and frightening lockdown, Billy and Aaron are mysteriously debilitated and Jay witnesses a door open by itself.

17.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S17E05 - Tintic Mining District
17.plot: Zak and the crew head to a former mining camp in Eureka, Utah, to investigate several haunted buildings. A special guest investigator joins the team for the terrifying lockdown in which an unprecedented piece of evidence horrifies everyone.

17.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S17E06 - Ghosts of the Old West

18.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S18E01 - Gates of Hell House
18.plot: The crew investigates paranormal activity at a Vegas haunted attraction.

18.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S18E02 - Palomino Club
18.plot: Zak and the crew investigate dark energy at a Las Vegas gentlemen's club.

18.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S18E03 - Lutes Casino
18.plot: The crew investigates a former casino with a shady past in Yuma, AZ.

18.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S18E04 - Melrose Hotel
18.plot: The crew investigates a historic hotel plagued by dark spirits in Colorado.

18.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S18E05 - Binion's Hotel and Casino
18.plot: The crew investigates two hotels inside an infamous Las Vegas casino.

18.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S18E06 - The Woodbury
18.plot: The crew investigates aggressive spirit activity at a California estate.

18.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S18E07 - Crescent Hotel
18.plot: The crew investigates a historic hotel plagued by restless spirits in Eureka Springs, AR. They capture a curtain moving on its own and make contact with Michael, the hotel's most active and notorious ghost.

18.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S18E08 - St. Ignatius Hospital
18.plot: Zak and the crew stick together as they investigate a 127-year-old hospital in Colfax, WA. The building may be abandoned, but it's far from quiet with reports of visitors hearing strange growls and being attacked by unseen hands.

18.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S18E09 - Mount Wilson Ranch
18.plot: Zak and the crew land outside of Pioche, Nevada, to investigate a mysterious ranch known for its concentration of supernatural energy and countless reports of extraterrestrial activity.

18.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S18E10 - Panic in Amarillo
18.plot: Zak and the crew rush to a private home in Amarillo, TX, where a family is reaching its breaking point with an aggressive entity. It's the guys' most complex and challenging investigation yet as they search for the truth.

18.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S18E11 - Union Hotel
18.plot: Zak and the crew travel to the Bay Area to investigate aggressive paranormal activity at a historic hotel that has endured the brutal California Gold Rush, a smallpox epidemic and a period as a seedy flophouse.

18.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S18E12 - Idaho State Tuberculosis Hospital
18.plot: Zak and the crew investigate a former tuberculosis hospital in Gooding, Idaho, that's been converted into an inn. The owners and their staff have been terrorized by whispering voices, ghostly children and the spirit of an angry old man.

18.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S18E13 - A Haunting in Scottsdale
18.plot: Zak and the crew investigate an Arizona home sitting on land once occupied by a Native American tribe. The owner claims he's been affected by a dark, aggressive energy and believes an ancient entity is haunting his property.

19.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S19E01 - Curse of the Harrisville Farm House
19.plot: Zak and the crew travel to Rhode Island investigate the site of one of America's most-iconic paranormal cases -- the Perron family haunting. The 300-year-old farmhouse has stood the test of time, but so too has the dark entity that roams the property.

19.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S19E02 - Albion Castle
19.plot: Zak and the crew are in San Francisco investigating a mysterious castle built on top of sacred caverns said to be a haunted by a female apparition. The current owners claim to be plagued by paranormal activity in almost every corner of the property.

19.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S19E03 - Cerro Gordo Ghost Town
19.plot: Zak and the crew investigate a former mining town sitting atop a mountain.

20.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S20E01 - Horror in Biggs
20.plot: The crew investigates a demonic entity terrorizing a small California town.

20.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S20E02 - Franklin Castle
20.plot: Zak and the crew investigate the most-haunted residence in Ohio.

20.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S20E03 - Union Brewery of Death
20.plot: The crew is back in Virginia City, NV, to investigate a haunted brewery.

20.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S20E04 - Nightmare in Antelope
20.plot: Zak and the crew travel to the Antelope Valley in Sacramento, California, to confront a demonic entity that's tearing a family apart. Zak believes an exorcism may be the only way to save them from the dark and powerful forces plaguing their home.

20.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S20E05 - Goodwin Home Invasion
20.plot: Aaron's father, Don, calls Zak and the crew to his Las Vegas home to investigate threatening paranormal activity. The terrifying apparition of a little girl and a dark, powerful presence a neighbor believes is a witch has left Don scared for his life.

20.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S20E06 - Haunted Hollow Forest
20.plot: Zak and the crew investigate reports of a mysterious gray entity haunting an ancient plot of land in West Haven, Utah. They uncover compelling evidence that suggests the paranormal creature originated with a shaman's curse.

20.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S20E07 - The Chinatown Poltergeist
20.plot: Zak and the crew investigate claims of poltergeist activity at a Las Vegas tiki bar. The staff believes a horrendous shooting on the property in 1995 may be responsible for recent sightings of moving objects, flying shadow figures and a ghost girl.

20.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S20E08 - Beneath the Bonanza
20.plot: A saloon in Virginia City, Nev., where staff are being violently attacked by an entity that inhabits the basement; a haunted artifact known as the Suicide Table may be responsible for the aggressive activity.

21.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S21E01 - Ghost Train of Ely
21.plot: The crew investigates the dark history of the Nevada Northern Railway.

21.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S21E02 - El Rancho Hotel
21.plot: The crew investigates a dark wave of energy at a historic New Mexico hotel.

21.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S21E03 - Painted Lady Brothel
21.plot: The crew investigates a former brothel inhabited by a vicious entity.

21.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S21E04 - The Comedy Store
21.plot: Zak and the crew stir up spirits at an iconic comedy club in LA.

21.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S21E06 - Curse of Ranch Island
21.plot: Zak Bagans and the crew investigate rampant paranormal activity at a once blissful communal compound outside of Las Vegas, known as Ranch Island. When Bagans is overcome by a dark energy, the team fears he may be in danger from a spirit trapped on the property.

21.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S21E07 - Disturbed in Wickenburg
21.plot: The crew returns to Vulture City, Arizona, to investigate after attendees of a paranormal conference were negatively affected by a dark energy in the once booming mining town. Zak Bagans learns that active mining on the site may have unleashed an ancient evil.

21.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S21E08 - The Joshua Tree Inn
21.plot: Zak Bagans and the crew check into the desert motel where country-rock pioneer Gram Parsons died in 1973. With help from special guest investigator, singer and social media personality Loren Gray, the team is in for an especially emotional and terrifying night as they investigate the intelligent and sometimes malicious paranormal energy that permeates the property.

21.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S21E09 - Mayhem in Millville
21.plot: Zak Bagans and the crew investigate a Utah home owned by a descendent of the prominent Jessop polygamist family. Tenants fear evil has taken up residence in the basement, putting the guys in serious danger.

21.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S21E10 - Benson Grist Mill
21.plot: Zak Bagans and the crew travel to Utah to investigate a 150-year-old grist mill haunted by shadow figures, poltergeist activity and an angry male presence. The guys are overwhelmed by the property’s dark energy as they attempt to contact a dead girl named Alice.

21.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S21E11 - Lost Souls of the Berkeley
21.plot: Zak Bagans and the crew board a steam ferry from the 1800s to investigate escalating paranormal activity. The staff fears something dark has awakened on the historical vessel after lying dormant for months during the COVID-19 pandemic.

22.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S22E01 - The Great Saltair Curse
22.plot: Zak and the crew investigate rumours of a cursed music venue on the banks of Utah's Great Salt Lake. The location has been plagued by disaster and death.

22.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S22E02 - Terror at the Toy Shop
22.plot: Zak and the crew encounter some of the most incredible poltergeist activity they have ever experienced at a toy and costume shop in Hollywood, California.

22.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S22E03 - Haunting In The Hills
22.plot: The Ghost Adventures crew investigate the Hollywood Hills home of model and television personality Holly Madison. She is experiencing disturbing paranormal activity, including demonic growls, and suspects that whatever haunts the property is preying on her fear.

22.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S22E04 - Territorial Enterprise
22.plot: Zak Bagans and the team open a terrifying new chapter in Virginia City, Nevada, a haunted town that’s kept the crew coming back again and again. This time, they are focusing on two places in town, the Territory Enterprise Building and the Knights of Pythias building. Locals suspect the town’s connection to a secret society may have opened a portal to the netherworld.

22.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S22E05 - Emergency in Elk Grove
22.plot: The crew is called to Elk Grove, California, to help a grieving woman who believes she is being terrorized by a demon and fears for her safety. The case takes an even more twisted turn when she reveals that the dark presence haunting her may be responsible for her father’s death.

22.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S22E06 - Carbon County Chaos
22.plot: When the small town of Helper, Utah, is under siege by dark forces, the mayor calls on the Ghost Adventures crew for help. She suspects that recent renovations to two historic buildings may be behind the surge in paranormal activity.

22.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S22E07 - Montecito Mansion of Mystery
22.plot: Zak Bagans senses a historic mansion with a tragic and mysterious past in Montecito, California, has called to him. When the crew attempts to re-create a séance in the home's majestic main hall, they capture some of their most compelling evidence to date.

22.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S22E08 - Mountain Oaks Mayhem
22.plot: Zak Bagans and the Ghost Adventures team gather in La Crescenta, California, to investigate an abandoned home that has been infected with evil. The dark forces that dwell there tore a family apart, and anyone who dares step inside the house is left fearing for their life.

22.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S22E09 - Pacific Grove Nightmare
22.plot: The Ghost Adventures team arrive in Pacific Grove, California, to investigate a doll shop overwhelmed by dark energy. Shelves of dolls and puppets appear to offer up disturbing clues as the search for evidence leaves the team drained and disoriented.

22.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S22E10 - Whitmore Mansion
22.plot: Zak Bagans and the crew investigate a Utah mansion soaked in tragedy and bloodshed. Unexplained paranormal activity has the new owner desperate for answers, and the team is concerned that a portal to hell has unleashed a negative entity into the home.

22.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S22E11 - Panic on Pine Street
22.plot: The team investigates poltergeist activity at a historic saloon in Paso Roble, California. The activity is so relentless that staff and guests don't feel safe on the premises. Zak Bagans suspects it may be the sole work of an entity called "The Old Hag."

22.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S22E12 - LA Police Station Invasion
22.plot: The crew is called to the Los Angeles Police Museum to confront a dark presence that has invaded the once-thriving precinct. Zak Bagans believes the disturbing activity is linked to the macabre artifacts from some of LA's most notorious crimes.

22.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S22E13 - Petrified in Pahrump
22.plot: The Ghost Adventures crew are called to a desolate Nevada town to investigate a winery allegedly built atop sacred burial grounds. Fatal accidents plague the property, and the terrified staff is stalked by an evil presence. Can Zak Bagans get to the bottom of the deadly curse?

22.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S22E14 - Steinbeck House Haunting
22.plot: Zak Bagans, Aaron Goodwin, Billy Tolley and Jay Wasley travel to Salinas, California, to investigate the birthplace of iconic author John Steinbeck. For decades, witnesses, including Steinbeck himself, have felt a dark presence in the home. Could a portal be drawing spirits to the property?

23.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S23E01 - Hotel Barclay
23.plot: Zak and the crew return to LA's Skid Row district to investigate a nearly abandoned building steeped in a dark, grisly history that rivals the Hotel Cecil; the guys have their hands full as both the dead and the living push back on the investigation.

23.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S23E02 - Lockdown in Lancaster
23.plot: The crew pierces the seal on California's Mira Loma Detention Center; decades of death, violence and bloodshed have scarred this massive compound, painting a thick layer of doom on every square inch and delivering some of the most solid evidence yet.

23.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S23E03 - Fear in Flagstaff
23.plot: Zak and the crew check in for a night of terror at a Flagstaff, Arizona, hotel where guests and staff have reported troubling paranormal experiences for decades. The chaotic spirits trapped within are wreaking havoc, and the GAC may be the only ones who can help.

23.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S23E04 - Stow House Haunting
23.plot: Echoes of a past investigation come into focus as Zak and the crew investigate a stately California ranch steeped in tragedy. A dark energy has taken root on the land, and the team must unravel its haunting secrets to help the terrified caretakers.

23.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S23E05 - Mentryville Ghost Town
23.plot: Zak and the crew venture to California's first oil boomtown to investigate countless reports of ghostly activity inside its buildings and glowing anomalies in the surrounding hills. Paranormal chaos ensues as the guys attempt to unravel the mystery of Mentryville.

23.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S23E06 - Hotel San Carlos
23.plot: Zak and the crew peel back the glamorous façade of a Phoenix, Arizona, hotel to expose a darkness that's said to drive people mad. As they explore the vacant rooms and halls, the team encounters a demonic presence that could be responsible for countless deaths on the property.

23.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S23E07 - King Gillette Ranch
23.plot: Zak and the crew visit King Gillette Ranch, a sprawling compound built on sacred land. Its dark history plus a brush with a religious cult has birthed violent spirit activity that drains the living of their energy, making this the GAC's heaviest investigation yet.

23.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S23E08 - Abandoned in Elko
23.plot: The crew awaken hostile spirits in Nevada when they investigate the Commercial Hotel and Casino; the building's rough history of lawless cowboys, cutthroat gamblers and exploited women fuels a malevolent energy.

23.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S23E09 - Village of Lost Souls
23.plot: The crew investigates reports of vicious paranormal attacks at LA's Heritage Square Museum; as the team explores this collection of Victorian homes, they suspect a dark portal is responsible for shadow figure sightings and poltergeist activity.

24.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S24E01 - Sutro Ghost Town
24.plot: Zak and the crew delve into the darkness that surrounds the historic and very haunted town of Sutro, Nevada. The team suspects an old mining tunnel is fueling the abandoned settlement's ominous aura as they uncover numerous deaths, disasters and mysterious fires.

24.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S24E02 - Ghost Island
24.plot: Zak and the crew brave a brutal winter blizzard to confront an aggressive presence at an abandoned ranch located off the coast of Utah's Great Salt Lake. Unmarked graves and whispers of a curse throw a shadow over the investigation as the guys seek out the dark, unseeable force.

24.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S24E03 - Scotty's Castle
24.plot: Zak and the crew trek through California's Death Valley to investigate a sprawling complex shrouded in mystery. The guys find themselves captivated by the desert villa's dark, powerful energy as they explore its flood- and fire-ravaged grounds. Who or what is feeding this ominous aura?

24.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S24E04 - Orcutt Ranch
24.plot: Zak and the crew suspect evil forces are afoot as they investigate a California estate haunted by rumors of secret rituals in the basement and a gruesome double homicide next door. The team treads on very dark grounds as they attempt to unravel the mystery.

24.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S24E05 - Nightmare in Northridge
24.plot: Zak and the crew don their spiritual armor to battle a dark, invasive energy in a California home. Fearing a demonic attachment, the team calls in an exorcist to help dissipate the evil cloud that overshadows the deeply religious family who lives there.

25.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S25E01 - Skinwalker Invasion
25.plot: Zak and the crew tread upon sacred ground when they investigate reports of skinwalker sightings in the remote town of Torrey, Utah. Was the invasion triggered by the desecration of Native American artifacts, or has a past investigation come back to haunt the team? Zak and the crew also investigate the Chuckwagon Inn and General Store and find themselves caught in a battle between an ancient energy and the dark spirits that haunt the building.

25.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S25E02 - Terror on 25th Street
25.plot: Zak and the crew head to historic Ogden, Utah, to explore two adjacent buildings that are overrun with dark spiritual activity. One of the buildings once housed a thriving brothel, and locals suspect its former madam is still running her business from the grave.

25.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S25E03 - LA Hospital of Horror
25.plot: Zak and the crew gain unprecedented access to a historic Los Angeles hospital to expose a demonic energy that has trapped countless souls inside the massive facility. This malevolent presence is a force to be reckoned with as the team explores the abandoned halls.

25.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S25E04 - Hotel Congress
25.plot: Zak and the crew check in for a night of terror at an infamous Tucson, Arizona, hotel plagued by poltergeist activity and spirit possession. Could a brush with one of America's most violent gangsters be responsible for the darkness that inhabits the building?

25.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S25E05 - Belmont Ghost Town
25.plot: Zak and the crew trek through the Nevada desert to locate a former Wild West town haunted by a grave injustice. The guys are shaken when they discover that the Manson family camped out in the courthouse of the crumbling town.

26.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S26E01 - Poltergeist House Curse
26.plot: Bagans and the crew dig deep into the mystery of the famed Poltergeist House, launching an unprecedented investigation inside the site of the classic horror film location to uncover the truth behind a rumored curse. Did real-life events converge with Poltergeist's fictional storyline to unlock a lethal, ancient darkness? After the team's lockdown leaves them with more questions than answers, Bagans believes a terrifying relic from the 1982 film could provide insight into the sinister energy that haunts the suburban California home.

26.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S26E02 - The Houdini Seance
26.plot: One the 100th anniversary of Harry Houdini's midnight visit to the fabled Winchester Mystery House, Zak and a team of paranormal experts attempt to summon the legendary magician's spirit. Will escaping death's grip be Houdini's greatest trick?

26.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S26E03 - Glen Tavern Tragedy
26.plot: Zak and the crew return to the Glen Tavern Inn in Santa Paula, Calif., to help its staff find closure after the loss of a local medium; Korn singer Jonathan Davis assists as the team digs deeper into the dark mysteries of the former gambling house.

26.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S26E04 - Abandoned at Whiskey Pete's
26.plot: Zak and the crew find themselves in an eerie Nevada desert town to investigate a recently shuttered casino haunted by the spirit of a notorious bootlegger. The air is thick with tension as the team and comedian Matt Rife confront the dark energy that lurks around every corner of the abandoned building.

26.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S26E05 - Mystery of Rispin Mansion
26.plot: Zak and the crew gain unprecedented access to the cursed Rispin Mansion in Capitola, California. Sealed shut after a violent paranormal event in 2012, the abandoned home has become a vault of concentrated evil, waiting for an opportunity to explode.

26.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S26E06 - Living Dead on La Brea
26.plot: Zak investigates a former girl's school in Hollywood, Calif., after a gardener discovers bones in a shallow grave; could the remains be connected to sightings of a ghostly girl? Or is something more malevolent at play.

26.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S26E07 - Midnight at the Museum
26.plot: Unsettling paranormal events near an exhibit of serial killer Samuel Little prompt Zak to investigate his own Las Vegas museum; are the events connected to Little's recently acquired remains, and could the lockdown reveal clues to his murders?

meta.plot: L'enquêteur paranormal Zak Bagans et son équipe, Nick Groff, Aaron Goodwin, Billy Tolley et Jay Wasley, recherchent des lieux hantés au niveau national et international. Au cours de leur enquête, Zak et son équipe se familiarisent avec la région, interrogent les habitants sur les lieux hantés et rencontrent les mauvais esprits qui hanteraient ces lieux.

Deniz a tout ce qu'une femme peut demander. Mais quand son mari n'a disparu aucune trace, cette vie heureuse change. Deniz, qui est dans un état désespéré avec ses deux enfants et son père, rencontre Mirat qui sera une amante et une bouée de sauvetage.
