meta.plot: Dans cette série d'anthologies policières, les téléspectateurs découvrent comment une personne ordinaire s'est retrouvée prise dans une situation extraordinaire, révélant finalement comment un mauvais virage en entraîne un autre, jusqu'à ce qu'il soit trop tard pour revenir en arrière. Raconté du point de vue de l'accusé, chaque épisode s'ouvre dans une salle d'audience sur l'accusé sans connaître son crime ni comment il s'est retrouvé en procès.

1.title: FR - Accused (2023) - S01E01 - Scott's Story
1.plot: A father confronts the limits of unconditional love when he comes to believe his teenage son may be planning an unimaginable crime.

1.title: FR - Accused (2023) - S01E02 - Ava's Story
1.plot: After a married couple discovers their newborn is Deaf, they elect to try a surgical procedure. But when their surrogate - who also happens to be Deaf - learns the news, she feels she has no choice but to intervene.

1.title: FR - Accused (2023) - S01E03 - Danny's Story
1.plot: After the death of his ailing mother, a teenager suspects foul play when he discovers his mother's former hospice caretaker is now dating his father.

1.title: FR - Accused (2023) - S01E04 - Kendall's Story
1.plot: When a man learns his daughter was assaulted, his friends encourage him to take justice into his own hands.

1.title: FR - Accused (2023) - S01E05 - Robyn's Story
1.plot: As a man, Kevin is shy and mild-mannered; onstage, she's Robyn Banks, a fierce drag queen who's all confidence and charisma. But when Kevin falls for a closeted guy secretly living a double life, their whirlwind affair leads to devastating consequences.

1.title: FR - Accused (2023) - S01E06 - Naataanii's Story
1.plot: After a group of Navajo friends are arrested for protesting the local Uranium mine, they come up with a plan to try and shut it down for good.

1.title: FR - Accused (2023) - S01E07 - Brenda's Story
1.plot: When an acerbic female stand-up comic is assaulted by a fellow comic, she uses her platform to try the case in the court of public opinion.

1.title: FR - Accused (2023) - S01E08 - Laura's Story
1.plot: A grieving mother learns that facts and evidence are no match for viral misinformation, when she discovers a growing online conspiracy.

1.title: FR - Accused (2023) - S01E09 - Jack's Story
1.plot: A high school teacher puts his reputation in jeopardy when he helps a student in need.

1.title: FR - Accused (2023) - S01E10 - Esme's Story
1.plot: After a white nationalist plows his car into a peaceful demonstration and gets away, a survivor takes justice into her own hands.

1.title: FR - Accused (2023) - S01E11 - Jiro's Story
1.plot: Jiro's mother has taken care of his brother Sam ever since the car accident that left Sam with a traumatic brain injury. But when their mother dies, and it appears that Sam is being abused in his new group home, Jiro has to decide which is more important - his brother, or his freedom.

1.title: FR - Accused (2023) - S01E12 - Morgan's Story
1.plot: A teacher going through a messy divorce gets arrested under suspicious circumstances.

1.title: FR - Accused (2023) - S01E13 - Samir's Story
1.plot: A limo driver's infatuation with one of his riders leads him down a dark path.

1.title: FR - Accused (2023) - S01E14 - Jessie's Story
1.plot: When all her attempts to discover the identity of her biological father hit roadblocks, a teenager takes extreme measures to uncover the truth.

1.title: FR - Accused (2023) - S01E15 - Billy's Story
1.plot: An aging rockstar attempts to cement his musical legacy, while trying to prevent his troubled son from unraveling.

2.title: FR - Accused (2023) - S02E01 - Lorraine's Story
2.plot: A psychic medium attempts to help a couple desperately looking for their missing son.

2.title: FR - Accused (2023) - S02E02 - April's Story
2.plot: A nurse who let her anger get the best of her is put on trial after a road rage incident.

2.title: FR - Accused (2023) - S02E03 - Marcus' Story
2.plot: A successful tech entrepreneur finds himself on trial after creating facial recognition software that leads to devastating consequences.

2.title: FR - Accused (2023) - S02E04 - Justin's Story
2.plot: A wrestling coach is on trial after pushing his star athlete too far.

2.title: FR - Accused (2023) - S02E05 - Margot's Story
2.plot: A widow taking dance lessons with her two best friends gets mixed up in the instructor's shady dealings.

2.title: FR - Accused (2023) - S02E06 - Val's Story
2.plot: A divorced mom (Cobie Smulders) is put on trial after an incident with her abusive ex-husband.

2.title: FR - Accused (2023) - S02E07 - Eugene's Story
2.plot: A jewelry store owner is put on trial after interfering with his wife's dicey past.

2.title: FR - Accused (2023) - S02E08 - Megan's Story
2.plot: An ambitious music executive faces hardship when a futuristic sex robot comes between her and her husband.

meta.plot: Go inside Canelo Álvarez and Terence Crawford's training camps and personal lives as they prepare for their once in a lifetime super middleweight matchup.

1.title: EN - Countdown: Canelo vs. Crawford [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Canelo and Crawford spend time with their families, trainers and teams and reflect on their rise from promising beginners to boxing elites.

1.title: EN - Countdown: Canelo vs. Crawford [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: In the thin air of the Sierra Nevada Mountains, Canelo begins camp. Crawford fine-tunes his mental fortitude and puts on pounds with precision.

meta.plot: Victims of romance scams try to reclaim their lives with help from "The Tinder Swindler" target Cecilie Fjellhøy and private investigator Brianne Joseph.

1.title: EN - Love Con Revenge [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E01 - The Selfie Scammer
1.plot: In Nashville, Cecilie and Brianne help newly single Jill, who lent her life's savings to a charismatic wellness guru who took her money and vanished.

1.title: EN - Love Con Revenge [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E02 - Fallen Soldier
1.plot: A secret recording blows Jill's case wide open. Cecilie and Brianne aid a woman whose army veteran boyfriend defrauded her out of nearly $50,000.

1.title: EN - Love Con Revenge [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E03 - A Fraudster in the Family
1.plot: Cecilie and Brianne help a Florida woman facing a $2M debt and embroiled in a dangerous web of deceit after her husband's true identity is revealed.

1.title: EN - Love Con Revenge [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E04 - Geek Girl Con
1.plot: Cecilie and Brianne assist Shareza's daughters in confronting Dorian. Later, they accept a rare appeal for help from a man taken in by a romance scam.

1.title: EN - Love Con Revenge [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E05 - Major League Scammer
1.plot: Brianne asks the FBI about reopening Aaron's case. Then, she and Cecilie race to stop a former athlete hoping to score big on a woman's money.

1.title: EN - Love Con Revenge [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E06 - Fraud Fighters
1.plot: Cecilie learns that Lindsay isn't Chris' only victim, and a harrowing chase begins when Brianne uncovers the truth about the fraudster's credentials.

meta.plot: Dans un univers de méchants et de victimes, trois arnaqueurs luttent contre la cupidité avec style. Ils volent les personnes malfaisantes. Et si le crime devenait un jeu, et la justice une astuce ? Bienvenue dans le monde de la Reine de l’Arnaque. Avec Yi-rang, la charmante meneuse, James, le vétéran et Gu-ho. N’oubliez pas : ne vous fiez pas à ce que vous voyez, ou vous vous ferez arnaquer.

1.title: FR - La Reine de l'Arnaque - S01E01 - Speed Dial 0
1.plot: Yi-rang, James, and Gu-ho take down another villain. Out of nowhere, Gu-ho announces he's leaving the con game and walking away from the team.

meta.plot: Des trois victoires au Super Bowl à une série de controverses, cette série documentaire retrace l'histoire mouvementée de la dynastie des Dallas Cowboys dans les années 90.

1.title: FR - America's Team : Une affaire de Cowboys - S01E01 - Saturday Night Massacre
1.plot: Saddled with debt, Jerry Jones takes a gamble on an oil well. When it pays off, he buys the Cowboys — and stuns fans by firing a beloved coach.

1.title: FR - America's Team : Une affaire de Cowboys - S01E02 - Aikmania
1.plot: As Dallas pins their hopes on quarterback Troy Aikman, Jones earns jeers for an unpopular trade. Still, he has an ace up his sleeve: Emmitt Smith.

1.title: FR - America's Team : Une affaire de Cowboys - S01E03 - How 'Bout Them Cowboys?
1.plot: The Cowboys take aim at the San Francisco 49ers, toppling an NFL dynasty. Jones and coach Jimmy Johnson remember their days playing together in college.

1.title: FR - America's Team : Une affaire de Cowboys - S01E04 - Back 2 Back
1.plot: Back-to-back Super Bowl wins elevate the Cowboys to pop culture icons. Cracks form in the relationship between owner and coach, and a snub sparks ire.

1.title: FR - America's Team : Une affaire de Cowboys - S01E05 - The Shootout at Valley Ranch
1.plot: Better team, bigger egos. As Jones and Johnson butt heads, the Cowboys eye a three-peat and welcome a controversial new coach.

1.title: FR - America's Team : Une affaire de Cowboys - S01E06 - Prime Time
1.plot: The arrival of Deion Sanders adds sparkle to the Cowboys' star — and draws scrutiny from the NFL about Jones' use of cash and rogue marketing tactics.

1.title: FR - America's Team : Une affaire de Cowboys - S01E07 - Cocaine Cowboy
1.plot: The dynasty enters a downward spiral when Michael Irvin's legal woes make headlines. As the team's image slips and injuries mount, key players exit.

1.title: FR - America's Team : Une affaire de Cowboys - S01E08 - Jerry's World
1.plot: Nearly three decades after the Cowboys' last Super Bowl, Jones extends an olive branch to Johnson and looks back on his legacy.

1.title: FR - Lagos Police Criminelle - S01E01 - Episode 1

meta.plot: Face à une menace terroriste grandissante à Lagos, une unité spéciale de la police criminelle haute en couleur est reformée pour neutraliser les ennemis de l'Etat.

1.title: FR - The Defects [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Eye Shopping
1.plot: Ahyeon and the children, who live as if they were dead after being abandoned, repeat harsh training to protect themselves. Taesik, who has been rescuing children without the organization knowing, makes a decision to save the new 'recall' target.

1.title: FR - The Defects [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Quality Dissatisfaction
1.plot: Ah-hyun and the kids try to run away as Tae-sik has planned for them. However, Jung-hyun, who had been keeping an eye on them, picks up their trail, putting them in danger. As the truth behind the brutal "refund" system comes to light, the kids vow to take revenge on the adults. Their first target is So-mi's adoptive parents.

1.title: FR - The Defects [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Survivors
1.plot: After being disowned by their adoptive parents, Ah-hyun and the kids live as if they are dead. They endure brutal training, determined to protect themselves. Meanwhile, Tae-sik, who has been secretly rescuing children from the malicious organization, makes a bold decision to save a new "refund" target.

1.title: FR - The Defects [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Mom
1.plot: To put an end to the inhuman adoption and refund system, Ah-hyun and the kids set out on a daring mission to confront the head of the evil organization. With fierce determination and a carefully crafted plan, they infiltrate the organization's bunker to strike from within. But once inside, Ah-hyun uncovers a devastating truth behind the system.

1.title: FR - The Defects [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - Useful Child
1.plot: The kids risk their lives to save their guardian, Ah-hyun. To do so, they're in desperate need big money, forcing them to confront Ju-an's adoptive father. Their plan is to steal offerings from his church. Meanwhile, Se-hee's ambition to seize even greater power pushes her toward devastating choices that could change the world.

1.title: FR - The Defects [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - Real Name
1.plot: Framed for murder, Ah-hyun and the kids turn to the only adult they trust, Detective Choi. Meanwhile, the unexpected and unwanted return of of Seok-su, the adoptive son who was believed to be dead, throws Kwon Kang-man into a crisis, leading him to seek ways to put an end to the adoption on his own.

1.title: FR - The Defects [VOSTFR] - S01E07 - D-Day
1.plot: The kids barely make it out alive from the fire, but with a tragic loss. Fueled by grief and rage, they vow revenge against the monster once more. Meanwhile, Kim Se-hee sets her sights on a refund project that is far more massive, ruthless, and shocking than Ah-hyun and the kids could have ever imagined.

1.title: FR - The Defects [VOSTFR] - S01E08 - Final Refund
1.plot: What begins as a camping trip soon turns into a living nightmare. Kim Se-hee's inhumanity reaches its peak as she executes her plan to massacre the "defects." To stop her once and for all, Ah-hyun and the kids rise up against her and her team, risking their lives for all the lives to avenge the ones already lost and protect those who could be next.

meta.plot: Un groupe de finissants du secondaire qui forment un groupe dans l'espoir d'échapper à l'avenir monotone qui s'offre à eux. Alors qu'ils poursuivent le succès et leur rêve presque impossible au cours d'un été, ils tombent amoureux et rencontrent des problèmes en chemin.

1.title: FR - The Runarounds - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Charlie Cooper and his friends form a new band called The Runarounds right after high school graduation.

1.title: FR - The Runarounds - S01E02 - Morning Glory
1.plot: Charlie struggles with writer's block, and makes a desperate move to spark his inspiration. Pete tries to get the band a gig, and Neil falls in love.

1.title: FR - The Runarounds - S01E03 - (Nice Day for a) Weird Wedding
1.plot: The Runarounds play a hippie wedding, hoping to get the attention of a local record label.

1.title: FR - The Runarounds - S01E04 - Three Grand, Five Songs, Four Days
1.plot: After booking time at a recording studio, the band struggles to keep it together as tempers flare and Bez considers other opportunities.

1.title: FR - The Runarounds - S01E05 - Ride the Wave
1.plot: The Runarounds take a wild road trip over the rainbow that tests loyalties, reveals secrets, and teaches them what it means to make music.

1.title: FR - The Runarounds - S01E06 - Been Caught Stealing
1.plot: The band is in high spirits after their road trip, until they discover all their gear has been stolen.

1.title: FR - The Runarounds - S01E07 - Hypocrites
1.plot: As their new song goes viral, the band gets the attention of a major label. But with the end of summer looming, time is running out for Charlie and Sophia.

1.title: FR - The Runarounds - S01E08 - Kill Devil
1.plot: With a major label interested in signing The Runarounds, the band scores their biggest gig yet to seal the deal.

meta.plot: Cette série documentaire sur des faits réels dévoile le complot complexe qui a mené au meurtre terrifiant de Frank Dan Nørgaard Jørgensen, un père de famille danois de 40 ans. À l'été 2022, la famille de Frank s'inquiète lorsqu'il manque un rendez-vous avec sa petite amie Rikke et ne répond pas aux appels répétés de ses proches. Au fil des heures, la disparition soudaine de Frank est compliquée par la réapparition d'une ex-petite amie qui prétend être enceinte de lui… et qui devient finalement le principal suspect de l'enquête qui s'ensuit. Proposant des entretiens intimes avec les personnes les plus proches de l'affaire, Horses & Hangmen offre un regard captivant sur une histoire troublante de mensonges et de manipulation qui a secoué le Danemark.

1.title: FR - Horses and Hangmen - S01E01 - Say something, Frank
1.plot: After Frank goes missing, his concerned family grows suspicious when his ex-girlfriend re-emerges claiming to be pregnant with his child.

1.title: FR - Bon Appétit, Your Majesty [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Course Nº 1 Gochujang Butter Bibimbap
1.plot: After winning a French cooking competition, Yeon Ji-young time-travels through an old cookbook and clashes with King Yi Heon upon arrival.

1.title: FR - Bon Appétit, Your Majesty [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Course N° 2 Sous Vide Cuisine
1.plot: Held captive in harsh conditions, Ji-young prepares a feast to win her freedom — but even her talent can't save her when a crisis puts her life in peril.

1.title: FR - Bon Appétit, Your Majesty [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Course N° 3 Haute Cuisine
1.plot: Ji-young becomes Yi Heon's new chief royal cook after impressing him with her French cuisine. But Kang Mok-ju, consumed by jealousy, plots against her.

1.title: FR - Bon Appétit, Your Majesty [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Course N° 4 **** and Spinach Doenjang Soup
1.plot: A high-stakes royal cooking competition awaits Ji-young and her fate at court hangs in the balance. Later, a troubled Yi Heon drunkenly summons her.

1.title: FR - Bon Appétit, Your Majesty [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - Course N° 5 Snowflake Schnitzel
1.plot: After an intimate moment together, Yi Heon begins rejecting Ji-young's meals — but soon find their minds wandering toward each other amid the distance.

1.title: FR - Bon Appétit, Your Majesty [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - Course N° 6 Black Sesame Macaron
1.plot: When the Ming envoy demands a cooking contest, Ji-young rises to the challenge to represent Joseon — and win what Yi Heon has promised her.

1.title: FR - Bon Appétit, Your Majesty [VOSTFR] - S01E07 - Course N° 7 Dongnae Pajeon on a Rainy Day
1.plot: In order to gain an edge in the cooking competition, Ji-young sets out to create a unique pot. However, finding the right craftsman proves difficult.

1.title: FR - Bon Appétit, Your Majesty [VOSTFR] - S01E08 - Course N° 8 Rice Wine Beef Bourguignon

FR - The Twelve [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Behind the facade of their anonymity, these twelve ordinary people bring with them their own histories. Lives that are as complex as the trial, full of fractured dreams, shameful secrets, hope, fears, personal trauma, and prejudice.

1.title: FR - The Twelve [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Detective Sam Chedid takes the stand as various pieces of evidence are introduced to the court, some of which raise questions about Nathan Spears' involvement.

1.title: FR - The Twelve [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: The Crown calls Claire's best friend, Amita, to the stand. As the trial gets more complex, so too does the jury room dynamics, as their personal lives become increasingly entangled.

1.title: FR - The Twelve [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Kate Lawson's provocative artwork takes centre stage in the courtroom. The Crown raises questions around her artistic methods, as well as revealing a complicated mental health diagnosis.

meta.plot: L'histoire de 12 Australiens ordinaires sélectionnés comme jurés dans un procès pour meurtre aussi traumatisant que controversé, dans lequel une femme est accusée d'avoir tué sa nièce adolescente.

1.title: FR - The Au Pair [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: When happily married and successful Zoe struggles with her father George and stepson Noah she hires au pair Sandrine - who has a hidden agenda - setting off a chain of events that puts Zoe in grave danger.

meta.plot: Zoe semble mener une vie idéale aux côtés de son mari Chris, qui insiste pour qu'elle prenne une jeune fille au pair pour l'aider à la maison. En effet, elle est plutôt occupée entre son travail de couturière, son père George, qui s'est installé à proximité de sa fille afin qu'elle veille sur lui, et la gestion du quotidien avec Amber et Noah, les enfants de Chris. Zoe finit par accepter et...

1.title: FR - Most Wanted: Julius Kivimäki - S01E01 - Hunted by the FBI
1.plot: The premiere episode introduces Julius Kivimäki, a Finnish teenager who, by the age of 14, had fallen into the world of cybercrime. This episode establishes his early involvement with a group of criminal hackers, detailing his role in mass data breaches and the use of "swatting" to terrorize his targets. meta.plot: Coursier à vélo berlinois de 25 ans, complètement irresponsable, John Pohlmann hérite de mille milliards de dollars et devient du jour au lendemain John Fontanelli, l'homme le plus riche du monde. Cependant, la fortune est liée à une prophétie qui prédit que l'héritier utilisera l'argent pour restaurer l'avenir perdu de l'humanité. Le glamour du luxe et du gaspillage s'estompe rapidement lorsque John réalise que son nouveau style de vie jet-set n'offre rien de substantiel. Poussé par une révélation, il entreprend de réaliser la prophétie. Au fur et à mesure qu'il s'engage dans ce combat, il se rend compte que des ennemis dangereux et puissants tentent de l'arrêter, menaçant de détruire non seulement John, mais aussi le monde tel que nous le connaissons.

1.title: EN - Archive 81 [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E08 - What Lies Beneath
1.plot: The Otherworld beckons. Melody circles back to the Visser, where a new device captures a sacrifice. So much depends on Dan's journey into the unknown.

meta.plot: With his two friends, a video-game-obsessed young man finds himself in a strange version of Tokyo where they must compete in dangerous games to win.

1.title: EN - Alice in Borderland  [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Arisu and his friends run into a public bathroom to hide from the police — but when they reemerge, the streets of Tokyo are suddenly completely empty.

1.title: EN - Alice in Borderland  [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Leaving an injured Chota, Arisu and Karube head out to gain more experience. They come to a sprawling apartment, where a deadly game of tag awaits.

1.title: EN - Alice in Borderland  [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: With Chota's and Shibuki's visas fast expiring, the four enter a vast botanical garden in Shinjuku, where they take part in a cruel game of betrayal.

1.title: EN - Alice in Borderland  [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Arisu is overwhelmed with guilt and ready to give up, but Usagi urges him to keep going. Next up is a game of endurance in an underground highway.

1.title: EN - Alice in Borderland  [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: After Arisu and Usagi find their way to the Beach, the king of the so-called utopian haven forces them to help gather the remaining playing cards.

1.title: EN - Alice in Borderland  [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Chishiya recruits Arisu and Usagi to help him change the status quo. An unforeseen event rocks the fragile power dynamics of the Beach.

1.title: EN - Alice in Borderland  [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Once a safe haven, the Beach becomes the arena for the next stage, where an epic witch hunt turns everyone against each other in a hostile showdown.

1.title: EN - Alice in Borderland  [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Tensions inside the resort reach a boiling point. As the game clock nears zero, those who've survived the onslaught now face an uncertain future.

2.title: EN - Alice in Borderland  [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E01 - Episode 1
2.plot: Arisu, Usagi, Kuina and Chishiya have been waiting for over an hour in Shibuya crossing for the next stage to start, but nothing seems to be happening.

2.title: EN - Alice in Borderland  [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E02 - Episode 2
2.plot: Now that the King of Clubs has revealed himself in his full glory, the game finally begins. Much to Arisu's surprise, things are going pretty well.

2.title: EN - Alice in Borderland  [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E03 - Episode 3
2.plot: With only a few minutes left in the game, the results for each team seems fixed. Arisu approaches Kyuma, and asks to shake his hand.

2.title: EN - Alice in Borderland  [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E04 - Episode 4
2.plot: There are just a handful of players left, and Chishiya's the only one without a partner. The next round may very well be the last of the game.

2.title: EN - Alice in Borderland  [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E05 - Episode 5
2.plot: Aguni has one thing on his mind: to find and kill the King of Spades. He's joined by Arisu and a determined high schooler named Akane Heiya.

2.title: EN - Alice in Borderland  [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E06 - Episode 6
2.plot: Usagi will have to change the hearts and minds of the cynical players on the Queen's team. At the Supreme Court, Chishiya meets the King of Diamonds.

2.title: EN - Alice in Borderland  [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E07 - Episode 7
2.plot: In the middle of an overgrown Shibuya crossing, Niragi challenges Arisu and Chishiya to a game. But then the King of Spades arrives.

2.title: EN - Alice in Borderland  [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E08 - Episode 8
2.plot: For their final game, they'll need to survive three rounds of croquet — but before they can get very far, the Queen asks them to sit down for some tea.

3.title: EN - Alice in Borderland  [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S03E01 - Episode 1
3.plot: Back in the real world with no memories of Borderland, Arisu and Usagi encounter Ryuji, a professor with a fixation on near-death experiences.

3.title: EN - Alice in Borderland  [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S03E02 - Episode 2
3.plot: The first game begins at a shrine. Arisu and the other players must solve math problems on the fly before everything goes up in flames.

3.title: EN - Alice in Borderland  [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S03E03 - Episode 3
3.plot: As Rei's plan unravels, Arisu takes a risky move to keep his team alive. On a separate stage, Usagi and Ryuji face a relentless barrage of lasers.

3.title: EN - Alice in Borderland  [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S03E04 - Episode 4
3.plot: With time running out and a crash imminent, Usagi's group must jump trains to survive. An explosive game of Kick the Can awaits Arisu's team.

3.title: EN - Alice in Borderland  [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S03E05 - Episode 5
3.plot: Arisu follows his digital double through a simulation of future Shibuya, stopping at a heartwarming scene — and the real Usagi before him.

3.title: EN - Alice in Borderland  [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S03E06 - Episode 6
3.plot: Haunted by a devastating glimpse into the future, Arisu crumples under the pressure to save everyone. Will he, Usagi and the team make it to the exit?

meta.plot: Les histoires racontées dans cette émission sont basées sur des enquêtes et faits divers étranges et phénomènes inexpliqués qui se sont le plus souvent déroulés aux États-Unis d'Amérique mais également en Australie. Pierre Bellemare met son talent de conteur au service de ces histoires étranges afin de ménager suspense et mystère. L'histoire racontée est illustrée par des reconstitutions tirées du format original américain Unsolved Mysteries (1987-2002) présentée par Robert Stack (plus de 553 épisodes).

meta.plot: When the world's seven most advanced robots and their human allies are murdered one by one, Inspector Gesicht soon discovers that he's also in danger.

1.title: EN - PLUTO [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: A beloved Swiss robot is found blown into in pieces. Meanwhile, Europol robot inspector Gesicht investigates another eerily related murder.

1.title: EN - PLUTO [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Another horned corpse is found. Gesicht reaches out to Atom, the most advanced of the seven robots, to help analyze the serial murders.

1.title: EN - PLUTO [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Abullah gets summoned by police superintendent Tawashi regarding Tazaki's murder. Gesicht starts to suspect that his data may be compromised.

1.title: EN - PLUTO [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Professor Ochanomizu brings a battered robot dog home and attempts to fix it. Soon after, a mysterious man claiming to be the owner visits his house.

1.title: EN - PLUTO [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: After delivering Adolf Haas to a safe house, Gesicht looks into his past. Meanwhile, Hercules and Epsilon sense a mysterious threat approaching them.

1.title: EN - PLUTO [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Gesicht meets Abullah in Persia to further investigate the case, but detects a lie. He inches closer to the truth when he encounters a robot child.

1.title: EN - PLUTO [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Dr. Tenma attempts to bring Atom back at all costs. A government official advises a distressed Epsilon to evacuate since he's the next target.

1.title: EN - PLUTO [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Professor Ochanomizu closely monitors Atom's erratic behavior. Dr. Tenma confronts his past and the truth unravels, triggering a world destroying threat.

meta.plot: Deux frères, Mark et Hank Hoagies, perdent leur emploi à cause de l'automatisation. Ils reçoivent alors trois mille dollars par mois dans le cadre d'un nouveau programme de revenu de base, et utilisent leur temps libre et l’argent donné pour se trouver un but, dans un monde où l'on n'a plus besoin d'eux.

1.title: FR - Universal Basic Guys - S01E01 - Pet Projects (Pilot)
1.plot: Threatened by a doctor's kindness toward Tammy, Mark tries to get her an exotic animal, only to have his face ripped off by the newly purchased chimpanzee. Meanwhile, Hank bonds with the chimpanzee via its bluetooth, and David's dog saves David and Mernft Man from a pet snake.

1.title: FR - Universal Basic Guys - S01E02 - Sunset Cruise
1.plot: When David, Andrea, Mark, and Tammy go on a cruise together, David and Andrea unexpectedly rekindle their romance. Mark's preoccupation with reeling in a big fish to outcompete Steve DelVecchio leads to him catching a whale that jeopardizes the safety of the entire cruise. Meanwhile, Hank goes on a date with a mermaid that goes awry when she reveals her distaste for hot dogs.

1.title: FR - Universal Basic Guys - S01E03 - The Devil You Know
1.plot: Mark, in an attempt to bond with his stepson Darren, insists on teaching him how to throw a handmade boomerang that was gifted to Darren by his father. The two soon find themselves on a trek deep into the Jersey woods in search of it, where they encounter the Jersey Devil himself. Meanwhile, David is the recipient of a sex doll that he swears he didn't order, and is put through the wringer trying to return it.

1.title: FR - Universal Basic Guys - S01E04 - Guys Day
1.plot: When Tammy is upset that an elite country club only takes men, Mark joins it to supposedly change things from within; Tammy's passion for the club infuriates the owner's wife, Ellen; Mark's entry into the club ruins the natural order.

1.title: FR - Universal Basic Guys - S01E05 - Jaws of Life
1.plot: Jealous of the attention Tammy gets for saving the life of a choking stranger, Mark buys a Jaws of Life to efficiently save lives; Tammy's life is threatened when she rejects the advances of Paul, the stranger she saved.

1.title: FR - Universal Basic Guys - S01E06 - Bird Cage
1.plot: Mark buys himself a Superbowl ring and leverages it to get special treatment at the Eagles game; Hank has an adventure with cutting-edge mascot technology.

1.title: FR - Universal Basic Guys - S01E07 - Fight or Flight
1.plot: Mark puts his piloting skills to the test.

1.title: FR - Universal Basic Guys - S01E08 - Poconos
1.plot: Mark, Tammy, Hank, and Darren discover a magical, immersive, Jumani-style board game where they have to overcome their interpersonal differences in order to survive. David, facing the most important deadline and worst writer's block of his career, seeks solitude.

1.title: FR - Universal Basic Guys - S01E09 - Mr. Cupcake Man
1.plot: Mark, trying to prove to Tammy that he can get babies to like him, writes a hit song that becomes the next Baby Shark. He enlists his family and neighbors to join his management team, putting these relationships to the test during his meteoric rise and humiliating fall. Meanwhile, David tries to capitalize in Mark's wake by resuscitating his old and out of touch climate change educational magic act.

1.title: FR - Universal Basic Guys - S01E10 - Mark Men
1.plot: Mark throws his hat into the ring as an Ad Man after being shown up by a group of execs.

1.title: FR - Universal Basic Guys - S01E11 - Sheet Shock
1.plot: After feeling slighted by a Navy recruiter, Mark sets out to join an elite unit of the Marines, only to be thwarted by his inability to properly make a bed. David teams up with a Veteran, hoping to ghost write the next American Sniper and can no longer distinguish fantasy from reality as his subject reveals stories from his past that are stranger than fiction.

1.title: FR - Universal Basic Guys - S01E12 - Deer Stakes
1.plot: Mark accidentally murders Hank with a crossbow while hunting a deer.

1.title: FR - Universal Basic Guys - S01E13 - Water Ice Shoppe
1.plot: Mark goes into business with Gary & Barry's Water Ice Shoppe, a Glantontown institution, when faced with being deprived of his favorite summer snack during their annual winter closure.

meta.plot: Déterminés à décrypter de vieux secrets de famille, les incroyables orphelins Baudelaire vont devoir affronter le maléfique comte Olaf et bien d'autres épreuves.

1.title: FR - Les Désastreuses Aventures des orphelins Baudelaire - S01E01 - The Bad Beginning (1)
1.plot: The dreadful history of the Baudelaire children begins with a deadpan narrator, a terrible fire and the ominous arrival of a distant relative.

1.title: FR - Les Désastreuses Aventures des orphelins Baudelaire - S01E02 - The Bad Beginning (2)
1.plot: While Mr. Poe's secretary works overtime, Count Olaf casts Violet and Klaus in "The Marvelous Marriage," a work of theater with alarming implications.

1.title: FR - Les Désastreuses Aventures des orphelins Baudelaire - S01E03 - The Reptile Room (1)
1.plot: After the Baudelaires move in with Dr. Montgomery, a renowned expert in reptile behavior, their new guardian hires a frighteningly familiar assistant.

1.title: FR - Les Désastreuses Aventures des orphelins Baudelaire - S01E04 - The Reptile Room (2)
1.plot: Klaus and Violet suspect Count Olaf and his evil cohorts when a lifeless body turns up in the reptile room. Sunny sees the inside of a suitcase.

1.title: FR - Les Désastreuses Aventures des orphelins Baudelaire - S01E05 - The Wide Window (1)
1.plot: The orphans arrive at the aptly named Lake Lachrymose to meet their widowed Aunt Josephine, a strict grammarian who's haunted by the past.

1.title: FR - Les Désastreuses Aventures des orphelins Baudelaire - S01E06 - The Wide Window (2)
1.plot: Klaus and Violet look for clues in a suspicious note that passes custody to Captain Sham, a seafaring scam artist with clear ties to Count Olaf.

1.title: FR - Les Désastreuses Aventures des orphelins Baudelaire - S01E07 - The Miserable Mill (1)
1.plot: The children arrive at the Lucky Smells Lumber Mill and unearth some unsettling accusations about their parents. Count Olaf courts an old flame.

1.title: FR - Les Désastreuses Aventures des orphelins Baudelaire - S01E08 - The Miserable Mill (2)
1.plot: Klaus just isn't himself after seeing Dr. Orwell, an optometrist with oddly optimistic patients. Meanwhile, Violet works to clear her parents' names.

2.title: FR - Les Désastreuses Aventures des orphelins Baudelaire - S02E01 - The Austere Academy (1)
2.plot: The Baudelaires begin life at boarding school and meet a pair of mysterious siblings whose tragic lives sound eerily similar to their own.

2.title: FR - Les Désastreuses Aventures des orphelins Baudelaire - S02E02 - The Austere Academy (2)
2.plot: While the Quagmires keep up the search, the Baudelaires struggle to balance their studies with a punishing workout schedule, courtesy of Count Olaf.

2.title: FR - Les Désastreuses Aventures des orphelins Baudelaire - S02E03 - The Ersatz Elevator (1)
2.plot: Violet, Klaus and Sunny get new guardians in a fashionable building, where stairs are in -- and the elevator's out. Jacques Snicket trains a recruit.

2.title: FR - Les Désastreuses Aventures des orphelins Baudelaire - S02E04 - The Ersatz Elevator (2)
2.plot: The Baudelaires find their friends -- and then lose them -- at the bottom of an elevator shaft. Count Olaf conducts an auction in disguise.

2.title: FR - Les Désastreuses Aventures des orphelins Baudelaire - S02E05 - The Vile Village (1)
2.plot: Mr. Poe brings the Baudelaires to V.F.D., a bird-loving village with an Old West vibe. Jacques and Olivia continue their search for the Quagmires.

2.title: FR - Les Désastreuses Aventures des orphelins Baudelaire - S02E06 - The Vile Village (2)
2.plot: The orphans find themselves under suspicion in the wake of a devastating murder. But time behind bars leads to an important realization.

2.title: FR - Les Désastreuses Aventures des orphelins Baudelaire - S02E07 - The Hostile Hospital (1)
2.plot: Life on the lam leads the Baudelaires to a horrifying hospital with an enormous library that could hold the answers to all of their questions.

2.title: FR - Les Désastreuses Aventures des orphelins Baudelaire - S02E08 - The Hostile Hospital (2)
2.plot: A bearded Klaus and Sunny comb the hospital's crumbling halls for Violet, who's being held prisoner under Count Olaf's questionable "care."

2.title: FR - Les Désastreuses Aventures des orphelins Baudelaire - S02E09 - Carnivorous Carnival (1)
2.plot: Come one, come all to the creepiest circus the world has ever seen, a place where puzzling mysteries -- and a familiar face -- await.

2.title: FR - Les Désastreuses Aventures des orphelins Baudelaire - S02E10 - Carnivorous Carnival (2)
2.plot: Still posing as conjoined carnival freaks, the Baudelaires brace themselves for a beastly fate. Will good fortune intervene ... for once?

3.title: FR - Les Désastreuses Aventures des orphelins Baudelaire - S03E01 - Slippery Slope (1)
3.plot: While Count Olaf makes his way to V.F.D. headquarters with Sunny, Klaus and Violet are exactly where we left them: careening toward the edge of a cliff.

3.title: FR - Les Désastreuses Aventures des orphelins Baudelaire - S03E02 - Slippery Slope (2)
3.plot: Sunny sends a signal from Count Olaf's camp, where a sinister duo is awakening old insecurities. A clue at V.F.D. HQ points the way to a fateful meeting.

3.title: FR - Les Désastreuses Aventures des orphelins Baudelaire - S03E03 - Grim Grotto (1)
3.plot: A young submarine captain with ties to the V.F.D. reveals she's looking for the sugar bowl. But so is Esmé Squalor, who's on a mission to find it first.

3.title: FR - Les Désastreuses Aventures des orphelins Baudelaire - S03E04 - Grim Grotto (2)
3.plot: With Sunny's fate hanging in the balance, Violet and Klaus race to find a life-saving antidote and learn the location of the Last Safe Place.

3.title: FR - Les Désastreuses Aventures des orphelins Baudelaire - S03E05 - Penultimate Peril (1)
3.plot: Various parties converge at the Hotel Denouement, where the mysterious "J.S." has called the V.F.D. together -- and things aren't always what they seem.

3.title: FR - Les Désastreuses Aventures des orphelins Baudelaire - S03E06 - Penultimate Peril (2)
3.plot: Big secrets are revealed when Count Olaf goes on trial in the hotel lobby. The Baudelaires are the first to take the stand, but will justice be served?

3.title: FR - Les Désastreuses Aventures des orphelins Baudelaire - S03E07 - The End
3.plot: The final chapter takes the orphans to a deserted island: a place of lost lives, old stories and new beginnings. It all ends here.

1.title: FR - Montmartre - S01E01 - Episode 1
