1.title: FR - V Wars - S01E04 - Bad as Me
1.plot: Luther pleads with the DNS to bring in Michael alive, but other pursuers have less peaceful intentions. Meanwhile, Danika's urges grow stronger.

1.title: FR - V Wars - S01E05 - Cold Cold Ground
1.plot: As Michael and his followers settle into new accommodations, a tough-talking general takes control of the DNS. Also, Luther witnesses a brutal act.

1.title: FR - V Wars - S01E06 - It's Not Enough to Have Lived
1.plot: Desmond's health worsens, forcing Luther down a dangerous path. Later, Luther receives a surprising offer and Michael lays down the law.

1.title: FR - V Wars - S01E07 - The Night Is Darkening Round Me
1.plot: Suddenly on his own, Desmond calls on his mother for help. Danika urges Michael to think bigger. Mila tries using her strength for good.

1.title: FR - V Wars - S01E08 - Red Rain
1.plot: Luther connects with a Washington insider who has a plan to keep society from collapsing. Ava sets out to get proof of the DNS internment camps.

1.title: FR - V Wars - S01E09 - The Junkie Run of the Predator Gene
1.plot: Luther's testimony rattles a few cages. Desmond and Amélie investigate an unsettling noise. Danika and Michael hit the town.

1.title: FR - V Wars - S01E10 - Bloody but Unbow'd
1.plot: An official truce is announced but complications quickly arise, threatening the lives of humans as well as Bloods.

meta.plot: Le Dr. Luther Swann voit sa vie basculer dans l'horreur le jour où son meilleur ami, Michael Fayne, se transforme en dangereux prédateur qui se nourrit de sang humain. Peu à peu, cette mystérieuse maladie se propage, divisant la société en deux camps : les gens « normaux » et les vampires. Swann entame une course contre la montre pour comprendre ce qu'il se passe et trouver un antidote, tandis que Fayne devient le leader des vampires.
Lorsque le soleil commence soudain à tout tuer sur son chemin, les passagers d'un vol de nuit en partance de Bruxelles tentent de survivre par tous les moyens.

1.title: FR - Into the Night - S01E01 - Sylvie
1.plot: When an armed man storms her late-night flight to Moscow, former military pilot Sylvie finds herself pulled into the cockpit to help.

1.title: FR - Into the Night - S01E02 - Jakub
1.plot: Mechanic Jakub clashes with the others about what to do next. A Wi-Fi signal brings troubling new intel on the disaster — and on some of the passengers.

1.title: FR - Into the Night - S01E03 - Mathieu
1.plot: As the group deals with a series of mechanical crises, Terenzio challenges Mathieu's authority, and Horst makes contact with another plane.

1.title: FR - Into the Night - S01E04 - Ayaz
1.plot: Rik organizes a hasty trial to decide Ayaz's fate, Terenzio reveals rumors of a NATO refuge, and Sylvie begins to worry about Mathieu's state of mind.

1.title: FR - Into the Night - S01E05 - Rik
1.plot: The mission to NATO headquarters takes a dramatic turn. Laura and Horst tend to a medical emergency. Jakub and Osman race to solve the fuel problem.

1.title: FR - Into the Night - S01E06 - Terenzio
1.plot: Emotions run high as the group makes one last desperate bid to reach safety before dawn breaks.

2.title: FR - Into the Night - S02E01 - Zara
2.plot: Just as the passengers settle into the rhythms of life in the bunker, a sudden food shortage forces them to consider making another risky journey.

2.title: FR - Into the Night - S02E02 - Laura
2.plot: With the generator shut down, temperatures and tempers soar, sparking a tense standoff. The Colonel finds a damning piece of evidence at the air base.

2.title: FR - Into the Night - S02E03 - Ines
2.plot: After a distressing chain of events, Thea and Mathieu lead a search for a new plane, and the officers plot their revenge on Sylvie.

2.title: FR - Into the Night - S02E04 - Gia
2.plot: At the bunker, the trial soon gives way to more twisted schemes. The group searching for seeds encounters a disoriented stranger.

2.title: FR - Into the Night - S02E05 - Théa
2.plot: As Thea and team attempt to lure Gia out of the vault, Ines searches for a way back into the bunker, and Rik confides in the ambassador.

2.title: FR - Into the Night - S02E06 - Asil
2.plot: The crisis aboard the plane threatens to leave the travelers stranded. Fearing for their lives, Sylvie and the others hatch a plan to flee the bunker.

meta.plot: Après une grave maladie, un magnat de la communication découvre que les manœuvres de ses enfants menacent l'empire qu'il a minutieusement bâti. Il veut le sauver – à tout prix.

1.title: FR - Legado - S01E01 - Return
1.plot: Returning from medical treatment, media tycoon Federico Seligman discovers that his children have embroiled his leading newspaper in a serious scandal.

1.title: FR - Legado - S01E02 - Punish
1.plot: The three siblings try not to panic as Andrés plans to use their father’s health to discredit him. Lara meets a mysterious new friend at university.

1.title: FR - Legado - S01E03 - Negotiate
1.plot: Federico challenges Andrés' position at El Báltico, while Guadalupe pursues a higher political position. Yolanda enters a dangerous love triangle.

1.title: FR - Legado - S01E04 - Farewell
1.plot: A shocking discovery leads to Manuel's detention. Federico deals with the resurgence of old feelings and considers letting go of El Báltico.

1.title: FR - Legado - S01E05 - Publish
1.plot: After a dangerous break-in at the family home, Manuel approaches his father-in-law with a tip-off. Lara learns more about León's past.

1.title: FR - Legado - S01E06 - Forgive
1.plot: With the interview circulating, Andrés and Federico grow closer. Yolanda's husband considers their marriage as Guadalupe finds out something about hers.

1.title: FR - Legado - S01E07 - Fight
1.plot: Andrés addresses Progresa's shareholders and Federico visits a resentful inmate. Guadalupe deals with Manuel's mistake. Lara decides to help León.

1.title: FR - Legado - S01E08 - Decide
1.plot: As the paper receives an offer it can't refuse, the truth of a past crime is revealed, leaving the future of Federico's legacy hanging in the balance.

1.title: FR - A Model Family - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: After losing hope of gaining tenure, a desperate Park Dong-ha acts quickly when he comes across a van containing two dead bodies and a bag of cash.

1.title: FR - A Model Family - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Ma Kwang-chul moves into the neighborhood, with Kwang Joo-hyun soon following suit.  Dong-ha searches online for tips on how to launder money.

1.title: FR - A Model Family - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Kwang-chul uncovers useful information on what went down with the money launderer.  Dong-ha calls the police with an anonymous tip about his neighbor.

1.title: FR - A Model Family - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Dong-ha sets out for Busan to make his first delivery.  Kang Eun-ju searches the streets for her daughter, who refuses to come home.

1.title: FR - A Model Family - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Park Yeon-woo stirs up trouble for herself and her father after he discovers the hidden bag and takes off with a chunk of the loot.

1.title: FR - A Model Family - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Eun-ju trails after Dong-ha as he heads to a spa.  Striking out on his own, Kwang-chul fights for a chance to work for the head cartel.

1.title: FR - A Model Family - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Kwang-chul drops by to give Tonh-soo a promised heads-up.  Park Deuk-soo makes himself at home while stealthily looking for clues.

1.title: FR - A Model Family - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Dong-ha and a partner are tasked with transporting the cash.  Choi-Kang-jun offers to free Dong-ha from the money and Kwang-chul in one fell swoop.

1.title: FR - A Model Family - S01E09 - Episode 9
1.plot: Fearing for his life, Yong-soo goes into hiding.  Joo-hyn makes Kang-jun an offer in exchange for the identity of the mole.

1.title: FR - A Model Family - S01E10 - Episode 10
1.plot: Dong-ha returns home to find the police digging around.  Kwang-chul sends the head cartel a bloody message.  Joo-hyun takes matters into her own hands.

meta.plot: Après avoir involontairement volé de l'argent à un cartel, un professeur fauché n'a pas d'autre choix que de devenir passeur de drogue pour sauver sa famille brisée.

1.title: FR - Splinter Cell: Deathwatch - S01E01 - Up from the Grave
1.plot: After a failed and bloody mission in Lituania, Fourth Echelon agent Zinnia McKenna must find her way out of the country and ask for the help of a retired agent : Sam Fisher.

1.title: FR - Splinter Cell: Deathwatch - S01E02 - Dinner First, Talk Later
1.plot: Sam and McKenna are hiding in Echelon's safe house while the latter is recovering from her wounds. But Displace is on their tracks and time is running out.

1.title: FR - Splinter Cell: Deathwatch - S01E03 - Welcome to the 4th Echelon
1.plot: When their location is compromised, the agents must hit the road and hunt for any clue left by Lukas. At Echelon's HQ, Grim and Jo are looking for a reliable IT expert to put them back on track.

1.title: FR - Splinter Cell: Deathwatch - S01E04 - Scars of Bagram
1.plot: While Diana struggle to find a proper work-life balance with Charlie, and McKenna has a hard time dealing with grief, Sam must face the ghosts of his own past.

1.title: FR - Splinter Cell: Deathwatch - S01E05 - Simple As That
1.plot: Echelon must infiltrate a crowded fundraiser to get their hands on Diana's phone. But since Sam mustn't be seen and recognized, McKenna has to take the lead. With the help of Thunder, it's time for a team effort.

1.title: FR - Splinter Cell: Deathwatch - S01E06 - The Man Is the Mission
1.plot: All hell breaks lose when McKenna is MIA and Sam goes rogue to end the mission on his own terms.

1.title: FR - Splinter Cell: Deathwatch - S01E07 - Chaos Theory (1)
1.plot: As the pieces of the puzzle are coming together, Echelon discover the evil schemes of the Shetlands.

1.title: FR - Splinter Cell: Deathwatch - S01E08 - Chaos Theory (2)
1.plot: To put a hold on Diana and Charlie deadly plan, the agents board the Lazarev to stop it before it's too late. But as always with the Shetlands, there's more than meets the eye.

meta.plot:
Dans l'univers nébuleux de l'espionnage, Sam Fisher est une rumeur et une légende. Appelé à reprendre du service, il doit aider une nouvelle recrue à démêler un complot mondial.

Série animée adaptée de la saga vidéo-ludique Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell.

meta.plot: Le corps inanimé de la jeune adolescente est découvert dans la forêt qui encadre le village de Manscheid, dans le nord du pays.  Luc Capitani, le policier délégué sur place, est originaire du sud minier et a fort à faire avec la mentalité locale.  Secondé par Elsa Ley, une jeune policière locale, il se retrouve rapidement emmêlé dans une intrigue compliquée où tout n'est que faux-semblant et où chaque habitant en sait plus qu'il ne veut bien en dire.  Au fil de l’enquête, Luc Capitani devra non seulement traquer un meurtrier, mais aussi casser une mentalité, un système où beaucoup de gens se manipulent au nom du "bien-être commun".  En démêlant les fils mensongers des villageois les uns après les autres, il se retrouvera face à sa propre conscience au moment de découvrir l'étouffante vérité...

1.title: FR - Capitani - S01E01 - Oh You, Up There
1.plot: Capitani enlists local police officer Elsa Ley to help him investigate how a 15-year-old girl ended up dead in the forest surrounding her village.

1.title: FR - Capitani - S01E02 - Beneath His Dark, Wooden Crown
1.plot: The village launches a search party for Tanja as suspicion lands on someone close to the Engels. Capitani encounters a friend he hasn't seen in years.

1.title: FR - Capitani - S01E03 - Out of Childhood, Out of Childhood
1.plot: Capitani searches for clues near the crime scene, and Elsa hatches a plan to retrieve evidence from Jenny's school — and slips away for an appointment.

1.title: FR - Capitani - S01E04 - No Rest for the Eyes, No Rest for the Heart
1.plot: As rumors about the latest developments fly around the village, Capitani sifts through shaky alibis, lies and local political drama.

1.title: FR - Capitani - S01E05 - Strangers Will Be Obliged to Accept
1.plot: New evidence unravels a witness statement, Capitani loses patience during an interrogation, and Elsa finds her personal life in conflict with her job.

1.title: FR - Capitani - S01E06 - So Far from Me, So Far!
1.plot: Capitani and Elsa pursue two promising suspects, Tanja's friends grow concerned about her behavior and Mick pushes for details on the investigation.

1.title: FR - Capitani - S01E07 - And I Know Misfortune and Sorrow
1.plot: Leaked information leads to an act of vengeance, an incident from Capitani's past causes trouble, and Elsa's inquiries hit worryingly close to home.

1.title: FR - Capitani - S01E08 - These Wonderful Golden Dreams
1.plot: As the police track the drug operation, Capitani forces Manon's hand. The soldiers hit a delivery snag, and Mick betrays his feelings about Jenny.

1.title: FR - Capitani - S01E09 - My Heart Was Full of Trust
1.plot: Capitani comes under scrutiny for a long-ago mistake, while a hidden letter, a secret phone and a distressed father help to blow the case wide open.

1.title: FR - Capitani - S01E10 - I Knew Nothing of Tears and Pain
1.plot: Capitani feels the clock ticking on his investigation, prompting him to share confidences with Elsa, who rashly follows a lead on the missing soldiers.

1.title: FR - Capitani - S01E11 - My Breast Full of Darkest Night
1.plot: After guns are drawn and shots fired, Capitani faces increasing pressure to close the case and move on despite his many unanswered questions.

1.title: FR - Capitani - S01E12 - It Happened One Beautiful Summer's Day
1.plot: With his career on the line and the lies piling up, Capitani races to uncover the truth of what happened to Jenny and Tanja on that fateful night.

2.title: FR - Capitani - S02E01 - In Your Sights
2.plot:
Four years after the events in Manscheid, Luc Capitani is working as a handyman in the station district of Luxembourg City.

Until Bianca, a prostitute, hires him to investigate the disappearance of her friend Andrea. The search is cut short when Capitani locates her body in a forest, and the hunt for her killer begins. Meanwhile, Lucky Onu arrives in Luxembourg from Nigeria, to look for his sister.

2.title: FR - Capitani - S02E02 - There's Someone on the Corner
2.plot:
Capitani is hired by Valentina Draga to look after her "girls". Lucky locates his sister, who wants nothing to do with him.

Police officer Elsa Ley is monitoring drug traffic in the area, but the relationship between her and Luc has deteriorated. A second prostitute is murdered in the night.

2.title: FR - Capitani - S02E03 - Hit or Run
2.plot:
Capitani reveals he is working as an undercover police officer for Pascale Cojocaru, which enabled him to walk free from prison.

Luc and Elsa share information on the murders. Bianca informs Luc of underage prostitutes working at a cabaret club in the city. Lucky struggles to get hold of his sister.

2.title: FR - Capitani - S02E04 - Until The First Approaches You
2.plot:
Gibbes Koenig joins forces with Valentina to combat a Nigerian drug gang.

Luc tries to organise a coup, but needs Elsa's help, but Elsa calls him a crook and refuses to work with him.  Luc's relationship with his boss Cojocaru starts to collapse.

2.title: FR - Capitani - S02E05 - Your Last Thought
2.plot:
Capitani helps Lucky view the body of his sister in return for information on the drug operations around Luxembourg City station.

Toni is mistrustful of Luc and forbids Bianca from spending time with him, but agrees to accompany Luc on a trip to the forest to meet with a dealer.

2.title: FR - Capitani - S02E06 - If Only I Fled
2.plot:
Luc discovers his former lover Carla Pereira is supplying the Nigerians with drugs. She asks him to leave her alone.

Elsa and Toni spend the night together but try to continue working together. Luc seeks assistance from his sister Jeanne, but the siblings' relationship has been rocky since the death of their father. Pascale Cojocaru realises that something is hindering Luc's release.

2.title: FR - Capitani - S02E07 - No Time to Lose
2.plot:
Capitani organises an attack on a Nigerian mafia drug shipment.

Cojucaru promises Luc his freedom if the operation is successful and if Arthur is taken into custody. Luc forces Carla to participate in the attack. Lucky asks Bianca for help finding Grace. Elsa suspects that Luc is working undercover.

2.title: FR - Capitani - S02E08 - The First One to Fall
2.plot:
Arthur is found dead, while the drug shipment has disappeared.

Lucky is imprisoned by Queen as he represents a risk to the operation. Valentina forces Gibbes to withdraw from the business. Cojucaru is unsuccessful in securing Luc's full release, although he has earned her trust. Luc decides to work for Valentina.

2.title: FR - Capitani - S02E09 - Late at Night
2.plot:
Elsa and Luc suspect that Carla is behind the drug shipment's disappearance.

Protesting her innocence, Carla reveals significant information about drug dealings at the "Grand Huit" café, which Luc passes on to Elsa. Grace tells Bianca that Dominik tried to kill her. Bianca demands an explanation from Dominik.

2.title: FR - Capitani - S02E10 - You Are Alone
2.plot:
Valentina takes over Gibbes' business, and thanks Luc for sorting the problem with the Nigerian dealer.

Elsa observes that the drug traffic is continuing to operate. Bianca wonders where her former friends are getting their cash flow from. An injured Lucky seeks to return to the city. Luc and Elsa talk for the first time.

2.title: FR - Capitani - S02E11 - Wipe the Smile From Your Face
2.plot:
Cojocaru locates Luc's service weapon in Manscheid lake and returns it to him.

Luc must confront his inner turmoil. Elsa and Toni monitor the prostitutes at the station, but Toni seems to have other plans in mind. Luc takes Lucky in, and Bianca finds Grace's address.

2.title: FR - Capitani - S02E12 - You Should Know What's Best
2.plot:
Luc discovers that Dominik stole the drug shipment and has been selling them via the prostitutes.

Valentina defends her son and insists that Luc stays on her side. Lucky visits his sister. Bianca and Luc investigate the threats made to Lucky, and set a trap to catch Dominik and Toni.

1.title: FR - Cher Hongrang - S01E01 - Rainbow Hong, Shining Rang - My Brother Hongrang
1.plot: Twelve years after Sim Hongrang's sudden disappearance, a man seeming to be him appears — passing all the tests. Yet Sim Jae-yi remains unconvinced.

1.title: FR - Cher Hongrang - S01E02 - The One Who Stole Our World
1.plot: Jae-yi and Hongrang separately search for a ghost rumored to be abducting children. In their search, peril strikes Jae-yi — but Hongrang is at her rescue.

1.title: FR - Cher Hongrang - S01E03 - The Most Authentic Replica
1.plot: After Hongrang's act of heroism, Jae-yi begins to question her doubts. Sim Mu-jin schemes to expose Hongrang's identity at his birthday celebration.

1.title: FR - Cher Hongrang - S01E04 - Our Reflective Scars
1.plot: Learning of Min Yeon-ui's plans, Sim Yeol-guk devises a counterattack. Hongrang struggles with his conscience after being assigned a terrible task.

1.plot: As she learns more about Hongrang's past, Jae-yi begins to care for him. Later, Hongrang and Mu-jin suspect Lady Min’s scheme to marry Jae-yi off.

1.plot: As plans to stop Jae-yi's arrangement fail, she finds herself in a dangerous bind. The opposition between Yeol-guk and Yeon-ui reaches a boiling point.

1.title: FR - Cher Hongrang - S01E07 - Roaring Waves
1.plot: As Mu-jin's fate remains dire, Jae-yi attempts to do whatever it takes to save him. Later, news of a dead child returning spreads, alarming Hongrang.

1.title: FR - Cher Hongrang - S01E08 - Imperfect Jae, Departing Yi - My Name Is Jae-yi
1.plot: Jae-yi decides to leave with Mu-jin despite her feelings for Hongrang. Yeol-guk initiates damage control after discovering a conspiracy against him.

1.title: FR - Cher Hongrang - S01E09 - The Living Offering
1.plot: A manhunt for Hongrang and Jae-yi ensues, putting them in grave danger. As they hide, their bond deepens, facing threats and challenges together.

1.title: FR - Cher Hongrang - S01E10 - A Bittersweet Farewell
1.plot: With Hongrang captured, Yeol-guk attempts to restore the guild in his name. But Grand Prince Hanpyeong wastes no time putting his grand plan into motion.

1.title: FR - Cher Hongrang - S01E11 - Forever and After
1.plot: The truth about Hongrang is revealed, but enemies remain. In the end, will he be able to save Jae-yi and free himself from the shackles of his past?

meta.plot: Quand Hongrang, fils d'un puissant marchand de Joseon, disparaît, sa demi-sœur Jae-yi s'acharne à le retrouver. Lorsqu'il revient des années plus tard avec un secret, le trouble s'installe entre Jae-yi et lui. Cette intrigue romantique d'époque prend place après le retour de Hongrang, et dépeint les liens indéfectibles qui unissent les personnages, tous porteurs de leurs propres secrets et désirs.
Follow a dysfunctional team of MI5 agents—and their obnoxious boss, the notorious Jackson Lamb—as they navigate the espionage world's smoke and mirrors to defend England from sinister forces.

1.title: EN - Slow Horses [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Work Drinks

1.title: EN - Slow Horses [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Visiting Hours

3.title: EN - Slow Horses [MULTI-SUB] - S03E01 - Strange Games

3.title: EN - Slow Horses [MULTI-SUB] - S03E02 - Hard Lessons
3.plot: River has to steal something out of the Park to save a life. Lamb realizes a stranger game is afoot.

3.title: EN - Slow Horses [MULTI-SUB] - S03E03 - Negotiating with Tigers
3.plot: Marcus and Shirley face Lamb's wrath. River discovers revenge is a dish best served cold.

3.title: EN - Slow Horses [MULTI-SUB] - S03E04 - Uninvited Guests
3.plot: Tearney makes a bold move. The Slow Horses assist the Tiger Team, unaware of their hidden agenda. Lamb and Ho take a road trip.

3.title: EN - Slow Horses [MULTI-SUB] - S03E05 - Cleaning Up
3.plot: Taverner and Tearney face off for control of MI5. River and Louisa find themselves caught in the crossfire.

3.title: EN - Slow Horses [MULTI-SUB] - S03E06 - Footprints
3.plot: The Slow Horses fight for their lives. Lamb shares some devastating truths with Catherine.

4.title: EN - Slow Horses [MULTI-SUB] - S04E01 - Identity Theft
4.plot: A London bombing puts Taverner under pressure. When River grows concerned for his grandfather, Louisa encourages him to go for a visit.

4.title: EN - Slow Horses [MULTI-SUB] - S04E02 - A Stranger Comes to Town
4.plot: A naive agent makes a discovery about the Westacres bomber. Lamb suspects that David knows more than he's letting on.

1.plot: As new details about the bombing emerge, Kate struggles to see eye-to-eye with Hal. Prime Minister Trowbridge's fiery remarks at a funeral cause a stir.

1.title: EN - The Diplomat [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E04 - He Bought a Hat
1.plot: As Rayburn's rep takes a hit, Kate drops in on Dennison's private meeting at the UK Foreign Office and learns startling information about the attack.

1.title: EN - The Diplomat [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E05 - The Dogcatcher
1.plot: Tempers flare at Chevening House, where an unexpected guest's arrival sends Kate and Dennison scrambling for a resolution. Hal makes a new connection.

1.title: EN - The Diplomat [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E06 - Some Lusty Tornado
1.plot: To appease Trowbridge, Kate seeks Hal's help with a high-profile visitor and consults an informed source in secret as complicated feelings begin to grow.

1.title: EN - The Diplomat [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E07 - Keep Your Enemies Closer
1.plot: After a sit-down with a Russian ambassador leads to new intel and mixed messages, Kate takes a trip to the Oval Office and reconnects with an old friend.

1.title: EN - The Diplomat [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E08 - The James Bond Clause
1.plot: In London, Hal's actions cause friction as Kate heads to Paris with Dennison to get a handle on the Lenkov situation, which soon takes a shocking turn.

2.title: EN - The Diplomat [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E01 - When a Stranger Calls
2.plot: After rushing back to London, Kate shares her suspicions about the bombing. The search is on for Lenkov — and Roylin. Eidra delivers devastating news.

2.title: EN - The Diplomat [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E02 - St. Paul's
2.plot: Eidra helps sneak an unannounced guest into Grove's funeral, Kate realizes she might have made a bad call before the bombing, and Stuart speaks his mind.

2.title: EN - The Diplomat [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E03 - The Ides of March
2.plot: A lavish Fourth of July party gives Kate a chance to help Dennison, who sees an opportunity after the prime minister's announcement about Lenkov.

2.title: EN - The Diplomat [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E04 - The Other Army
2.plot: Kate proposes a unique solution to the Roylin problem. A risky plan unfolds at the prime minister's event in Scotland. Stuart confronts his feelings.

2.title: EN - The Diplomat [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E05 - Our Lady of Immaculate Deception
2.plot: Vice President Grace Penn arrives in London with an agenda — and advice — as fallout from Roylin's bombshell affects Kate's relationship with Trowbridge.

2.title: EN - The Diplomat [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E06 - Dreadnought
2.plot: Kate puts her best foot forward after pillow talk with Hal forces her to face hard truths, and Vice President Penn offers a blunt lesson in geopolitics.

3.title: EN - The Diplomat [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S03E01 - Emperor Dead
3.plot: Amid a growing constitutional crisis, the staff scrambles to stage an impromptu inauguration, while Hal exploits the chaos behind the scenes.

3.title: EN - The Diplomat [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S03E02 - Last Dance at the Country Club
3.plot: Kate weighs a compelling offer. Eidra faces scrutiny over fallout from the Roylin debacle. Stuart pitches a proposal that goes far deeper than policy.

3.title: EN - The Diplomat [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S03E03 - The Riderless Horse
3.plot: As the nation pauses to mourn, Grace considers the framework of her administration. Private strain threatens Kate and Hal's polished public image.

3.title: EN - The Diplomat [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S03E04 - Arden
3.plot: Kate's unique role grants her access to anyone she wants — except the one person she needs. Dennison puts actionable intelligence to personal use.

3.title: EN - The Diplomat [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S03E05 - Birdwatchers
3.plot: Forced to play the perfect couple, Kate and Hal confront a looming problem in international waters and a development that could torpedo U.S. credibility.

3.title: EN - The Diplomat [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S03E06 - Amagansett
3.plot: At an emergency strategy session, Grace weighs unthinkable choices, while Kate rolls the dice on a gamble that could alter the course of history.

3.title: EN - The Diplomat [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S03E07 - PNG
3.plot: Sequestered inside Winfield House as embassies go on alert and allies fall silent, Kate and Callum race to contain a potential disaster.

3.title: EN - The Diplomat [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S03E08 - Schrodinger's Wife
3.plot: Kate must use all her leverage and political instincts to avert a catastrophe at a high-stakes summit — with the fate of nations hanging in the balance.

meta.plot: A brilliant chocolatier who's afraid of making eye contact meets an heir who can't touch others — but somehow, they're immune to each other.

1.title: EN - Romantics Anonymous [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E01 - Rainbow Palette
1.plot: Hana's mentor Kenji plans a special birthday dinner, but tragedy strikes. Meanwhile, Sosuke's big presentation falls apart when someone touches him.

1.title: EN - Romantics Anonymous [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E03 - Wasabi en Soie

1.title: EN - Romantics Anonymous [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E04 - Bonbon Sakura

1.title: EN - Romantics Anonymous [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E05 - Spécial Orangette

1.title: EN - Romantics Anonymous [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E06 - Two-way Confiserie

1.title: EN - Romantics Anonymous [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E07 - Pure Kenji
1.plot: With Le Sauveur's fate hinging on a contest, the team struggles to recreate their signature bonbon. Hana offers to help but risks exposing her secret.

1.title: EN - Romantics Anonymous [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E08 - Chocolat du Bonheur
1.plot: While Sosuke wrestles with a power struggle at Futago Confectionery, Hana faces her fears under many watchful eyes. Can they finally taste happiness?

meta.plot: A mother faces stigma and a painful separation when her husband takes their children abroad, forever changing her life.

1.title: EN - No One Saw Us Leave [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E02 - I Will Find Them

1.plot: Valeria is further ostracized after her story goes public. A bank vote decides Samuel and Moishe's futures, and Leo's new friends bring more problems.

1.title: EN - No One Saw Us Leave [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E04 - Shut Up and Dance
1.plot: Valeria and Carlos receive a surprise, and old memories resurface. Isaac and Tamara face Leo, but as secrets threaten to arise, time starts ticking.

1.title: EN - No One Saw Us Leave [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E05 - Hello, Valeria
1.plot: Leo, Isaac and Tamara adjust to a new home. In Israel, Valeria reunites with her children, but her custody battle with Leo has just begun.

1.plot: The lives of Eduardo, Silvia, Rafael and Carlinhos inevitably change when hundreds of kilos of cocaine sink off the coast near their small village.

1.title: EN - Turn of the Tide [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E02 - Supply and Demand
1.plot: Eduardo and his friends start their new shipwrecked cocaine business, but the arrival of Inspector Frias to the village complicates their venture.

1.title: EN - Turn of the Tide [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E03 - Earth Shakes
1.plot: An earthquake disturbs life in the village, but drug lord Monti is the one who turns things upside down as he tries to recover his missing cocaine.

1.title: EN - Turn of the Tide [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E04 - Loose Lips
1.plot: The business finally takes off. Frias and Monti are neck and neck in the race to find the drugs, but an incident puts a new competitor on the track.

1.title: EN - Turn of the Tide [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E05 - No One Escapes From an Island
1.plot: Eduardo and Rafael are missing. A reluctant Silvia moves in with her father, whose help is requested by Ian and Bruna when they receive a serious threat.

1.title: EN - Turn of the Tide [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E06 - The Swan Song
1.plot: The friends find refuge in Joe's hiding place while they deal with a terrible loss, but they can't run away from their misfortunes for long.

1.title: EN - Turn of the Tide [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E07 - This Is Not America
1.plot: When Joe draws up the ultimate plan for selling the drugs and escaping to the US, the friends fall apart and Eduardo's ambition is called into question.

2.title: EN - Turn of the Tide [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E01 - Home Sweet Home
2.plot: Eduardo's escape plans don't go as expected. While Sílvia harbors a secret and the drugs change hands, Inspector Frias remains focused on the Azores.

2.title: EN - Turn of the Tide [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E02 - Return of the Living Dead
2.plot: Sílvia enlists the help of Eduardo and the gang for a new operation. An unexpected comeback shocks the island, while Carlinhos struggles with pain.

2.title: EN - Turn of the Tide [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E03 - Forever Friends
2.plot: As detectives try to dig up dirt on the Italians, a Brazilian drug lord arrives in the Azores with an ultimatum that derails Eduardo's plans.

2.title: EN - Turn of the Tide [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E04 - Big Tuna
2.plot: Orlando makes a discovery that forces Sílvia to choose where her loyalty lies. As the friends hunt a buyer for Ofelia's deal, Eduardo has his own ideas.

2.title: EN - Turn of the Tide [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E05 - Throw a Rock, Hide Your Hands
2.plot: A betrayal brings fiery consequences. Sílvia convinces the gang to help with a major shipment. Inspector Frias discovers a mole in the police force.

2.title: EN - Turn of the Tide [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E06 - It's Raining Cocaine
2.plot: The friends face setbacks during the operation. Eduardo and Sílvia decide where their hearts lie as new enemies emerge and tragedy strikes again.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E01 - The Comeback
1.plot: Aarch the previous Akillian GF "Galactik Football" striker has a memory of his last football match when he takes a penalty but a freak snow and ice storm disrupts the game and the planet Akillian is left in an ice age. Aarch has come back after 15 years to make a new team and try for the GF cup. Aarch meets a few unhappy people with his return, but a bunch of teens,are excited to hear of his return. Some guys are sent to deal with Aarch and his friend clamp that very evening but their saved by the group of teens who are glad to know of his arrival.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E02 - A New Hope
1.plot: Aarch collects new Command for Galactik Football.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E03 - The Challenge
1.plot: During the tests, Aarch is convinced that Tia and the others possess the Breath of Akillian. He still has one position to fill on his team, so he visits his brother to convince him to let Rocket (Aarch's nephew) play.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E04 - The Team
1.plot: The team that Aarch has put together has been approved and is now headed for the moon of Ibo. They'll be playing a friendly match against the legendary Wamba team, whose star attacker Lun Zaera is especially dangerous.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E05 - The Captain
1.plot: Today the Snow Kids are up against the Red Tigers in a match that will decide which of the two teams is going to represent Akillian in the Galactik Football Cup. The police have taken Tia back to her parents.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E06 - Second Wind
1.plot: The Snow Kids are losing 3-0 against the Red Tigers at half-time. They have to win this match if they want to qualify. Will Tia's return be enough to turn the situation around? Not if Artegor Nexus has anything to say about it.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E07 - Coach's Pet
1.plot: The tensions among the Snow Kids are making themselves felt: Micro-Ice is trying to get closer to Mei, but she has only one thing on her mind: becoming an attacker. Worse yet, the Snow Kids have to deal with the Rykers.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E08 - The Storm
1.plot: While the Shadows-Pirates game is in full swing, Aarch looks for the captain of his team, but to no avail. Rocket has disappeared. Tia thinks she knows where he could be hiding, but an enormous snowstorm is brewing outside.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E09 - Revenge Match
1.plot: Today the Snow Kids are playing the return match against the Rykers if they lose this match, our young heroes will advance no further in the competition. Micro-Ice's thoughts, however, have turned to Mei.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E10 - The Pirates
1.plot: The Snow Kids are traveling to play another legendary team: the Pirates of Shiloe. Since the Pirates are always on the move and ready to respond to any possible attack by Technoid, anything could happen.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E11 - The Professor
1.plot: During the return match against the Pirates, Rocket is injured. Clamp is somewhat distracted as he follows the match, and who could blame him? Memories of his past work for Technoid are coming back to him.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E12 - The Escape
1.plot: While Clamp is being kidnapped by Technoid robots, Sonny escapes through the ventilation duct and winds up face to face with Micro-Ice. Everyone at Aarch Academy is very worried: Aarch searches for Clamp, who suddenly reappears.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E13 - The Striker
1.plot: Snow Kids are up against the terrifying Shadows, and Micro-Ice still has not come back. Aarch is crazed with worry how will they play the match without him. D'Jok puts the blame on Mei, saying that it's her fault that Micro-Ice has left.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E14 - Black Hole
1.plot: Micro-Ice's return is a relief to everyone, because the Snow Kids are leaving immediately for the planet Shadows to play the return match. How will the Snow Kids play successfully under these conditions against Artegor's team.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E15 - Last Chance
1.plot: It's half time in the Snow Kids-Shadows match, and our young heroes have no energy left. They let the provocations of their opponents get to them and Thran seems exhausted they're losing 3-0. Only Rocket has managed to get his second wind.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E16 - Genesis Stadium
1.plot: These new and surprising conditions excite everyone, especially Mei, who has agreed to be a spokes-model for a brand of shampoo. But Tia has other things on her mind; armed with a photo of Rocket's mother, she goes to look for her.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E17 - Get Ready
1.plot: D'Jok has become the newest rising Galactik Football star, and he and his teammates are extremely confident before their upcoming match against the Wambas. Sonny and the Pirates have discovered why MetaFlux is so extremely important.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E18 - Under Pressure
1.plot: The match against the Wambas nearly turned into a complete fiasco. D'Jok really has let fame go to this head. Mei is being pressured by her mother to film new ads. And Tia has planned a surprise party for Rocket's birthday.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E19 - The Star
1.plot: The next match the Snow Kids will be playing against the Lightnings. Clamp who is still being held in a secret Technoid laboratory is getting sicker. Bleylock offers him an antidote that will allow him to live, but demands the Meta-Flux.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E20 - Metaflux
1.plot: The Snow Kids have qualified for the semi-final and the real Clamp is back. Unfortunately, he has some very bad news to report MetaFlux can be very dangerous to the health of players that use it. also D'Jok finds out that Sonny is his dad.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E21 - The Forfeit
1.plot: Aarch and his players are in serious trouble. Without MetaFlux, our young heroes seem to be losing control of the Breath of Akillian. They have no chance of winning the match against the Technoid team.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E22 - The Missing Link
1.plot: While the Pirate chief tries to put the MetaFlux in a safe place D'Jok confesses to Micro-Ice that Sonny Blackbones is his father. D'Jok's disappearance during the second semi-final between the Shadows and the Cyclopes makes Aarch worried.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E23 - Blackmail
1.plot: While almost all the parents have come to attend the party right before the final, D'Jok isolates himself. Mei can no longer approach him, and even the Pirates cannot convince him to speak to them. D'Jok is highly preoccupied.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E24 - The Duel
1.plot: Before the final Aarch is pessimistic about his team's chances of winning D'Jok is the most troubled of all if the Snow Kids win the final his father Sonny will die Sinedd seems to know about this terrible dilemma and makes D'Jok an offer.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E25 - The Traitor
1.plot: The Snow Kids are just minutes away from the Galactik Football Cup final!. Will D'Jok really throw the game to save his father? Will Maya manage to convince him not to? Will the Pirates ally themselves with Technoid to save Sonny?

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E26 - The Cup
1.plot: Everyone in Genesis Stadium is holding their breath D'Jok is going to shoot the free kick that will tie the score in the Galactik Football Cup final D'Jok is worn out. The Pirates have just arrived where Bleylock is holding Sonny prisoner.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E01 - Return to Genesis
2.plot: Four years after their triumphant victory in the Galactik Football Cup the Snow Kids return to Genesis Stadium and prepare to do it again but all is not well with the team. Ahito has a mysterious illness and may have to return to Akillian.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E02 - The Suspension
2.plot: Rocket saves Tia's life in Genesis Forest, but to do it, he uses The Breath. Yuki becomes the new Snow Kids' goalkeeper after Addim tells Aarch of the illegal use of The Breath. Aarch has no choice but to suspend Rocket indefinitely.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E03 - A Team Reinvented
2.plot: Aarch searches for a replacement for Rocket, but it's not easy. Rocket is irreplaceable. D'Jok suggests Mark from Akillian to step in. Sinedd introduces Rocket to Netherball a dangerous one-on-one football match played inside The Sphere.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E04 - The New Captain
2.plot: Clamp tells Sonny that he saw Bleylock alive. Sonny doesn't believe it, Aarch makes D'Jok the new captain of the Snow Kids in Rocket's absence; Tia takes it badly - The "friendly" between the Snow Kids and The Shadows is very unfriendly.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E05 - The Homecoming
2.plot: The Snow Kids go home to Akillian to surprise Ahito who is there recovering from his illness. The big news is Ahito's coming back to Genesis with the Snow Kids, but he's still not ready to play.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E06 - Netherball Rules!
2.plot: Back on Genesis, Norata blames Aarch for Rocket's disappearance. Rocket plays the Rykers's star Kernor - the current Netherball champion - in a brutal one-on-one match. Will she remain in The Sphere?

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E07 - Doubts Within
2.plot: The Snow Kids go to Addim saying that Rocket should not be suspended. It's announced that D'Jok will replace Rocket on the All-Star Team but D'Jok seems a bit too happy about it Mei reminds him of the real problem Rocket is still missing.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E08 - Rocket's Descent
2.plot: Plunging into the world of Netherball, Rocket plays Woowamboo of the Wambas. Will Rocket keep control of The Sphere? Sonny tells his men they need to find Rocket. Rocket may lead them to Bleylock - if Bleyok is alive.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E09 - The All-Stars
2.plot: The Snow-Kids watch the match on the Holo-TV: the All-Stars vs. the Technodroids V3s - Luur of the Xenons is very impressive; his flux, the Heat of Xenon is one of the most powerful forces in the galaxy.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E10 - Rocket vs. Sinedd
2.plot: Against the wishes of Bleylock and Harris, Sinedd plays Rocket in a rough match of Netherball. Will Sinedd control The Sphere? The pirates Arty and Bennett follow Wolfen and Zoran into the lower levels of Genesis Stadium.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E11 - The Champions Stumble
2.plot: Harris sneaks into Addim's office and places a video file on her computer to keep Rocket playing Netherball. The League votes to delay Rocket's return to the GFC, early in the match with the Wambas, the Snow Kids are losing.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E12 - Last Stand
2.plot: The Snow Kids are trailing the Wambas at the half and the team is very depressed especially D'Jok. It looks bad for our champions suddenly Ahito comes back and subs for Yuki in the second half Aarch pushes the Snow Kids to win the match.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E13 - Fluxless
2.plot: The Shadows/Pirates match begins, Bleylock orders his robots in a spacecraft to fire a flux device at the Shadows planet causing a huge explosion the Shadows suddenly lose their flux The Pirates easily beat the Shadows 7-2.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E14 - New Order
2.plot: After the explosion on the Shadows planet, and the Pirates GF team is disqualified. Rocket plays Luur in Netherball in a wicked obstacle match. D'Jok tells Rocket that he can play GF again, but Rocket tells him he's never coming back.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E15 - Revelations
2.plot: Tia discovers that Technoid is holding her parents prisoners Mei promises to help she introduces Tia to her special friend Corso The Xenons and the Cyclops play in the quarterfinals. Luur uses his flux, the Heat of Xenon to deadly results.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E16 - New Rules
2.plot: Dame Simbai informs him that the explosion on the Shadows planet was a flux device Sonny now knows what's behind Netherball. Aarch announces the new assistant coach for the Snow Kids Artegor Nexus who putting Yuki in Tia's vacant position.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E17 - Open Doors
2.plot: Tia is taken prisoner with Sonny and his pirates aboard the Technoid prison barge. She spots her parents in a nearby cell The Snow Kids play the Rykers in the quarterfinals match but Rocket has not come back and Tia is with the pirates.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E18 - Warren Steps In
2.plot: D'Jok competes in the Big Kicks Challenge in Genesis Stadium with other GF stars. D'Jok and Mark (and secretly Tia) go back down to watch Warren play Rocket in a brutal Netherball match with obstacles can Warren beat Rocket?

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E19 - The Technodroid V3s
2.plot: The Lightnings and the Technodroids V3s battle it out in their quarterfinals match. Yuki warms up to Micro-Ice to his shock. But they're late for practice again. D'Jok goes down to play Rocket in Netherball, but someone steps in his way.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E20 - The Fallen Star
2.plot: Tia bravely enters the Netherball Sphere to play Rocket but Rocket's too far gone. He's too wrapped up in the sport to know it's even her. Rocket plays harder than ever. Can Rocket be beaten? Will Tia survive the match?

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E21 - Coach Artegor
2.plot: The Snow Kids are thrilled to have Rocket back but Rocket is shocked to see Artegor coaching. After the Shadow's flux returns Artegor gets his wish The Shadow play the Xenons in their semifinals match can Shadows beat the invincible Xenons

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E22 - Rocket, the Midfielder
2.plot: Against Maya's wishes D'Jok plays in the Snow Kids semifinals match with the Lightnings. But on the pitch, Ahito falters could he still be sick As halftime approaches the Snow Kids are trailing Aarch is not sure that his team wants to win.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E23 - Destiny
2.plot: It's the second half of the semifinals match between the Snow Kids and the Lightnings and the Snow Kids are losing 2-0. Rocket rallies the team to everyone's surprise, and thanks to D'Jok's great idea, the Snow Kids fight back.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E24 - Final Preparations
2.plot: Sonny finds Bleylock in an alley. Now Sonny knows Bleylock's true intentions to destroy Genesis Stadium Snow kids parents are at Genesis expecting a night out with their children however the Snow Kids have their own plans.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E25 - A Team Unravels
2.plot: Cup finals fever has hit Genesis Stadium despite the Snow Kids being the current champions the odds are on the Xenons and their power flux the Heat of Xenon meanwhile Arty and Bennett find Bleylock but lose the flux devices in Luna Genesis

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E26 - Bleylock's Revenge
2.plot: Snow Kids play the second half time against Xenons D'Jok manages to tie the result to 2:2. Meanwhile, The Pirates chase Bleylock Can Snow Kids beat Xenons Harris is shown placing a flux device saying that one day they will rule the galaxy.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E01 - Stars in Danger
3.plot: The Snow Kids are on Akillian practicing for their upcoming friendly match against the Shadows. But they play without conviction. When explosions at Genesis Stadium sever the contact with Mei who was participating from a distance.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E02 - The Break-Up

meta.plot: Cette série met en scène l'histoire d'une jeune équipe de football futuriste, les Snow Kids, qui va essayer de gagner la Galactik Football Cup pour leur planète Akillian, après s'être faite recruter par une ancienne légende du football. Mais pour ce faire, ils devront faire face à de nombreuses équipes bien plus aguerries que la leur comme les Shadows, les Lightnings ou les Wambas, et devront s'imposer comme la meilleure équipe. On suit alors leurs débuts de joueurs, de l'anonymat à la célébrité et leur évolution aussi bien dans le football que dans leur vie privée.

1.plot: While litigating on behalf of an inmate locked up on a robbery charge, Aaron is torn between doing what's right and what's best for his case. 1.title: FR - For Life - S01E06 - Burner
1.plot: Aaron confronts O'Reilly in court, targeting the search warrant used in Aaron's arrest and the DA's failure to disclose a confidential informant. Maskins arranges for a dangerous inmate, Cassius Dawkins, to be transferred to Bellmore in hopes that he'll cause problems for Safiya and Aaron.

1.plot: Aaron struggles to balance the demands of his own case with the needs of an inmate who's fighting for the right to marry his dying girlfriend. Safiya defies the prison board, effectively jeopardizing Anya's campaign as well as their marriage.

1.plot: Aaron pushes to represent longtime inmate Easley Barton, hoping that winning this 23-year-old case against Maskins will strengthen his own. 1.title: FR - For Life - S01E10 - Character and Fitness

2.title: FR - For Life - S02E03 - The Necessity Defense

2.title: FR - For Life - S02E04 - Time to Move Forward

Meanwhile, Jasmine begins to spend more time at Ronnie's house and Marie grapples with the first signs of an empty nest.

2.title: FR - For Life - S02E06 - 354
2.plot: After an urgent call from Bellmore concerning the growing COVID-19 pandemic, Aaron enlists Safiya’s help and heads back to the prison to investigate. Meanwhile Marie faces a choice: Expose her family to the virus or go all-in at the hospital.

2.title: FR - For Life - S02E07 - Say His Name
2.plot: Aaron takes on the case of an unarmed man shot by a police officer. Safiya represents Ronnie after he’s arrested and roughed up by law enforcement, and the family struggles with whether to have Aaron Jr. baptized.

2.title: FR - For Life - S02E08 - For the People
2.plot: Aaron faces pressure from all sides when he is forced to decide which charges to bring against the officers responsible for the killing of an unarmed civilian. 2.title: FR - For Life - S02E09 - The Blue Wall
2.plot: With Aaron and Marie facing threats from an increasingly hostile community, Aaron and his team double down by pursuing criminal charges against a high-ranking police officer they believe tried to cover up the shooting.

2.title: FR - For Life - S02E10 - Andy Josiah
2.plot: Aaron and his legal team face their toughest trial yet as they prosecute the police officer responsible for the killing of an innocent, unarmed Black man.

meta.plot: Accusé à tort de meurtre et envoyé en prison à vie, Aaron devient avocat depuis sa cellule et se sert de sa nouvelle occupation pour aider ses compagnons, mais aussi pour prouver son innocence. Sa quête de liberté est motivée par son désir de retrouver sa famille et de récupérer la vie qui lui a été arrachée. Injustement condamné, le détenu va devoir se heurter aux limites du système judiciaire.
