3.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S03E01 - Beneath these Streets
3.plot: The Turtles learn the cost of slacking off when Splinter is badly hurt during a confrontation with Shredder.

3.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S03E02 - Turtles On Trial
3.plot: The intentions of the Ninja Turtles are put to the test when a controversial TV-figure portrays our heroes as menaces to society.

3.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S03E03 - Attack of the 50-Foot Irma
3.plot: Irma accidentally becomes gigantic and her naturally clumsy nature makes her a danger to the city.

3.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S03E04 - The Maltese Hamster
3.plot: Gangsters are swiping all the antiques in town. And when they swipe most of our heroes, it's up to Donatello and April to find out why. Could Shredder be behind this?

3.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S03E05 - Sky Turtles
3.plot: The Turtles go flying when the Shredder invents a gravity-altering device.

3.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S03E06 - The Old Switcheroo
3.plot: The personalities of Shredder and Splinter are switched when a device is accidentally activated during a battle between the Turtles and their enemies. As Shredder plans the Turtles' demise and Splinter plans on how to get back to his body, everyone else is clueless.

3.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S03E07 - Burne's Blues
3.plot: In the middle of a summer heat wave, someone is destroying all the air conditioners and taking all the city's freon. In the meantime, Vernon and Burne go looking for the Turtles, but find something else.

3.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S03E08 - The Fifth Turtle
3.plot: A 14-year-old boy tries his best to help out the Turtles, but with some not so optimal results.

3.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S03E09 - Enter: The Rat King
3.plot: Thompson assigns April to research the growing rat infestation. She is pursued by an army of rats and escapes on a passing city bus.

3.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S03E10 - Turtles at the Earth's Core
3.plot: Dinosaurs invade the Big Apple. Befriending a young diplodocus the Turtles trace the invading dinosaurs to their source finding a lost world.

3.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S03E11 - April Fool
3.plot: Emperor Aleister of Malicuria comes to New York City, bringing along a shard of Lydium 90 to the USA.

3.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S03E12 - Attack of the Big MACC
3.plot: A robot warrior arrives from 400 years in the future in 20th-Century New York.

3.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S03E13 - The Ninja Sword of Nowhere
3.plot: Krang's computers detect an alien metal on the surface of the Earth. Krang sends Shredder, along with an Alien Metal Detector, to the surface to find it.

3.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S03E14 - 20.000 Leaks Under the City
3.plot: Still searching for a way to destroy the Turtles, Krang develops a super pump that he intends to use to flood the sewers.

3.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S03E15 - Take Me to Your Leader
3.plot: Full of self doubt, Leonardo leaves the team. Michaelangelo, Raphael, and Donatello all take turns being leader as they try to figure out why the sun is getting smaller.

3.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S03E16 - Four Musketurtles
3.plot: A bump on the head leaves Leonardo thinking that he is in 17th century France, and that he and his comrades are Musketeers.

3.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S03E17 - Turtles, Turtles Everywhere
3.plot: Shredder programs the city's new garbage collecting super-computer to collect the Turtles. But when Shredder doesn't specify 'Ninja' Turtles, the super-computer collects them all! Turtles of the city of every shape and size are not safe.

3.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S03E18 - Cowabunga Shredhead
3.plot: The Shredder thinks he's Michaelangelo after a computer malfunction.

3.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S03E19 - Invasion of the Turtle Snatchers
3.plot: Aliens abduct Donatello and Rocksteady.

3.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S03E20 - Camera Bugged
3.plot: A visit to Earth from a Polarisoid results in havoc when Shredder comes into possession of the alien's camera, because it does more than just take pictures.

3.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S03E21 - Green with Jealousy
3.plot: Krang sets his sights on a powerful Nuclear-Powered Submarine, believing it's fuel will be more than enough to power the technodrome.

3.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S03E22 - Return of the Fly
3.plot: Baxter Stockman returns for revenge against the Turtles and Shredder, while our heroes attempt to stop Shredder's plan to siphon water from an underground reservoir.

3.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S03E23 - Casey Jones: Outlaw Hero
3.plot: An eager vigilante is causing a stir in the city, while Krang and Shredder take control of all the machines in the city. Maybe this new 'hero' can help the Turtles.

3.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S03E24 - Mutagen Monster
3.plot: In an attempt to hijack two separate trains carrying the ingredients needed to make mutagen, Rocksteady and Bebop cause their head-on collision, resulting in the spillage of both chemicals in the city's train yard.

3.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S03E25 - Corporate Raiders from Dimension X
3.plot: High ranking corporate executives are kidnapped by men in business suits. The Turtles don't get involved until they learn that one of these corporations is the world's largest suppliers of pizza.

3.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S03E26 - Pizza by the Shred
3.plot: Michaelangelo gets a job as a pizza delivery boy. But who's his new boss?

4.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S04E01 - Plan Six From Outer Space
4.plot: With the Technodrome in serious need for new equipment, Bebop and Rocksteady are sent to Earth, disguised in human form, to capture the Channel 6 building and return it to Dimension X.

4.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S04E02 - Turtles of the Jungle
4.plot: A professor's new ray-gun causes plants to go wild and his pet ape Jocko to become a giant rampaging monkey. By using the same ray-gun, Donatello is increased to Jocko's size so he can fight the giant ape and save April from him.

4.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S04E03 - Michaelangelo Toys Around
4.plot: While trying to see the new toys at the Toy Fair, Michaelangelo stumbles upon a plot to take over a noted toy company.

4.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S04E04 - Peking Turtle
4.plot: The Turtles must battle a reanimated Terracotta Army after Shredder steals an energy device shaped like a giant pearl, which is held and guarded by a Jade Dragon.

4.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S04E05 - Shredder's Mom
4.plot: New York is in the middle of an induced heat wave caused by Shredder, who must battle the Turtles and deal with his mother, Miyoko Saki, at the same time.

4.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S04E06 - Four Turtles and a Baby
4.plot: When General Tragg and his troops attack the Neutrino capital, the Neutrino leaders, Zenter and Gizzla, send their infant daughter Tribble through a portal to Earth, asking the Turtles to look after her, but Tribble causes big trouble for our heroes.

4.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S04E07 - Turtlemaniac
4.plot: An eccentric billionaire, Monroe Q. Flem, who is also a collector, wishes to collect every piece of TMNT memorabilia that he can get his evil hands on, including April and the Turtles themselves.

4.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S04E08 - Rondo in New York
4.plot: Shredder, Bebop, and Rocksteady are in town to steal a rare new mutagen created by Oswald Dren, a grad student. Some mutagen is accidentally spilled onto a reel of movie film causing monsters to come to life.

4.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S04E09 - Planet of the Turtles
4.plot: The Turtles must save the Earth from a massive energy drain and its Apocalyptic result by traveling to another dimension where turtles are the dominant species.

4.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S04E10 - Name That Toon
4.plot: A Technodrome computer disguised as an electronic keyboard ends up on Earth, and in the most unlikely of hands.

4.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S04E11 - Menace, Maestro Please
4.plot: The Turtles must contend with the "Phantom of the Floxy" while trying to hinder Shredder's latest plan to bring the Technodrome back to earth.

4.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S04E12 - Superhero for a Day
4.plot: Gadget Man comes out of retirement after 50 years, but is tricked by Shredder into fighting against the Turtles.

4.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S04E13 - Back to the Egg
4.plot: Krang hires a multi-dimentional ring-master who intends on making the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles part of his circus by using an anti-aging serum.

4.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S04E14 - Son of Return of the Fly II
4.plot: Vengeful Baxter Stockman and an A.I. computer return to Earth from a dimentional limbo and capture the Turtles while luring Shredder into their trap as well.

4.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S04E15 - Raphael Knocks 'em Dead
4.plot: Raphael must contend with a mobster named Pinky McFingers when he is kidnapped from a local comedy club.

4.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S04E16 - Bebop and Rocksteady Conquer the Universe
4.plot: On their latest trip to Earth, Bebop and Rocksteady steal a machine that makes everyone scared of everything.

4.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S04E17 - Raphael Meets His Match
4.plot: Raphael wins a ticket to a costume party on MacDonald Crump's yacht and decides to go disguised as a Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtle.

4.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S04E18 - Slash the Evil Turtle from Dimension X
4.plot: Bebop and Rocksteady use Krang's new Mutagen on Bebop's pet turtle Slash so he can do their housework for them. Slash runs away and is conned by an irritated entrepreneur into framing the TMNT.

4.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S04E19 - Leonardo Lightens Up
4.plot: A ray-gun makes Leonardo carefree and ignore his responsibilities. This leaves the Turtles defenseless and the city at the mercy of Maestro G Clef, a villain who destroys the city with music.

4.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S04E20 - Were-Rats from Channel 6
4.plot: After many failed attempts from his rodent subjects to find food, the Rat King learns of an abandoned canister of mutagen lost in the sewers and claims it for himself.

4.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S04E21 - Funny, They Shrunk Michaelangelo
4.plot: While Michaelangelo is testing out a sailboard in the sewers he accidentally gets swept out into the city harbor.

4.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S04E22 - The Big Zipp Attack
4.plot: Krang sends Shredder, Bebop and Rocksteady to find Rigidium to repair the Technodrome. A meteorite lands containing a large egg. The egg hatches, revealing a Zipp, a cute little creature that begins to eat the Technodrome.

4.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S04E23 - Donatello Makes Time
4.plot: Professor Lloyd Cycloyd, a crazy scientist who escaped from an institution, accidentally discovers the Turtles' lair. He sees Donatello testing out one of his new inventions, a time stopper.

4.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S04E24 - Farewell, Lotus Blossum
4.plot: While on their way to a movie, the Turtles rescue the Urn of Chakahachi from two thieves. The thieves pry off a pearl from the Urn before the Turtles get their hands on it.

4.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S04E25 - Rebel Without a Fin
4.plot: Dr. Polidorius creates a half-man half-fish named Ray. The Doctor has Ray plant explosives in certain parts of the sewer so that he can sink the city beneath the ocean.

4.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S04E26 - Rhino-Man
4.plot: J. Gordon Hungerdunger, a Texas millionaire, is holding a best super-hero contest. The winner of the contest will receive the humongous Malaprop Diamond.

meta.plot: Les Tortues Ninja sont quatre petites tortues qui deviennent humanoïdes, à la suite d'un contact avec une étrange substance chimique rose, le mutagène. Splinter, un maître en arts martiaux transformé en rat à la suite d'une mutation similaire, va les accueillir dans les égouts de la ville de New York et leur enseigner le Ninjutsu, l'art des ninjas. Ils vont ensuite faire la rencontre d'une journaliste nommée April O'Neil, qui va les aider à lutter contre la bande de Shredder, un méchant qui se cache derrière un masque de fer.
Elite athletes from Asia engage in a gripping test of physical prowess, fiercely battling for national pride. In the end, only one flag will claim victory.

1.title: EN - Physical: Asia [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E01 - Where the Sun Rises
1.plot: Forty-eight contestants from eight countries arrive and the teams size each other up. At last, the curtain rises on the first quest.

1.title: EN - Physical: Asia [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E02 - On The Brink
1.plot: Athletes race, push and grapple atop a sinking slope. After grueling, deadlocked matches, two countries face off without making any concessions.

1.title: EN - Physical: Asia [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E03 - Shipwreck
1.plot: One nation claims a powerful privilege. In their test of speed and teamwork, players race through a giant shipwreck across a rugged obstacle course.

1.title: EN - Physical: Asia [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E04 - Desperate Prayer
1.plot: After a wild, intense race through the shipwreck, the next quest unfolds in a new arena — where the results from the previous match are crucial.

1.title: EN - Physical: Asia [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E05 - Mysterious Village
1.plot: Players tap into their sports skills for battle. As the third quest looms, teams prepare to pick formidable reps as each win rides on smart match-ups.

1.title: EN - Physical: Asia [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E06 - Insurmountable Wall
1.plot: Racing against time and heavy loads, teams face more than a contest  —  it's a true test of endurance. Losing teams must break their own torsos right away.

1.title: EN - Physical: Asia [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E07 - For the Homeland
1.plot: In a seemingly endless game, one contestant demonstrates extraordinary ease and skill in the hanging game. Can the other competitor win by imitation?

1.title: EN - Physical: Asia [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E08 - Formidable Foe
1.plot: No mistakes are permitted as time continues to run out. With only half the teams left, the results of an early poll return to haunt the contestants.

1.title: EN - Physical: Asia [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E09 - Inescapable Hell
1.plot: This brutal challenge demands arm strength, tenacity, speed and precision. One team catches their competitors off guard with a surprise move.

1.title: EN - Physical: Asia [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E10 - Charge
1.plot: Shackles. Giant pillars. Iron balls. The teams are summoned to a hellish game where mental endurance is more important than ever.

1.title: EN - Physical: Asia [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E11 - Impenetrable Fortress
1.plot: Teams give their all in a grueling test of stamina and tactics. As daunting challenges push them to the limit, who will endure and make it to the end?

1.title: EN - Physical: Asia [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E12 - All-Out Battle
1.plot: As exhaustion and determination peak, the finalists enter the arena for an intense all-out battle. The victor will claim glory and a hefty cash prize.

1.title: FR - The Asset (2025) - S01E01 - Building the Legend
1.plot: When a police informant following a drug smuggler is murdered, an inexperienced cadet is enlisted to go undercover and get the details of the next drop.

1.title: FR - The Asset (2025) - S01E02 - Back from Dubai
1.plot: Ashley attends a soirée held by Sara, and Miran voices his suspicions about the women's new-found friendship. Folke requests a warrant for a wiretap.

1.title: FR - The Asset (2025) - S01E03 - Blood and Balloons
1.plot: An abrupt message from Ashley forces Sara to try a new tactic. Meanwhile, Miran pitches an idea for a different kind of collaboration with the jeweler.

1.title: FR - The Asset (2025) - S01E04 - Nowhere to Run
1.plot: After a somber gathering, Miran makes a proposition to his family. Sara's diamond-grading skills — and her friendship with Ashley — are put to the test.

1.title: FR - The Asset (2025) - S01E05 - Into the Deep
1.plot: The pressure mounts on Miran after unexpected visitors arrive, and Folke steps out of the shadows. A concerned Tea wrestles with her conscience.

1.title: FR - The Asset (2025) - S01E06 - What Was Your Name Again?
1.plot: Folke makes Ashley an enticing offer at an impossible price. Trying to help her friend, Tea comes face-to-face with the last person she wants to see.

meta.plot: Pour infiltrer un réseau criminel, une jeune policière se lie d'amitié avec la femme d'un narcotrafiquant. Mais plus elle se rapproche de sa cible, plus sa mission se complique.

Lorsqu’une enfant disparaît après l’explosion d’une maison, une voisine inquiète et une détective privée font équipe pour la retrouver. À mesure que les masques tombent et qu’un complot militaire se dessine, c’est un véritable chaos qui s’abat sur la paisible banlieue d’Oxford.

1.title: FR - Down Cemetery Road - S01E01 - Almost True
1.plot: A catastrophic event upends South Oxford. Sarah grows suspicious of the emergency response. While investigating, she encounters Zoë Boehm.

1.title: FR - Down Cemetery Road - S01E02 - A Kind of Grief
1.plot: Zoë goes digging for answers as Sarah starts to spiral. Hamza is under pressure to keep a lid on the crisis.

1.title: FR - Down Cemetery Road - S01E03 - Filthy Work
1.plot: Sarah winds up on an unexpected road trip. Zoë begins pulling threads left behind by Joe and suspects something bigger is at play.

1.title: FR - Down Cemetery Road - S01E04 - My Friends Don't Like Me
1.plot: While hiding out, Sarahs learns more about Downey. Zoë ruffles feathers as she seeks new collaborators for her investigation.

1.title: FR - Down Cemetery Road - S01E05 - Slow Dying
1.plot: Zoë makes a startling discovery that expands the scale of the conspiracy. Sarah and Downey trek north, revealing their pasts along the way.

1.title: FR - Down Cemetery Road - S01E06 - Neglected Waters
1.plot: A dangerous game of cat and mouse begins on the train to Scotland. Sarah and Zoë try piecing together Dinah's exact location.

1.title: FR - Down Cemetery Road - S01E07 - Lights Go Out
1.plot: Downey and Amos converge as the race to find Dinah reaches a breaking point. Sarah must take a leap of faith.

1.title: FR - Down Cemetery Road - S01E08 - What Will Survive
1.plot: Everything Sarah has fought for hangs in the balance.

1.title: FR - Ça : Bienvenue à Derry - S01E01 - The Pilot
1.plot: As four misfit kids vow to find their missing classmate, Major Leroy Hanlon arrives to a mixed reception at Derry Air Force Base.

1.title: FR - Ça : Bienvenue à Derry - S01E02 - The Thing in the Dark
1.plot: After joining Leroy at their new house in Derry, Charlotte is left with a strange feeling while running errands in town, and Will is teased on his first day of school. Later, Lilly faces pressure from all sides about what really happened at the movie theater, and Ronnie worries about her father's fate.

1.title: FR - Ça : Bienvenue à Derry - S01E03 - Now You See It
1.plot: When a major find yields few clues, General Shaw pushes ahead with his top-secret mission, ordering Leroy and Pauly to escort Dick Hallorann on an aerial search for a new dig site. Meanwhile, Rose attends a tribal meeting about the military presence in Derry, and Ronnie, Lilly, Will, and Rich attempt to get visual proof by conjuring an Orixá.

1.title: FR - Ça : Bienvenue à Derry - S01E04 - The Great Swirling Apparatus of Our Planet's Function
1.plot: As the kids face increasingly terrifying experiences, Charlotte attempts to advocate for Hank, and General Shaw escalates his efforts.

1.title: FR - Ça : Bienvenue à Derry - S01E05 - Neibolt Street
1.plot: Leroy moves his family to the base for safety. While the tribal Keepers strategize how to contain increased aggression in town, the military descends on Neibolt Street, and the kids head into the sewers with their own objective.

1.title: FR - Ça : Bienvenue à Derry - S01E06 - In the Name of the Father
1.plot: Dick is plagued by increasingly dark visions. Will faces his parents' disapproval, Marge stands up to the Patty Cakes, and Lilly's behavior grows erratic.

1.title: FR - Ça : Bienvenue à Derry - S01E07 - The Black Spot
1.plot: A vigilante attack on the Black Spot unleashes long dormant forces. In the aftermath, Dick helps uncover another crucial artifact.

1.title: FR - Ça : Bienvenue à Derry - S01E08 - Winter Fire
1.plot: As a dense fog engulfs the town – and General Shaw pushes ahead with his mission – the Hanlons, Rose, Dick, and the kids must work together to save Derry.

meta.plot: Des événements étranges se déroulent dans la ville de Derry dans les années 1960 liés à Pennywise le clown, un personnage mystérieux qui hante Derry.
Un étudiant affronte les défis de la vie et de l'université tout en tentant de gérer une situation délicate : sa coloc est une ravissante ex-star de K-pop.

1.title: FR - Doona ! - S01E01 - An Unexpected Twist
1.plot: College student Lee Won-jun moves into a sharehouse, and meets a beautiful yet strangely familiar housemate — but they get off on the wrong foot.

1.title: FR - Doona ! - S01E02 - Getting to Know Each Other
1.plot: Gradually, Lee Doona gets acquainted with Won-jun’s social circle. He later celebrates Doona's birthday, attempting to get to know her better.

1.title: FR - Doona ! - S01E03 - Spring Breeze
1.plot: Alone in her room, Doona feels unsafe — like she's being watched. Won-jun and Kim Jin-ju go out to see the cherry blossoms, but it starts to pour.

1.title: FR - Doona ! - S01E04 - The Unexpected
1.plot: Won-jun and Doona grab a late-night meal, experiencing their first paparazzi moment. Much to his disdain, Won-jun accidentally reunites with an old foe.

1.title: FR - Doona ! - S01E05 - Meaningless Kiss
1.plot: A confused Won-jun confronts Doona about the sudden kiss. New housemates move into the sharehouse, making the place livelier than ever.

1.title: FR - Doona ! - S01E06 - Twilight Zone
1.plot: Doona secretly visits Dream Sweet’s showcase event. Later, she invites Won-jun on a spontaneous trip to her childhood home.

1.title: FR - Doona ! - S01E07 - Clear the Air
1.plot: After the return of a person from her past, Doona makes a rash decision. Won-jun later confronts Doona in a moment of pain and frustration.

1.title: FR - Doona ! - S01E08 - Typical and Ordinary
1.plot: As Won-jun and Doona's relationship flourishes, a chance at a comeback comes knocking on Doona's door — but so do the tough choices.

1.title: FR - Doona ! - S01E09 - Doona!
1.plot: Won-jun moves into a new apartment and focuses on his studies. Meanwhile, Doona's career soars as she finds newfound confidence.

meta.plot: À Rio, un jeune homme rêve de devenir le baron du jeu clandestin, sans se douter qu'il devra pour cela affronter trahison, luxure et bains de sang.

1.title: FR - Maîtres du jeu [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Profeta
1.plot: Profeta devises a risky scheme to increase his influence in the gambling world. A wedding party serves as the backdrop for secret deals and partnerships.

1.title: FR - Maîtres du jeu [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - All in
1.plot: After a dangerous encounter with Búfalo, Profeta makes a bold promise. Meanwhile, Leila draws a French investor into a double-edged alliance.

1.title: FR - Maîtres du jeu [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Hustlers and Fools
1.plot: Profeta and Mirna scheme around Búfalo's slot machines, raising Suzana's suspicions. At a family barbecue, old tensions and unusual bonds surface.

1.title: FR - Maîtres du jeu [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Pyramid
1.plot: Politicians debate licensing the illegal lottery. Suzana plots against Profeta and Mirna, and a violent night threatens to unravel everything.

1.title: FR - Maîtres du jeu [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - The Nest and the Cage
1.plot: As Profeta's fate hangs in the balance, secrets from Leila's past resurface. Meanwhile, Mirna goes to great lengths to justify her actions to the board.

1.title: FR - Maîtres du jeu [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - Turf War
1.plot: Mirna and Profeta sign a deal. A samba school rehearsal erupts in violence, and someone close to Profeta's family learns the cost of betrayal.

1.title: FR - Maîtres du jeu [VOSTFR] - S01E07 - Treacherous Beast
1.plot: Búfalo and Profeta are summoned by the board. A funeral descends into terror, while a carnival ball sets the stage for carnage.

1.title: FR - Maîtres du jeu [VOSTFR] - S01E08 - The Board
1.plot: The board meets to decide Profeta's future. Xavier maneuvers Santiago into leading the samba school and long-buried secrets finally come to light.

meta.plot: Fêtarde à Manchester, la vie de Gemma bascule après une rencontre en vacances qui la laisse enceinte. Elle doit gérer sa grossesse tout en soutenant son père Malcolm, dévasté par l’échec de son mariage.

1.title: FR - Papa a Problèmes - S01E01 - Happy Tears
1.plot: When Gemma discovers she is pregnant, she only has her hapless father for support. Malcolm, a sweet man in crisis, must learn to rebuild his life and his relationship with Gemma.

1.title: FR - Papa a Problèmes - S01E02 - Normal Men
1.plot: Gemma tries to reconnect with the girls from school after a chance encounter with Cherry. Malcolm is encouraged to find a normal friend after Derek introduces him to close-up magic

1.title: FR - Papa a Problèmes - S01E03 - Sugar Daddies
1.plot: After receiving dodgy life advice from those around her, Gemma enlists Cherry to help find a potential father for her unborn child. Meanwhile, Malcolm finds love with a woman online

1.title: FR - Papa a Problèmes - S01E04 - Garden Sliders
1.plot: Gemma tries birthing classes but resorts to asking her aunt Jess for advice. Malcolm and Gemma get invited to Jess and Tyrone’s hot tub party, but Malcolm is scared of hot tubs!

1.title: FR - Papa a Problèmes - S01E05 - Man Mess
1.plot: Gemma bumps into an old flame and agrees to a date. Derek hatches a plan for Malcolm to retrieve his belongings from his old family house, so Malcolm invites Gemma’s new man along.

1.title: FR - Papa a Problèmes - S01E06 - Sadie
1.plot: Malcolm throws Gemma a baby shower, and Derek surprises Malcolm with a birthday present. Xander discovers Gemma in labour, whilst Malcolm and Derek are locked in an escape room.

meta.plot: Marie, Caroline, Sébastien, Arnaud, Grégory, Stéphane et David forment le groupe des autoproclamés "Potages" (contraction de "potes" et "otages"). Le soir du 13 novembre 2015, ils ont fait face aux terroristes pendant plus de deux heures dans un étroit couloir du Bataclan. De leur survie miraculeuse est né un lien unique et indéfectible.

4.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S04E01 - 15 Chefs Compete
4.plot: Season four begins with 15 hopefuls playing to win a job as a chef along side Gordon Ramsey in his L.A. restaurant. The contestants will be divided into teams of 'men vs. women' after preparing their signature dish. Gordon will be impressed by most of the entries, but one will make him retch.

4.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S04E02 - 14 Chefs Compete
4.plot: The season's first challenge finds the contestants slicing halibut into thin 6 ounce fillets. One member of each team must serve as a maitre d' during the dining service, and one contestant will be eliminated at the shows conclusion.

4.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S04E03 - 13 Chefs Compete
4.plot: Live chickens awaken the contestants, followed by a challenge of plucking their morning "wake up callers" and creating a family styled dinner out of them.

4.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S04E04 - 12 Chefs Compete
4.plot: The two teams must compete to see who can prepare the most pasta for the evening dinner service, with a trip to Santa Monica for the winners. One contestant winds up in the hospital after an accident in the kitchen.

4.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S04E05 - 11 Chefs Compete
4.plot: The chefs receive their first challenge, create a gourmet pizza. The winning team will head to Santa Barbara for a gourmet meal, while the losers will be sentenced to taking pizza orders during dinner service and then deliver them, at which one contestant is rushed to the hospital after suffering an accident.

4.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S04E06 - 10 Chefs Compete
4.plot: A fantasy birthday celebration is the order of the day for the remaining aspiring chefs. The chefs cook for a sweet 16 party, but the mood in Hell's Kitchen is anything but sweet. One chef must face Ramsay's wrath when a diner sends back undercooked meat. And in a surprise twist, a new chef joins one of the teams at the episode's elimination ceremony.

4.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S04E07 - 9 Chefs Compete
4.plot: The nine remaining chefs are challenged to compete in a taste test, with the winner receiving a day at the spa and the losers sent to clean the dorm. Once the dinner ervice is completed, Chef Ramsay must decide on which tastes worse, raw food or a lack or communication within the kitchen.

4.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S04E08 - 8 Chefs Compete
4.plot: The group dynamics are drastically changed when Chef Ramsey asks for a volunteer to switch sides. This week's challenge consists of creating 4 new dishes from 20 ingredients. One chef requires a medic after injuring himself during the challenge.

4.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S04E09 - 7 Chefs Compete
4.plot: A relay race puts both teams to the test, with a sunny reward on the line. To up the stakes, the losing team faces a top-to-bottom complete restaurant cleaning. At the evening's dinner service, the teams are required to serve items from menus that they each created. One chef is called out for serving a disgusting extra ingredient in the food -- their own sweat. Chef Ramsay makes an unprecedented move at the evening's elimination.

4.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S04E10 - 6 Chefs Compete
4.plot: The two teams are combined to create a single team. Each chef is asked to create a dish designed specifically to please Chef Ramsay centered around a single main ingredient. The new unified team struggles to complete its first service together. Two chefs scheme together to plot another's downfall. The winner of the challenge is invited on a very special trip -- a visit to Vegas and a meeting with Rock Harper, the winner of the show's third season. The show's medics are put the test when things once again get a little too hot. One chef goes ballistic when the pressure of the evening's dinner service gets to be just a bit too much.

4.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S04E11 - 5 Chefs Compete
4.plot: The aspiring chefs teach the art of gourmet meat preparation to housewives, with the winner of the challenge given one-on-one time with chefs Mark Peel and Ben Ford. The chefs later struggle to complete their most complicated dinner service yet.

4.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S04E12 - 4 Chefs Compete
4.plot: Dinner service reaches a new low when one chef burns Chef Ramsay's hand. A group of special guests pays a visit to Hell's Kitchen. The remaining chefs face what is said to be their toughest challenge yet.

4.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S04E13 - 3 Chefs Compete
4.plot: The pressure is at an absolute boiling point as the three chefs remaining try their hardest to reach the final two. Chef Ramsay brings in a group of surprise guests whom serve each the aspiring chefs a breakfast they must then attempt to recreate. Each of the remaining chefs is given a chance at running the hot plate, but must face tests designed by Chef Ramsay.

4.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S04E14 - 2 Chefs Compete
4.plot: The final two chefs must prepare their signature dishes in New York City. They are then asked to create their own restaurant as a test of their skill. Featuring a special guest appearance by Whoopi Goldberg.

4.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S04E15 - Winner Announced
4.plot: The two finalists are faced with the ultimate test at the final dinner service when they must work together with previously eliminated chefs; the winner of the fourth season of the program is determined.

5.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S05E01 - Day 1
5.plot: The fifth season begins with Hell's Kitchen's most promising group yet: sixteen professional chefs competing for a position at the Borgata in Atlantic City. After Chef Ramsay judges their signature dishes, they face the pressure of the first dinner service, and one must face the ignominy of being the first sent packing.

5.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S05E02 - Day 2
5.plot: Chef Ramsey puts the Red and Blue teams in a new challenge, which causes tempers to flare and will result in the dismissal of one more contestant.

5.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S05E03 - Day 3
5.plot: The contestants go to a meat locker to learn different cuts of beef. The teams race to impress chef Ramsay when they are asked to put their new found knowledge to the test.

5.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S05E04 - Day 4
5.plot: 50 young football players and cheerleaders will be served breakfast by the 13 remaining chefs. One team runs short on eggs, and 1 more chef is released.

5.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S05E05 - Day 5
5.plot: After sending the chefs to an Asian market, Chef Ramsay challenges them to create three Asian-fusion dishes utilizing poultry, seafood and beef. The teams then present their dishes for judging by Chef Ramsay and Tanya Steel, Editor-in-Chief of Epicurious.com. The following night, the teams go head-to-head at dinner service, and tensions run high as chefs from both teams crack under pressure. Chef Ramsay throws in a last-minute twist before sending the losing chef home.

5.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S05E06 - Day 6
5.plot: The remaining 11 chefs are challenged to cook variations of the three favorite foods of the honoree for his Bar Mitzvah. The dinner service seems to go well, but not for one contestant.

5.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S05E07 - Day 7
5.plot: Chef Ramsay challenges the teams to create delicious tapas style, or small portioned, dishes out of left-overs. At dinner service, one chef's performance nearly takes both teams down and the lack of unity on the Blue Team leaves Chef Ramsay fuming.

5.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S05E08 - Day 8
5.plot: Chef Ramsay challenges the team's palates in a blind taste testing. In a packed dinner service, anxiety is higher than usual when celebrities Eric McCormack and Robert Patrick stop by.

5.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S05E09 - Day 9
5.plot: Each team member is asked to create a dish using King Crab, but only one dish can be selected to represent them in front of Chef Ramsay. Both teams have a chance to show off the creativity in the kitchen when they get to create their own menus for dinner service, but internal conflicts cause chaos in the kitchens.

5.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S05E10 - Day 10
5.plot: The six remaining chefs are on their own now that Chef Ramsey has dissolved the teams. This week's challenge is for the chefs to use 14 simple ingredients in a dish. Later, the chefs will once again need to work as one for dinner service, but things heat up and one chef finds themselves in need of medical attention.

5.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S05E11 - Day 11
5.plot: Chef Ramsay sends the remaining chefs off to New Jersey to dine in the Borgata Hotel Casino and Spa, where one of them will be running a restaurant. When the chefs return, they are asked to create their signature dish which they would serve in their restaurant should they win.

5.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S05E12 - Day 12
5.plot: The chef's taste buds are put to the test when Chef Ramsay prepares three dishes for them to try. They are then given thirty minutes to prepare just one of the dishes, the fish stew, identifying the ingredients only by taste. The winner enjoys an afternoon with Ramsay, taking an amazing ride in a bi-plane. The losing chefs are punished with polishing crystal and cutlery, cleaning the carpets and prepping for the evening's service. During the dinner service Chef Ramsay tells them they need make it all the way through not only for themselves, but for one of their guests, who plans to propose to girlfriend during the dessert course. Two chefs rise to the challenge, but two struggle throughout the night. One is ultimately eliminated and then Chef Ramsay announces a surprise, to be revealed in the next episode.

5.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S05E13 - Day 13
5.plot: It's down to the final three, who must prepare a meal for 100 of L.A.'s finest chefs. The winner gets some face time on FOX's local morning show, while the losers do the laundry as they watch the winner on TV. At the dinner service, each contestant is given a chance at the pass running the kitchen.

5.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S05E14 - Day 14 (1)
5.plot: The final two chefs prepare for their ultimate challenge. They must design their restaurants as well as create a winning menu. But they won't be there to oversee the renovations- Chef Ramsay flies them back to the Borgata where they compete to wow the Hotel's CEO with their signature dish.

5.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S05E15 - Day 15 (2)
5.plot: The season 5 finale finds the remaining two chefs competing in their final dinner service competition. The winner will be named head-chef at a new restaurant at the Borgata Hotel Casino & Spa in Atlantic City.

7.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S07E01 - 16 Chefs Compete
7.plot: Chef Ramsay introduces himself to the 16 new contestants by announcing that they are expected to complete their very first dinner service. He then divides them into two teams, men vs. women, and sends them to the kitchen to prepare their signature dishes. After presenting the dishes to Chef Ramsay, he sends them up to study the menu and prepare for dinner service, which, unfortunately, does not go as he had hoped.

7.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S07E02 - 15 Chefs Compete
7.plot: Both teams are challenged to prepare eggs four different way. The team that cooks the most eggs properly wins a helicopter ride over Los Angeles. Meanwhile, an argument between one of the chefs and Chef Ramsay during dinner service causes one team to crash and burn.

7.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S07E03 - 13 Chefs Compete
7.plot: The chefs are challenged to serve lunch to the very hungry members of a marching band. During dinner service, one member on the red team gets burned and throws the entire team into chaos.

7.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S07E04 - 12 Chefs Compete Part 1
7.plot: The two teams are challenged two each create a dish based on ingredients chosen by rolling dice with letters on them. Though one team makes some strange choices, the results end up being close, with the final determination coming down to the quality of the cooking rather than the nature of the dishes.

7.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S07E05 - 12 Chefs Compete Part 2
7.plot: "Hell's Kitchen" does barbecue for the first time ever, and the chefs are challenged to prepare pork-themed dishes with their chosen ingredients. But when the red team fails to keep cool under pressure, Chef Ramsay gives them a piece of his mind.

7.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S07E06 - 11 Chefs Compete
7.plot: When it comes to judging good food, mother knows best. The chefs are tasked with preparing dishes representing each of the five "mother sauces," and two surprise judges show up to decide which dishes stand out. For the evening's dinner service, it's family night and the pint-sized customers couldn't be more finicky, rowdy and demanding. As tempers flare, one contestant is sent home and Chef Ramsay surprises everyone by throwing in an unexpected twist.

7.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S07E07 - 10 Chefs Compete
7.plot: Chef Ramsay turns Hell's Kitchen into an upscale deli when he challenges each contestant to create an original gourmet sandwich. While the winning team is treated to an amazing retreat in wine country, the losing team is left behind to perfect the peanut butter and jelly sandwich. Later, Chef Ramsay gets into an angry confrontation – with a disgruntled customer – during a disastrous dinner service. Meanwhile, when Chef Ramsay switches up the teams, the contestants face a different challenge: adjusting to their new teammates while reinventing a wedding menu for a 50th anniversary party.

7.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S07E08 - 9 Chefs Compete
7.plot: The remaining aspiring chefs compete in the eighth episode of the competition.

7.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S07E09 - 8 Chefs Compete
7.plot: The remaining aspiring chefs compete in the ninth episode of the competition. A blind taste test challenges the palette of the chefs. Later, the two teams are tasked to create their own original menus.

7.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S07E10 - 7 Chefs Compete
7.plot: The chefs are challenged to create their own unique lobster dishes. The dishes are judged by Michelin-starred chefs, with Gordon Ramsay left to break a tie after two chefs' dishes are rejected for simply not being cooked to par. The winning team enjoys a visit to a caviar house followed by a shopping spree, while the losing team is made to clean the dorms, then prep both kitchens for service. Gordon Ramsay delivers a surprise by ordering the two teams to work together to complete a dinner service with a time limit of 2 and 1/2 hours. The pressure proves too much for one, leading to a complete meltdown and ejection during service. The dinner service, however, is ultimately a great success, leading to another surprise at the elimination.

7.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S07E11 - 6 Chefs Compete
7.plot: The six remaining aspiring chefs work together for the first time as one team. The chefs are presented with a challenge requiring them to come up with a creative dish using cheap ingredients. Switching stations create added pressure during service.

7.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S07E12 - 5 Chefs Compete
7.plot: The remaining aspiring chefs compete in the twelfth episode of the season.

7.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S07E13 - 4 Chefs Compete Part 1
7.plot: The remaining chefs compete in the thirteenth episode of the season and struggle against the pressure with only four chefs left. The chefs are challenged to teach bachelors how to prepare monkfish. During service, a chef is called out for sabotaging another. A budding romance forces Chef Ramsay to make a difficult decision.

7.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S07E14 - 4 Chefs Compete Part 2
7.plot: The remaining aspiring chefs must recreate a dish by taste; one of the aspiring chefs buckles under pressure.

7.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S07E15 - 2 Chefs Compete
7.plot: The final two chefs compete to be the winner of Hell's Kitchen. Both are given a preview of what they could win and face their toughest challenge yet. One of the two is declared the winner of Hell's Kitchen, earning $250,000 and a position at the Savoy Hotel in London.

12.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S12E01 - 20 Chefs Compete
12.plot: Twenty aspiring restaurateurs hoping to impress Ramsay present their signature dishes; after the opening night dinner service, contestants face elimination.

12.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S12E02 - 19 Chefs Compete
12.plot: Teamwork plays an important role during a relay race in which duos must accomplish basic culinary tasks; while challenge winners go to San Francisco, the losing team picks carrots at a farm; both teams disappoint during dinner service.

12.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S12E03 - 18 Chefs Compete
12.plot: The contestants learn about teamwork during a challenge involving pigs and potatoes; while the winning team enjoys a day on a yacht, the losers bathe their new livestock friends; a disorganized dinner service leaves chef Ramsay disappointed.

12.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S12E04 - 17 Chefs Compete
12.plot: The contestants take part in a team competition involving lobster ravioli.

12.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S12E05 - 16 Chefs Compete
12.plot: The teams must pair side dishes with four different types of protein; while the losing team makes honey taffy from scratch, the winners spend a day at Laguna Beach; the teams prepare a breakfast reception for a wedding.

12.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S12E06 - 15 Chefs Compete
12.plot: The teams must pick a team leader for the next dinner service; a chef serves an undercooked dish; a contestant is eliminated.

12.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S12E07 - 14 Chefs Compete
12.plot: Contestants from each team must work in pairs and present a unique pizza dish to Ramsay; the losers clean up and prepare both kitchens for dinner service, while the winners go to a luxurious hotel; one team runs out of a crucial ingredient.

12.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S12E08 - 13 Chefs Compete
12.plot: The team that prepares the most-impressive Southern-inspired menu for a sorority's anniversary party wins a trip to Las Vegas; both teams struggle with communication during dinner service.

12.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S12E09 - 12 Chefs Compete
12.plot: The contestants are given 30 minutes to create an entree from surprise ingredients; Ramsay conducts one-on-one evaluations.

12.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S12E10 - 11 Chefs Compete
12.plot: The contestants visit one of Gordon Ramsay's restaurants; the teams prepare meals inspired by Ramsay's cuisine; the contestants face elimination.

12.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S12E11 - 10 Chefs Compete
12.plot: A team competition tests the contestants' knowledge of pork, with the winners receiving an indoor sky-diving experience; during dinner service, both teams face struggles.

12.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S12E12 - 10 Chefs Again
12.plot: After both teams are reorganized, the chefs blindly choose ingredients from which they must create a unique dish; the chefs must serve a five-course meal to UNICEF Ambassador Angie Harmon and other VIP attendees.

12.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S12E13 - 9 Chefs Compete
12.plot: The red team and the blue team each create their own menus, from which guests can order during dinner service; the team that impresses diners with its food and service wins the challenge; contestants face elimination.

12.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S12E14 - 8 Chefs Compete
12.plot: The remaining contestants face the blind taste test, with the winning team getting an ice skating lesson with figure skater Rachael Flatt; the contestants struggle to stay organized during the dinner service.

12.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S12E15 - 7 Chefs Compete
12.plot: Ramsay challenges the teams with creating entrees with the highest dollar values with ingredients purchased on a small budget; three previous winners judge individual contestant's entrees.

12.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S12E16 - 7 Chefs Again
12.plot: The Top 7 chefs serve guests from Oxfam America, including Minnie Driver. During the dinner service, two chefs struggle with their stations.

12.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S12E17 - 6 Chefs Compete
12.plot: The six remaining chefs receive their black jackets and prepare tailgate food for football fans; tempers flare during dinner service.

12.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S12E18 - 5 Chefs Compete
12.plot: The remaining contestants use leftovers to create a dish; Better Homes & Gardens Editor Laurie Buckle chooses which dish will be featured in the magazine; the contestants face elimination.

12.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S12E19 - 4 Chefs Compete
12.plot: The remaining four chefs sample one of Ramsay's complex entrees and then must re-create it correctly; two of the chefs face elimination.

12.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S12E20 - Winner Chosen
12.plot: The final two contestants must prepare five unique dishes, to be judged by renowned Los Angeles chefs; former contestants help with the final dinner service; a winner is chosen.

13.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S13E01 - Top 18 Compete
13.plot: Ramsay splits the 18 aspiring chefs into two teams and asks them to present their signature dishes; the winning team spends time with Ramsay and chef Wolfgang Puck, while the losers set up the living arrangements.

13.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S13E02 - Top 17 Compete

However, stress levels rise and Ramsay makes a shocking decision.

17.plot: Teams must re-create six of Ramsay's dishes; the three weakest chefs from each team must re-create one of Gordon's signature dishes; an elimination.

17.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S17E08 - Welcome To The Jungle
17.plot: This week's challenge takes place in the HELL'S KITCHEN "Jungle," where the contestants must create a dish using exotic meats - Boar, Venison and Elk - that were eaten by early humans. Each team will use a spear to hunt for five ingredients to prepare as sides for their dish. Gordon invites special guests Chef Jon Shook and Chef Vinny Dotolo (Animal, Son of a Gun, and Trois Mec restaurants) to help judge the challenge. Later, during the dinner service, Goo Goo Dolls lead singer John Rzeznik is a guest at the chef's table, causing a change in momentum for one team.

17.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S17E09 - Catch Of The Day
17.plot: Special guest judge and fish-cooking expert Chef Michael Cimarusti joins Chef Ramsay, as the remaining contestants compete in a special challenge involving creatures of the sea. Then, during dinner service, the chefs aim to impress a host of VIP guests, including actor Aleks Paunovic, rapper E-40, professional dancer Cheryl Burke and actor Dan Bucatinsky. With two chefs fighting bitterly for authority and another struggling to communicate, Chef Ramsay is less than pleased. Find out who doesn't make the cut.

17.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S17E10 - It's All Gravy
17.plot: The remaining all-stars head to the dining room to be greeted by Gordon and a camel, before diving into the infamous Blind Taste Test Challenge - during which they must decipher spices with the risk of being blasted by mashed potatoes and gravy. Later, during a special dinner service, the restaurant hosts a private charity event for the Leukemia & Lymphoma Society and Shane's Inspiration. Each team must prepare a five-course meal for the guests, including actress Mindy Sterling and actor David Koechner. Find out who gets cut after Chef Ramsay calls this the worst charity dinner service ever.

17.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S17E11 - Trying to Pasta Test
17.plot: The all-stars get a late night call from Chef Gordon Ramsay with instructions on their next challenge. They’re given $20 to purchase ingredients and create three restaurant-quality pasta dishes in order to demonstrate their ability to maximize a profit off the ingredients purchased.

17.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S17E12 - Five Is The New Black
17.plot: Chef Ramsay reveals to the remaining All-Stars that they will be competing for the coveted black jacket by facing a series of three difficult challenges: "Taste It, Now Make It," in which contestants must use their senses to recreate a dish; "Five Domes," in which contestants have 30 minutes to create a cohesive restaurant quality dish using mystery ingredients hidden under domes; and "Free For All," in which the All-Stars must make a dish of their choice using ingredients picked out by Ramsay. Find out who receives Chef Ramsay's stamp of approval and who gets the boot.

17.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S17E13 - Stars Heating Up Hell
17.plot: The remaining All-Stars must instruct athletes Candice Park, Jordan Wieber, Ricky Williams, Shawne Merriman and Reggie Miller to cook their signature dishes - using only verbal instructions. Later, for the first time ever, the all-star contestants will be cooking in one kitchen during dinner service, with special guests rapper and musician Wyclef Jean and actor Mathew Moy. Find out who makes it to the final four.

17.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S17E14 - Families Come to Hell
17.plot: The four remaining All-Stars are invigorated by a visit from their families before their first challenge.

17.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S17E15 - Final Three
17.plot: Chef Ramsay informs the remaining three All-Stars that all of them will compete in the finale. As a reward, Ramsay invites the contestants to a pampered retreat at Calamigos Ranch in Malibu. However, what the contestants think is a relaxing vacation is soon turned upside-down when Ramsay reveals this will be their last challenge before the finale. The three finalists must cook and perfect their menus and only two will advance.

17.title: FR - Hell's Kitchen - S17E16 - All-Star Finale
17.plot: The final two All-Stars pick from the season's past contestants to join them on their team for the final dinner service. With a head chef position at the first ever Hell's Kitchen flagship restaurant at Caesars Palace Las Vegas, and a salary of a quarter of a million dollars on the line it all comes down to this.

meta.plot: Des ministres contraints de se cacher pour échapper à des kidnappings commandités par des barons de la cocaine. Des avocats et des journalistes assassinés. Des policiers et des douaniers soumis à de brutales tentatives de corruption. Ça ne se passe pas en Amérique du sud, en Colombie ou en Equateur, terre des cartels tout puissants, mais en Europe, au Pays Bas, en Belgique, en France.  Les trafiquants de drogue sont entrés en guerre contre les États européens. Devenus tout puissants grâce aux énormes revenus générés par la cocaïne, ils ne reculent devant aucune violence pour prendre le contrôle des ports ou échapper à la justice.  Du Havre à Anvers, Benoit Sarrade a enquêté sur ces mafias, leurs méthodes radicales et sanglantes. "Narcos, la terreur au coeur de l’Europe", une série inédite de Ligne Rouge.

1.plot: With two murders and no strong leads, can Detective Inspector Perez and his team apprehend the suspect before crowds descend on the Shetland Islands for Up Helly Aa, the biggest fire festival in Europe?

2.plot: Detective  Inspector Jimmy Perez believes he and his team are finally closing in  on the killer as they discover what 17-year-old Catherine Ross was  hiding from everyone in the hours before her death.

2.title: FR - Shetland - S02E03 - Dead Water - Part 1
2.plot: When an old acquaintance of Detective Inspector Jimmy Perez dies in a suspicious car accident on the island, he wonders whether his journalist friend had uncovered a story that cost him his life.

2.title: FR - Shetland - S02E04 - Dead Water - Part 2
2.plot: After a second body is found brutally murdered on Shetland, Detective Inspector Jimmy Perez wonders if the two killings are connected to corporate greed and corruption on the island or to just one woman - Evie Watt.

2.title: FR - Shetland - S02E05 - Blue Lightning - Part 1
2.plot: Perez returns to his childhood home after the murder of a scientist on the beautiful island of Fair Isle. Tensions run high as a storm on the mainland forces Perez to work in isolation - and compels all of the suspects to remain together under one roof.

2.title: FR - Shetland - S02E06 - Blue Lightning - Part 2
2.plot: Time is running out for Detective Inspector Perez as prime suspect Peter Latimer lies critically ill in hospital. Was the fire a drunken accident, or was Peter Latimer the second victim of a murderer still free on Fair Isle?

3.title: FR - Shetland - S03E01 - Episode 1
3.plot: When a young man disappears on the Aberdeen to Shetland ferry crossing and a small boy ends up in intensive care, DI Jimmy Perez and his team investigate, becoming convinced the two events are connected.

3.title: FR - Shetland - S03E02 - Episode 2
3.plot: DI Jimmy Perez is convinced that Michael Maguire is somehow implicated in the death of Robbie Morton. But with the investigation seemingly under threat before it's even started, he faces an uphill battle to uncover the truth behind Maguire's silence.

3.title: FR - Shetland - S03E03 - Episode 3
3.plot: The murder investigation takes Perez and Tosh to Glasgow as they try to uncover the reasons behind Maguire's brutal death and his connection to Robbie Morton. But old ghosts return to haunt Perez as his enemies try to prevent him from getting to the truth.

3.title: FR - Shetland - S03E04 - Episode 4
3.plot: Perez and his team are determined to track down the person who helped Michael Thompson's killer on Shetland. But the closer the team get to the truth in both Shetland and Glasgow, the more dangerous it becomes for all of them.

3.title: FR - Shetland - S03E05 - Episode 5
3.plot: Perez struggles to deal with what has happened to Tosh as he continues to investigate the murders of Robbie Morton and Michael Thompson, but a shocking discovery finally leads him to the identity of who Thompson was going to testify against.

3.title: FR - Shetland - S03E06 - Episode 6
3.plot: As the investigation reaches its final stages, Detective Inspector Perez and his team discover the person responsible for the deaths of Robbie Morton and Michael Thompson is closer to home than any of them thought.

4.title: FR - Shetland - S04E01 - Episode 1
4.plot: When Thomas Malone has his murder conviction overturned after 23 years behind bars, DI Perez has to reopen the investigation into the 1994 death of local teenager Lizzie Kilmuir.

4.title: FR - Shetland - S04E02 - Episode 2
4.plot: Perez is on the trail of an attacker, Tosh investigates an oil company in the hunt for Sally's killer, and DNA testing in the Kilmuir case yields a surprising result.

4.title: FR - Shetland - S04E03 - Episode 3
4.plot: Jimmy questions Donna about the shocking DNA results, Alison arrives in Norway in search of Andreas Hagan, and an unexpected twist leads Perez and Tosh into the murky world of the Norwegian far right.

4.title: FR - Shetland - S04E04 - Episode 4
4.plot: Ignoring Secret Service warnings, Perez and Tosh track down Mathias Soderland. Back on Shetland, a beach memorial service is held for Sally McColl.

4.title: FR - Shetland - S04E05 - Episode 5

4.title: FR - Shetland - S04E06 - Episode 6
4.plot: Season Finale - Troubled by historical DNA evidence results, Jimmy has to face the fact that Duncan may have been involved in Lizzie Kilmuir's murder, and potentially Sally McColl's as well. A shocked Duncan is brought to the station for questioning, hurt that Perez would even think him capable of murder. However, the detective knows Duncan's lying - perhaps not about the murder, but about something else significant. So when Duncan finally admits he had an affair with Donna, it's not long before a bombshell is dropped.

5.title: FR - Shetland - S05E01 - Episode 1
5.plot: A severed hand washes up on a Shetland beach, with further body parts discovered in a holdall that has been dumped at sea. Perez and the team begin a complex murder investigation.

5.title: FR - Shetland - S05E02 - Episode 2

5.title: FR - Shetland - S05E03 - Episode 3

5.title: FR - Shetland - S05E04 - Episode 4

5.title: FR - Shetland - S05E05 - Episode 5

5.title: FR - Shetland - S05E06 - Episode 6

6.title: FR - Shetland - S06E03 - Episode 3

meta.plot: The Targaryen dynasty is at the absolute apex of its power, with more than 15 dragons under their yoke. Most empires crumble from such heights. In the case of the Targaryens, their slow fall begins when King Viserys breaks with a century of tradition by naming his daughter Rhaenyra heir to the Iron Throne. But when Viserys later fathers a son, the court is shocked when Rhaenyra retains her status as his heir, and seeds of division sow friction across the realm.

However, mermaids are terrifying creatures that feed on human beings.

When Akira, his girlfriend's brother, comes to his rescue, Toshihide realizes he might be attracted to Akira. In this confusing situation, Toshihide and his girlfriend must decide what will become of their relationship.

He has been managing well until Nayuta incurs the people's wrath with her actions.

meta.plot:
La disparition de Sarah Leroy, quinze ans, a bouleversé la petite bourgade de Bouville-sur-Mer et ému la France entière. Un coupable fut vite arrêté. Pourtant, dans chaque foyer, chaque bistrot, on continuait à élaborer des hypothèses. Ce qui est vraiment arrivé, personne ne l’a jamais su.

Vingt ans plus tard, Fanny, journaliste, revient sur les lieux de ce drame qui a marqué sa jeunesse. Et c’est tout un passé qui resurgit ... Car l’histoire de Sarah Leroy, c’est aussi un peu la sienne, de sa sœur Angélique et celle d’une bande de filles "les Désenchantées" qui ne connaissait que trop bien Sarah. Une histoire qui a l’odeur du chlore de la piscine municipale, des serments d’amitié et, surtout, des plus lourds secrets.

1.plot: Following in the footsteps of Jersey Shore and Geordie Shore, France's 10 biggest party-goers gathered at Cap d'Agde for a dream vacation.

1.title: FR - Frenchie Shore - S01E02 - Uncontrolled skating
1.plot: First contacts for our 10 party kings, who feel as at home in their new home as lemon slices on tequila shots. But first contacts also mean first flirtations and, of course, first clashes.

1.title: FR - Frenchie Shore - S01E03 - The art of ruining your vacation in 3 lessons
1.plot: The vacations are off to a good start for our Frenchies, and especially for the boys, who don't know where to put their tongues. But the girls' jealousy is about to get the better of them, especially Ouryel, who's about to commit the irreparable.

1.title: FR - Frenchie Shore - S01E04 - All French people have their place at Frenchie Shore
1.plot: Pepita is having a hard time recovering from the previous day's events, but a bare-assed barbecue evening eases all tensions.

1.title: FR - Frenchie Shore - S01E05 - Follow me, I'm running away from you...
1.plot: Above the villa, the sun is still at its zenith, but on the bum side the weather is stormy as the Frenchies continue to play cat-and-mouse.

1.title: FR - Frenchie Shore - S01E06 - An a*s between two chairs
1.plot: For once, the girls manage to get everything they want from the boys. Julie gets what she wants, but may regret it sooner than she thinks.

1.title: FR - Frenchie Shore - S01E07 - Dangerous double play
1.plot: The Frenchies pay the consequences of their actions. Tristan reaches the point of no return. Iris has the best afternoon of her vacation. Ouryel and Enzo go on a secret mission.

1.title: FR - Frenchie Shore - S01E08 - The musical chairs
1.plot: The Kara volcano is about to erupt. Cupid has finally set his sights on Enzo. Melvin once again finds himself at the center of all tensions.

1.title: FR - Frenchie Shore - S01E09 - If everything were simple, they'd be bored
1.plot: TTM is caught at its own game. The afternoon is all about exhibitionism. Ouryel and Enzo finally reach 7th heaven.

1.title: FR - Frenchie Shore - S01E10 - The end!
1.plot: Pepita can't get over Iris's torrid shower. Ouryel and Tristan open their hearts. The Frenchies settle the score before a final toast.

2.title: FR - Frenchie Shore - S02E01 - Guess who's back ??
2.plot: It's the big day, the vacations in the South of France are finally starting for the Frenchie Shore! Of the 10 candidates from season 1, who will be returning? Will they like the villa? And above all, who are the new housemates?

2.title: FR - Frenchie Shore - S02E02 - Trouble, flirting and tears!
2.plot: It's finally time for the Frenchie shore's first club outing! Who will bring someone back to the villa? Tension mounts between Pepita and the others, especially as it's raining and they're all stuck under the same roof! An explosive atmosphere!

2.title: FR - Frenchie Shore - S02E03 - Club and pool party, summer has begun!
2.plot: Tension is mounting in the villa. Tristan is bored and wants to leave. How do we convince him to stay? The Frenchies discover a new club and meet a new girl. Our party-goers want a summer pool party. But nothing's ready yet! ”

2.title: FR - Frenchie Shore - S02E04 - The villa is about to explode
2.plot: Tristan has a diabolical plan to separate Pepita and Hardoin. Antonin had warned them that if they missed a job, there would be sanctions. Kara has been disrespected. She can count on Ouryel and Enzo to support her.

2.title: FR - Frenchie Shore - S02E05 - A Frenchie leaves us...
2.plot: For the first time, a Frenchie will be leaving the villa. Ouryel can't help herself; as soon as she sees Patrick, she breaks down. But Pepita isn't far away. Enzo is feeling lonely, so he decides to go to a gay club with some Frenchies.

2.title: FR - Frenchie Shore - S02E06 - No Nico, no party
2.plot: Off to a 24-hour job on the farm for Iris, Tristan, Pepita and Enzo, the team that lost the Shore-lympics. Nico from season 1 arrives in town and Hardouin and Yamina are without their partners... will they behave?

2.title: FR - Frenchie Shore - S02E07 - Fantasies, confessions and a surprise guest!
2.plot: Tristan and Kara are getting closer. How will Yamina take it? Spoiler: not well! It's confession time for Pepita. Hardouin is going to fall flat on his face. Patrick has to choose between Ouryel and Pepita! And look out, a contestant from season 1 turns up.

2.title: FR - Frenchie Shore - S02E08 - Settling of scores!
2.plot: The confrontation between Julie, Ouryel and Kara is going to be terrible. Her arrival pushes Pepita to take responsibility for her relationship with Patrick. And Hardouin? And Ouryel? For Tristan and Yamina, things are not moving forward. Everyone goes to spend a day at the beach.

2.title: FR - Frenchie Shore - S02E09 - La frenchie Shore party !
2.plot: Antonin has a mission for the French Shore! Organize the first clubbing party in the history of the Shore! A candidate from season 1 comes to help them! While they go to recruit the public in a bar, Enzo has a great encounter.

2.title: FR - Frenchie Shore - S02E10 - This is the end...
2.plot: It's the end of the Frenchie Shore party! And to finish, Antonin has planned a party on a catamaran! It's the last chance for the Frenchies to settle their scores and say goodbye.

1.title: FR - Le Coup gagnant - S01E01 - The Golden Goose
1.plot: José Luis is desperate to support his daughter's racing career. When he finds a loophole at work that could get her sponsorship, he jumps at the chance.

1.title: FR - Le Coup gagnant - S01E02 - The the Same Boat

1.title: FR - Le Coup gagnant - S01E03 - Everyone Has a Price
1.plot: A magic trick plays on José Luis' mind as he strategically assembles a team — by any means necessary — to help him get the cash he needs.

1.title: FR - Le Coup gagnant - S01E04 - You Can't Trick a Trickster
1.plot: The gang talks logistics as they're assigned their own tasks. Lina faces a custody threat from her ex-boyfriend, raising the stakes — and her price.

1.title: FR - Le Coup gagnant - S01E05 - The Perfect Plan
1.plot: Nerves settle in as the day of the draw arrives, and a surprise visit from Tarto only makes things worse. José Luis promises Katy will be late for work.

1.title: FR - Le Coup gagnant - S01E06 - Behind the Winning Numbers
1.plot: Dreaming of freedom, the gang's team spirit starts to shatter as they get desperate to claim their cash — but impatience might just unravel their scheme.

1.title: EN - SAKAMOTO DAYS [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E07 - Jurassic Bastard

1.title: EN - SAKAMOTO DAYS [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E08 - Sakamoto's vs. the Lab
1.plot: To rescue Lu, Sakamoto and Shin infiltrate a top-secret lab seized by assassins. Meanwhile, in the prison cell, Lu meets someone from Shin's childhood.

1.title: EN - SAKAMOTO DAYS [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E09 - All Aboard
1.plot: In the depths of the Lab, Shin and Heisuke join forces to take down the invisible assailant, while Sakamoto engages in an intense battle against Kashima.

1.title: EN - SAKAMOTO DAYS [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E10 - Bathhouse Roughhouse
1.plot: Exhausted from their battle, the crew heads to a local bathhouse but finds it too dangerous to relax. Later, a mysterious man arrives in search of Lu.

1.title: EN - SAKAMOTO DAYS [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E11 - Casino Battle
1.plot: The crew faces Wutang in a high-stakes casino showdown to learn who issued Sakamoto's bounty. Meanwhile, X sends a group of vicious assassins their way

1.title: EN - SAKAMOTO DAYS [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E12 - Overload
1.plot: As Sakamoto gathers intel on the assassins targeting him, ORDER begins hunting the death row inmates. Later, Shin and Lu face a deadly assault.

1.title: EN - SAKAMOTO DAYS [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E13 - Just Desserts
1.plot: Saw's attacks push Shin and Lu to awaken new abilities, turning the tables on the deadly killer. Meanwhile, Dump ambushes Osaragi at a temple.

1.title: EN - SAKAMOTO DAYS [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E14 - Strong Assault
1.plot: The battles rage on even as the crew gets treated by Granny Miya! Minimalist threatens Aoi at the store while Heisuke clashes with Apart at Tokyo Tower.

1.title: EN - SAKAMOTO DAYS [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E15 - Round and Round the Tower
1.plot: Deadly battles with death row inmates break out everywhere! The Minimalist who attacked the Sakamoto Store is defeated by Nagumo of ORDER, disguised as Aoi, leaving only Apart as the only death row inmate remaining.

1.title: EN - SAKAMOTO DAYS [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E16 - Slice Slice Dance
1.plot: While X and Gaku invade the JAA, a lone ORDER assassin stands in their way. Amid the chaos, Sakamoto discovers the shocking truth about X's identity.

1.title: EN - SAKAMOTO DAYS [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E17 - Have a Nice Flight
1.plot: After facing Takamura, X and his men temporarily retreat from the devastated JAA Kanto Branch and begin a new plan. Meanwhile, Sakamoto learns that X is his former JCC classmate, Uzuki. Advised by Hyo, Sakamoto and Shin board a plane to take the JCC transfer exam and search for clues in the JCC data bank.

1.title: EN - SAKAMOTO DAYS [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E18 - Kanaguri
1.plot: It's every assassin for themselves as the exam takes to the skies. While Sakamoto impresses fellow candidate Akira, Shin takes on the germaphobe Mafuyu.

1.title: EN - SAKAMOTO DAYS [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E19 - Exam, Stage Three
1.plot: Stage Three of the JCC exams begins as a trio of special applicants joins the fray. Toramaru, a devoted Sakamoto fan, immediately clashes with Shin.

1.title: EN - SAKAMOTO DAYS [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E20 - Mutual Fans
1.plot: Sakamoto discovers Akira's ties to an old friend. While Shin and Toramaru vie over their favorite assassin, X's secret plans throw the exam into chaos.

1.title: EN - SAKAMOTO DAYS [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E21 - Hard Mode
1.plot: Shin teams up with Mafuyu, Toramaru and Kaji to take down a berserk Shinaya. Can these ragtag new allies work together to defeat their rampaging foe?

1.title: EN - SAKAMOTO DAYS [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E22 - Each One's Mission
1.plot: With the entrance exam behind them, Sakamoto and Shin can now continue with their original objective: infiltrating the JCC and obtaining clues on X!

1.title: FR - Extra-Lucide - S01E01 - The noise of others
1.plot: Coach de vie, Denise est télépathe et connaît les secrets les plus inavouables des gens qu'elle fréquente. Ce super-pouvoir est devenu peu à peu un fardeau. Elle doit composer avec l'arrivée inopinée d'Oslo, le neveu d'une de ses clientes, un brin invasif...

1.title: FR - Extra-Lucide - S01E02 - Episode 2
FR - Extra-Lucide - S01E03 - The fine print at the bottom of the contract
1.plot: A dive into the past: childhood, the family home, parents. And above all, friendship. At the age of 12, Denise decides to confide the secret of her superpower to her two best friends, Angel and Melanie... Then comes adolescence, a time of parties and excess; Denise enjoys her superpower without any remorse. It was during this period, while filming her first movie, that Melanie became Joy... Years later, when the friendship between the three had faded, Denise returned to her childhood home with Jérém, her great love. The time had come to reveal her secret to him...

1.title: FR - Extra-Lucide - S01E04 - View of the mind
1.plot: Angel refuses to lend Denise money for Jacques' nursing home, but suggests organizing a poker game at Joy's house, just like in the old days. Denise finally agrees and, for one evening, becomes the legend of underground games once again, uncompromising and undefeated. But things get complicated when Jérém bursts into the apartment, throwing a spanner in the works of their carefully laid plans... Denise finds comfort in Sybil, a client who has recently started consulting her and to whom she feels increasingly close. For Sybil has a rare quality: she always says what she thinks, and always thinks what she says...

1.title: FR - Extra-Lucide - S01E05 - We are born, we live, we die
1.plot: Sybil—now a close friend—gives Denise an ultimatum: she tells her to meet her outside on the street. The time approaches and Denise becomes increasingly nervous about going out. To encourage her, Joy enlists the help of the apartment community. To convince Denise to take control of her life despite setbacks, scars, and fears, each person reveals a key moment in their life.

1.title: FR - Extra-Lucide - S01E06 - Like you
1.plot: Joy decides to sell her wardrobe to put her past as a porn star behind her. Very quickly, a joyful and colorful crowd invades the apartment, much to Denise's dismay. What was supposed to be a simple clothing sale turns into an impromptu party. Joy, Angel, Sybil, Jérém, Jacques, Kevin, Nazim, Mikaela, Joy's friends, strangers passing through—all these voices jostle for space in Denise's head. What if, somewhere in the midst of this chaos, she finally finds the answers she has been searching for?

meta.plot:
Denise sait exactement ce que vous pensez. Et pour cause, Denise est télépathe. Elle connaît vos secrets les plus inavouables. Un super-pouvoir devenu peu à peu un super fardeau. Depuis un an, Denise vit recluse, loin des pensées du monde. Elle s’est réfugiée chez Joy, sa meilleure amie, gloire déchue du porno. Deux super-héroïnes sans trop d’illusions.

Et au final une question : peut-on être lucide et heureux en même temps ?

1.plot: After the Mighty Nein break out of prison and subdue a Volstrucker assassin, Beau interrogates her brutally. But as the questioning ramps up, Beau's suspicions turn to to Caleb as his connection with the Empire and dark past are unraveled.

1.title: FR - The Mighty Nein - S01E07 - Belonging
1.plot: After the Mighty Nein prove their worth, The Gentleman offers another assignment – to steal a mysterious Kryn artifact. Competing desires, however, lead the Nein on separate journeys throughout Zadash. While in the Dynasty, Essek betrays Verrat after a devastating loss.

1.title: FR - The Mighty Nein - S01E08 - The Zadash Job
1.plot: After the Mighty Nein reunite, they embark on an elaborate heist to steal the mysterious Kryn artifact for The Gentleman. But when their plan completely falls apart, it's unclear how the Nein will even escape with their lives.

Ayant complètement perdu connaissance la nuit précédente, Margritte doit découvrir ce qui s'est passé afin d'innocenter, ou de condamner, son propre nom.

Meanwhile, things turn violent during a weapons exchange when inventory goes missing and Arman has 24 hours to find the thief.

Meanwhile, a rift forms between Fiona and her son, Chris, when a secret is revealed that has major consequences for his future, sending Fiona into a spiral as she tries to find a solution.

1.plot: Facing a heartbreaking setback with Luca's treatment, Thony desperately takes matters into her own hands. Meanwhile, Garrett makes a risky demand of Thony, pushing her deeper into moral ambiguity.

meta.plot: Sam & Cat est une sitcom américaine pour adolescents qui a été créée le 8 juin 2013 sur Nickelodeon. Il s'agit d'un spin-off croisé d'iCarly et de Victorious. Il met en vedette Jennette McCurdy dans le rôle de Sam Puckett et Ariana Grande dans le rôle de Cat Valentine. Les filles se rencontrent par hasard au cours d'une aventure bizarre et deviennent colocataires, puis lancent une entreprise de baby-sitting pour gagner de l'argent supplémentaire.

Mais comment être un guide pour les autres quand on est soi-même aux prises avec les fondamentaux de l'amour, de la famille et en quête de sens ?

1.plot: While Paul helps Nate look for Mikey, Lydia plays hardball. Making nice becomes a labor of love for Carla. Shocking discoveries shake two marriages.
